jobs.title: Internship - Consulting - SAP
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Line of Service** Advisory **Industry/Sector** Not Applicable **Specialism** SAP **Management Level** Intern/Trainee **Job Description & Summary** At PwC, our people in business application consulting specialise in consulting services for a variety of business applications, helping clients optimise operational efficiency. These individuals analyse client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilisation of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. As a SAP consulting generalist at PwC, you will focus on providing consulting services across various SAP applications to clients, analysing their needs, implementing software solutions, and offering training and support for effective utilisation of SAP applications. Your versatile knowledge will allow you to assist clients in optimising operational efficiency and achieving their strategic objectives. Join PwC Consulting Indonesia as an SAP Consulting Intern and be part of a team that helps leading organizations transform their business through technology. At PwC, we empower our clients to maximize their SAP investments across key functions such as finance, supply chain, sales, engineering, and human capital. Our work spans consulting, system integration, and implementation services, with a strong emphasis on digital transformation through mobile, analytics, and cloud-based solutions. Driven by curiosity, you are a reliable, contributing member of a team. In our fast-paced environment, you will have the chance to work on a variety of assignments, each presenting varying challenges and scope. Every experience is an opportunity to learn and grow. You are encouraged to ask questions, take initiative, and produce quality work that adds value for our clients and contributes to our team’s success. During your time at the Firm, you start to establish your personal brand, paving the way to more opportunities. Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to: * Apply a learning mindset and take ownership for your own development. * Appreciate diverse perspectives, needs, and feelings of others. * Adopt habits to sustain high performance and develop your potential. * Actively listen, ask questions to check understanding, and clearly express ideas. * Seek, reflect, act on, and give feedback. * Gather information from a range of sources to analyse facts and discern patterns. * Commit to understanding how the business works and building commercial awareness. * Learn and apply professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), uphold the Firm's code of conduct and independence requirements. As an intern, you’ll gain hands-on experience working alongside experienced consultants on real client projects. Your contributions will include: * Assisting in the design, configuration, and implementation of SAP solutions tailored to client needs. * Supporting the analysis of business requirements and helping develop functional specifications. * Participating in system testing, issue resolution, and performance tuning. * Providing end-user support and training to ensure successful adoption. * Contributing to project documentation, reporting, and knowledge sharing. * Collaborating with PwC teams and clients to deliver high-impact SAP services. * Staying informed on SAP innovations and industry best practices. At PwC, we value individuals who are curious, adaptable, and committed to excellence. You’ll be expected to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, engaging with diverse teams and clients. Every experience is an opportunity to learn, grow, and build your personal brand. jobs.descriptionHtml: ### **Deskripsi Pekerjaan** **SEVIMA mencari engineer yang mampu mengarahkan agent AI dalam proses pengembangan dan berperan sebagai penjamin kualitas teknis atas hasilnya. Solusi yang Anda bangun akan digunakan oleh jutaan mahasiswa dan dosen di lebih dari 1.200 institusi pendidikan tinggi di Indonesia.** ### **Lingkup Pekerjaan:** ### **Anda bertanggung jawab atas aspek teknis satu modul, meliputi arsitektur, keamanan, data, performa, dan pengujian. Anda bekerja dalam tim kecil bersama seorang Product Builder, tanpa rantai serah terima antartim.** **Onsite - Surabaya** **Tanggung jawab utama:** * Menyiapkan konteks, menjalankan agent coding, serta memeriksa dan mengamankan hasilnya, termasuk hasil agent yang dijalankan oleh Product Builder rekan kerja Anda. * Mengidentifikasi potensi masalah pada kode yang dihasilkan AI, seperti kendala performa, celah keamanan, dan risiko integritas data. * Menyusun pengujian otomatis berdasarkan *acceptance criteria*. * Memantau tingkat pemakaian fitur pascarilis sebagai bagian dari ukuran keberhasilan. Akuntabilitas atas kualitas kode, termasuk kode yang dihasilkan AI, berada pada engineer yang melakukan pemeriksaan. ### **Kualifikasi** * Memiliki rekam jejak membangun solusi dengan agent coding yang telah digunakan oleh pengguna, serta dapat menjelaskan bagian hasil agent yang Anda tolak beserta alasannya. * Mampu menelaah kode, baik yang ditulis orang lain maupun yang dihasilkan AI, dan mengidentifikasi kesalahannya. * Mampu menyusun pengujian otomatis berdasarkan *acceptance criteria*. * Memiliki orientasi pada kebutuhan pengguna, tidak terbatas pada aspek teknis. ### **Yang Tidak Menjadi Syarat** * Penguasaan sintaks atau daftar *framework* tertentu. * Pengalaman kerja yang semata-mata berbasis tiket. * Jumlah tahun pengalaman. Kami menilai cara Anda memeriksa dan mengambil keputusan. Sebagai konteks, *tech stack* kami antara lain Go, PHP, Vue.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, dan Docker. Penguasaan seluruhnya tidak menjadi persyaratan. ### **Tahapan Seleksi** * **Portofolio karya:** Lampirkan satu karya yang Anda bangun dengan bantuan agent dan telah digunakan oleh pengguna, dalam bentuk tautan atau tangkapan layar. Seleksi awal tidak didasarkan pada CV. * **Studi kasus satu hari:** Selesaikan permasalahan nyata dari institusi pendidikan dengan bebas menggunakan tools AI. Sertakan catatan tentang instruksi yang diberikan kepada AI, hal yang diperiksa, dan hal yang ditolak. * **Sesi evaluasi kode:** Selama 60 menit, Anda menelaah kode hasil agent yang memuat sejumlah kesalahan bersama engineer senior kami. * **Wawancara kolaborasi:** Pembahasan mengenai cara Anda berkolaborasi dengan Product Builder dan menerima masukan. ### **Komitmen Kami** * Boleh gagal, wajib belajar dari kegagalan * 4 jam belajar tiap minggu, di jam kerja * Tools AI terbaik, bukan versi gratis * Cara kerjamu bisa jadi standar perusahaan * Dinilai dari hasil, bukan jam duduk **Benefit Tambahan:** Mentoring langsung dari senior engineer berpengalaman. Lingkungan kerja kolaboratif & suportif. Program continuous learning & tech sharing. Competitive salary & benefits. Work-life balance dan budaya #BuildForImpact. ### **Program Onboarding** Setiap Product Engineer – Builder yang bergabung menjalani program onboarding intensif selama **4 bulan**. Program ini memastikan Anda mampu mengarahkan agent, memeriksa hasilnya secara menyeluruh, dan bertanggung jawab atas aspek teknis produk secara mandiri. Program terdiri dari **tiga fase**. Setiap fase diakhiri dengan evaluasi, dan hanya peserta yang memenuhi standar yang dapat melanjutkan ke fase berikutnya. Tingkat kelulusan program ini sekitar **60%**. Pengembangan tidak berhenti setelah onboarding. jobs.title: Platform Engineer (Senior Software Engineer)
jobs.descriptionHtml: ### **Deskripsi Pekerjaan** **SEVIMA mencari engineer senior yang ingin menjaga sistem yang digunakan oleh jutaan mahasiswa dan dosen, serta menjadi gerbang terakhir untuk setiap perubahan pada inti sistem.** ### **Lingkup Pekerjaan** Anda memegang komponen yang digunakan oleh seluruh tim produk: inti sistem, database bersama, infrastruktur, keamanan, dan pipeline rilis. Banyak tim kecil membangun dengan bantuan agent AI di atas sistem ini. Tugas Anda memastikan mereka tidak saling berbenturan dan setiap perubahan pada inti sistem melewati Anda dengan aman. Anda tidak terikat pada satu tim produk; Anda melayani semuanya. **Onsite - Surabaya** **Tanggung jawab utama:** * Menjaga stabilitas, keamanan, dan performa inti sistem serta database bersama. * Menelaah dan menyetujui setiap perubahan pada inti sistem, termasuk perubahan hasil agent AI. * Menyusun standar teknis dan rulebook tertulis yang digunakan oleh seluruh tim. * Menangani gangguan produksi dan menyusun postmortem secara terbuka. ### **Kualifikasi** * Memiliki pengalaman memegang sistem berskala besar yang tidak boleh berhenti beroperasi, termasuk menangani gangguan pada sistem tersebut. * Mampu menilai hasil agent pada sistem yang saling terhubung dan mengenali perubahan kecil yang dapat merusak modul lain. * Mampu menulis standar dan rulebook yang dibaca serta dipakai orang lain. * Tenang saat menghadapi gangguan dan jujur dalam menyusun postmortem. ### **Yang Tidak Menjadi Syarat** * Mentoring satu per satu sebagai cara utama. Di sini, pengetahuan disebarkan melalui standar tertulis. * Menjadi yang paling cepat menulis kode. Agent yang menulis kode, Anda yang menjaga. * Penguasaan satu *stack* saja. Sistem kami terdiri dari lebih dari satu generasi teknologi. ### **Tahapan Seleksi** * **Cerita sistem:** Ceritakan satu sistem yang pernah Anda jaga dan satu gangguan yang pernah Anda tangani. Seleksi awal tidak didasarkan pada CV. * **Studi kasus arsitektur:** Selesaikan permasalahan arsitektur nyata dengan bebas menggunakan tools AI. Sertakan catatan tentang instruksi yang diberikan kepada AI, hal yang diperiksa, dan hal yang ditolak. * **Sesi evaluasi perubahan:** Selama 60 menit, Anda menelaah perubahan hasil agent pada modul yang saling bergantung dan menemukan perubahan yang merusak modul lain. * **Wawancara dengan CTO:** Pembahasan mengenai cara Anda menyusun standar dan menjaga sistem. ### **Komitmen Kami** * Boleh gagal, wajib belajar dari kegagalan * 4 jam belajar tiap minggu, di jam kerja * Tools AI terbaik, bukan versi gratis * Cara kerjamu bisa jadi standar perusahaan * Dinilai dari hasil, bukan jam duduk **Benefit Tambahan:** Mentoring langsung dari senior engineer berpengalaman. Lingkungan kerja kolaboratif & suportif. Program continuous learning & tech sharing. Competitive salary & benefits. Work-life balance dan budaya #BuildForImpact. ### **Program Onboarding** Setiap Platform Engineer yang bergabung menjalani program onboarding intensif selama **4 bulan**. Program ini memastikan Anda memahami inti sistem secara menyeluruh dan siap menjadi gerbang terakhir bagi setiap perubahan pada inti sistem. Program terdiri dari **tiga fase**. Setiap fase diakhiri dengan evaluasi, dan hanya peserta yang memenuhi standar yang dapat melanjutkan ke fase berikutnya. Tingkat kelulusan program ini sekitar **60%**. Pengembangan tidak berhenti setelah onboarding. Di SEVIMA, setiap karyawan dituntut untuk terus berkembang, dan standar kerja akan terus meningkat seiring waktu. ### **Catatan Penting** Di SEVIMA, penggunaan AI merupakan syarat kerja. Seluruh tahapan tes memperbolehkan penggunaan AI. Penilaian kami berfokus pada cara Anda memeriksa, cara Anda menyusun standar, dan cara Anda bersikap saat terjadi gangguan. Fulltime Surabaya, Jawa Timur Rp 8.000.000 - Rp 15.000.000

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml: **POSITION SUMMARY** We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to drive product strategy, development, and growth for AccelByte's gaming technology platform. You'll own product decisions, not just the backlog. We are looking for a hands-on product leader who can actively identify customer problems, shape product direction, drive product discovery, and translate insights into impactful product initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong product management expertise with commercial acumen, particularly in SaaS pricing, monetization, and business model development, to maximize product value and business growth. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS / RESPONSIBILITIES** * Own and drive product strategy, vision, roadmap, and execution, ensuring alignment between customer needs, technical capabilities, and business objectives. * Lead product discovery by identifying customer pain points, validating opportunities, and translating customer insights into product requirements and actionable solutions. * Own product definition, prioritization, and decision-making. * Develop and refine SaaS pricing, packaging, and monetization strategies, including usage-based pricing and other revenue models, to support product adoption and sustainable business growth. * Identify opportunities to improve product value, customer adoption, retention, and revenue performance through data-driven product decisions. * Collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver scalable product capabilities and successful product adoption. * Engage with customers and internal stakeholders to understand business needs, validate product direction, and communicate product value effectively. * Define product success metrics, monitor product performance, and use customer feedback and data to continuously improve product outcomes. * Provide product leadership and mentorship to other product team members, fostering strong product thinking, ownership, and execution. **QUALIFICATIONS / EXPERIENCE REQUIRED** * 7+ years of experience in Product Management, with demonstrated ownership of product strategy and successful product development. * Proven experience in B2B SaaS, platform products, or enterprise software, preferably involving developer-facing products, APIs, cloud services, or technical platforms. * Strong experience in SaaS pricing, monetization, packaging, or revenue model development, with demonstrated contribution to pricing strategy and commercial outcomes. * Proven ability to drive product discovery, define product requirements, prioritize initiatives, and translate customer problems into successful product solutions. * Strong business acumen and analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate product opportunities based on customer value, market potential, and business impact. * Experience working closely with Engineering teams on technical products, with the ability to understand technical trade-offs and communicate effectively with technical stakeholders.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml: Job Description Technical Project Manager Role Overview We are seeking a Technical Project Manager to lead complex, large-scale cloud migration, cloud deployment, application development and modernization programs in regulated-industry environments. The role combines disciplined project and program management with strong technical understanding of cloud platforms, software delivery, DevSecOps, security, governance and operational readiness. The successful candidate will manage initiatives from discovery and planning through solution design, application development, migration, testing, production deployment, cutover, stabilization and operational handover. The role coordinates multidisciplinary teams and ensures that solutions are delivered securely, compliantly and in alignment with business outcomes. **Key Responsibilities** 1. Project and Program Delivery * Lead end-to-end delivery of large-scale cloud migration, application development, cloud deployment and modernization programs. * Develop and maintain integrated plans covering scope, schedule, budget, resources, milestones, deliverables, assumptions, dependencies, risks and issues. * Manage multiple workstreams across applications, infrastructure, architecture, data, integration, security, networking, testing, operations and change management. * Establish governance forums, reporting cadence, decision processes, quality gates and escalation paths. * Coordinate release planning, cutover, rollback, hypercare, knowledge transfer and transition to support. **2. Application Development Management** * Manage the complete application delivery lifecycle from requirements, estimation and solution design through build, integration, testing, release and production support. * Coordinate product owners, business analysts, architects, developers, testers, UX teams, security specialists and operations teams. * Manage application backlogs, sprint or release plans, acceptance criteria, technical dependencies and delivery commitments. * Oversee system integration, API development, data migration, environment readiness and non-functional requirements. * Ensure appropriate software engineering practices, code quality controls, peer reviews, test automation, defect management and release governance are applied. * Support delivery using Agile, Scrum, Waterfall or hybrid methodologies, selecting controls appropriate to project and regulatory requirements. **3. Cloud Migration and Modernization** * Manage assessment, planning, readiness, migration, validation and optimization of enterprise workloads. * Coordinate migration strategies including rehost, replatform, refactor, rebuild, replace and retire. * Lead migration-wave planning, workload sequencing, dependency mapping, production cutover and business validation. * Coordinate modernization involving cloud-native services, containers, microservices, managed databases, APIs and serverless platforms. * Ensure migration designs address availability, disaster recovery, performance, security, compliance and business continuity. **4. DevSecOps and Deployment Management** * Lead adoption and governance of DevSecOps practices across application and cloud delivery. * Coordinate CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, vulnerability scanning and policy validation. * Ensure security controls are integrated across planning, coding, build, testing, release, deployment and operations. * Manage environment promotion, deployment approvals, segregation of duties, secrets management, artifact controls and rollback procedures. * Work with engineering and security teams to track vulnerabilities, remediation actions and approved exceptions. **5. jobs.title: Applications Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml: Job Description **Role Overview** We are seeking an Application Manager for Avanade’s Application Practice to connect business development, consulting delivery and engineering capability. This is a client-facing practice management role—not primarily an internal application-owner position. The manager leads software teams delivering application consulting, custom development and modernization engagements, while supporting presales, go-to-market (GTM) activities and application managed services. The successful candidate will translate client needs into credible solutions and proposals, mobilize delivery teams, govern execution and develop engineering talent. Working with practice leadership, sales, account teams, architects and delivery managers, the role balances client outcomes, technical quality, commercial commitments, team capacity and capability growth across the application lifecycle. **Key Responsibilities** **1. Presales and Solution Development** * Partner with sales and account teams to qualify application consulting, development, modernization and managed-services opportunities and understand client business outcomes. * Lead discovery workshops, application assessments and solution shaping; define scope, delivery approach, architecture options, assumptions, dependencies and risks with solution architects. * Coordinate estimates, staffing models, delivery schedules, cost inputs and statements of work; support proposal preparation, RFP responses, demonstrations and client presentations. * Validate solution feasibility and delivery commitments through appropriate reviews, and ensure a clear handover from presales to delivery. **2. Consulting Delivery and Engagement Management** * Lead or oversee application consulting and software delivery engagements from discovery and mobilization through build, testing, release, acceptance and transition. * Work with delivery managers and client stakeholders to govern scope, milestones, budgets, dependencies, risks, change requests and contractual commitments. * Coordinate business analysts, architects, software engineers, quality engineers, DevOps specialists and distributed delivery teams with clear ownership and escalation paths. * Maintain delivery reporting, quality gates and client communications; resolve blockers and support project recovery while protecting agreed business outcomes. **3. Application Development and Modernization** * Guide teams delivering custom applications, digital products, APIs and integrations, using Microsoft Azure and appropriate engineering technologies for the client solution. * Lead application assessments and modernization roadmaps covering rationalization, cloud migration, replatforming, refactoring, replacement and retirement. * Ensure engineering practices include secure design, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, accessibility and non-functional requirements. * overn architecture decisions, technical debt, release readiness, rollback plans and reusable delivery assets with architecture, security and operations stakeholders. **4. Application Managed Services, Security and Operational Readiness** * Shape application managed-services scope, support models, service levels and transition plans during solutioning and delivery, with the relevant service teams. * Ensure implementation-to-operations handover includes documentation, monitoring, runbooks, knowledge transfer, support ownership and recovery requirements. * Oversee service reviews and incident, problem, change and release governance for engagements within the role’s remit; prioritize automation and continual improvement. * Embed security, privacy, compliance and resilience requirements in client solutions; coordinate risk reviews, audit evidence and remediation with accountable stakeholders. **5. jobs.title: Engineering

jobs.descriptionHtml: Deskripsi Pekerjaan Kami sedang mencari Substation / Receiving Station Engineer yang memiliki pengalaman dalam proyek gardu induk tegangan tinggi, khususnya pada sistem kelistrikan dengan tegangan 150 kV atau lebih tinggi. Kandidat bertanggung jawab mendukung kegiatan teknis proyek, termasuk instalasi peralatan gardu induk, pengujian kelistrikan, peninjauan gambar teknik, serta koordinasi dengan PLN untuk memastikan pekerjaan berjalan sesuai spesifikasi teknis proyek. Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan * Mengawasi dan mengoordinasikan pekerjaan instalasi transformator serta peralatan utama gardu induk. * Melakukan atau mengoordinasikan pengujian tegangan tinggi (High Voltage Testing). * Memeriksa dan memastikan sistem proteksi relay berfungsi sesuai persyaratan teknis. * Mendukung proses sinkronisasi sistem kelistrikan ke jaringan listrik. * Membaca, meninjau, dan memeriksa gambar teknik kelistrikan primer dan sekunder. * Menggunakan software CAD untuk meninjau dan menyiapkan gambar teknik. * Berkoordinasi dengan PLN, kontraktor, dan tim proyek terkait pekerjaan teknis. * Melakukan analisis dan penyelesaian masalah teknis di lapangan. * Membantu menangani kondisi darurat dan kendala teknis selama pelaksanaan proyek. * Memastikan pekerjaan sesuai dengan spesifikasi proyek dan standar teknis yang berlaku. Kualifikasi * Minimal lulusan S1 Teknik Elektro. * Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun di proyek gardu induk (Substation/Receiving Station) dengan tegangan 150 kV atau lebih tinggi. * Memahami instalasi transformator dan peralatan listrik tegangan tinggi. * Memahami pengujian tegangan tinggi, sistem proteksi relay, dan proses sinkronisasi jaringan listrik. * Mampu membaca dan meninjau gambar teknik primer dan sekunder. * Mahir menggunakan software CAD. * Fasih berbahasa Inggris, baik lisan maupun tulisan. * Memiliki pengalaman berkoordinasi dengan PLN. * Memiliki kemampuan analisis teknis dan pemecahan masalah yang baik. * Mampu menangani kondisi darurat dan permasalahan teknis di lapangan. * Bersedia ditempatkan di Pasuruan, Jawa Timur. * Wajib memiliki laptop kerja pribadi. Jenis Pekerjaan: Penuh Waktu Bahasa: * English (Diwajibkan) Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml: At Xtremax, we believe great developers aren’t just coders — they’re thinkers, problem-solvers, and collaborators. If you have **strong technical fundamentals**, a curious mind, and the drive to grow fast, this program is designed to accelerate your journey. You’ll work alongside experienced mentors, contribute to real projects, and develop the skills to become a future tech leader. We are looking for a Software Engineer who is not only strong in web development, but has proven experience solving real-world problems using Generative AI. You are someone who: * Has built or shipped solutions where GenAI was a core part of the system, not just a demo * Uses AI to automate manual processes and save significant time * Actively experiments with new tools, frameworks and models * Enjoys end-to-end ownership — from design to deployment You’ll be part of a cross-functional team that values quality, automation, experimentation and user experience. ### **Responsibilities** Core Engineering Responsibilities * Design and develop modern web frontend and backend (primary) applications * Develop backend APIs and databases supporting applications * Write automated unit and functional tests * Design and develop applications leveraging cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP) * Assist in build and release automation with DevOps practices * Participate in pair programming and code reviews * Work closely with Business Analysts, Quality Engineers and UX Designers to deliver user-centric features GenAI & Innovation Responsibilities * Design and implement features leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and other Generative AI technologies * Build AI-powered automation tools to reduce manual operational effort * Integrate LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, etc.) into production systems * Implement prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), or agent-based workflows where applicable * Evaluate new GenAI tools/frameworks and assess production-readiness * Prototype rapidly and translate experiments into production-ready systems Collaboration & Delivery * Work closely with Product/Project Managers, Architects, Business Analysts, Quality Engineers, UX Designers, and fellow engineers. * Participate in Agile ceremonies and iterative delivery * Communicate clearly with onshore stakeholders despite offshore setup * Produce technical documentation and support knowledge transfer where required **Requirements** Core Engineering * Experience with frontend frameworks such jobs.title: Developer - Backend
jobs.descriptionHtml: **[PT Mitra Cakra Digital — Tech Team]** **Kami mencari Developer Backend - Java / Spring untuk bergabung dalam tim engineering kami.** Di peran ini, Anda akan bertanggung jawab membangun layanan backend berbasis Java/Spring yang tangguh, teruji, dan sesuai standar arsitektur enterprise. Tidak hanya mengembangkan API biasa, Anda juga akan merancang komponen berbasis event (Event-Driven Architecture), membuat pustaka (SDK) internal untuk tim developer lain, serta menjaga alur pertukaran data agar tetap high-throughput, andal, dan fault-tolerant. Jika Anda peduli pada kualitas kode, menguasai ekosistem Java, serta memiliki ketertarikan pada Apache Kafka dan Developer Experience (DevEx), posisi ini sangat tepat untuk Anda. Apa yang akan Anda lakukan: Mengembangkan layanan backend dan komponen berbasis event menggunakan Java, Spring Boot, serta message broker (Apache Kafka). Membangun, mendokumentasikan, dan memelihara pustaka (library) atau SDK internal untuk digunakan oleh squad developer lain. Mengembangkan jalur integrasi yang andal antara sistem legacy dengan layanan baru sesuai rancangan sistem dan kontrak API. Menerapkan mekanisme penanganan kegagalan (fault tolerance) tingkat lanjut (retry, exponential backoff, Dead Letter Queue). Menulis pengujian otomatis (unit & integration testing) yang komprehensif sesuai standar test coverage tim. Melakukan code review secara aktif, menindaklanjuti temuan tim QA, serta melakukan perbaikan bug secara responsif. Memantau (monitoring) serta menjaga keandalan (reliability) dan performa alur pertukaran data antar layanan secara berkelanjutan. Kualifikasi Utama: Pengalaman minimal 4 tahun dalam pengembangan backend. Menguasai Java 17 (atau lebih baru) dan framework **Spring Boot 3 / 4** (termasuk Spring Kafka, REST API, dan JPA/Hibernate). Menguasai basis data relasional, khususnya **PostgreSQL**. Pengalaman hands-on dengan **Apache Kafka** beserta konsep intinya: producer, consumer group, partition, offset management, dan rebalancing. Menguasai serialisasi data menggunakan **Avro** serta pengelolaan **Schema Registry**. Memahami dan berpengalaman menerapkan pola arsitektur **event-driven** (idempotency, exactly-once processing, dan Outbox Pattern). Terbiasa dengan praktik automated testing (JUnit, Mockito). Memiliki pemahaman baik dan pengalaman hands-on dengan Git, Docker, serta pemahaman dasar Kubernetes. Soft Skill: Disiplin tinggi terhadap standar kode (no cowboy coding), teliti, komunikatif lintas peran (Frontend, QA, PM), serta memiliki sudut pandang "developer-as-a-customer" dalam menyusun dokumentasi teknis dan sample code. Nilai Tambah: Pengalaman membangun internal tools / SDK / open-source library. Familiar dengan Debezium / CDC atau pengelolaan Kafka di platform Cloud (AWS MSK, Confluent Cloud, dll). Memiliki pengalaman bekerja dengan metodologi Agile/Scrum dan tools CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins). Pengalaman di industri IT Consulting. Informasi Tambahan: Skema Bekerja: On-Site (Work From Office) – Kota Wisata, Gunung Putri, Kabupaten Bogor. Budaya Perusahaan: PT Mitra Cakra Digital menerapkan budaya kerja GROWTH (Grit, Results-Oriented, Ownership, World-Class, Techie, Harmony). Kami mendorong tim untuk bereksperimen, mencari solusi berbasis teknologi, dan tumbuh bersama. PT Mitra Cakra Digital berkomitmen pada kesetaraan kesempatan kerja. Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Full-Stack SMPP Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Full-Stack SMPP Developer** We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Full-Stack SMPP Developer to join our growing technology team. In this role, you will be responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing robust SMS gateway solutions and full-stack web applications. You will bridge the gap between complex telecom protocols and modern web interfaces, ensuring seamless, high-volume, and reliable message routing. **Key Responsibilities** * SMPP Integration & Management: Implement, configure, and maintain SMPP (Short Message Peer-to-Peer) client/server connections (v3.4/v5.0) with various SMS Centers (SMSC) and telecom aggregators. * Full-Stack Development: Design, develop, and deploy scalable front-end and back-end applications that interface with our SMS gateway and core business systems. * System Optimization: Monitor and optimize database queries, API performance, and message queuing systems to handle high-throughput SMS traffic. * Troubleshooting & Support: Diagnose and resolve complex issues related to SMPP session drops, message delivery failures, and application bugs. * Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, QA engineers, and external telecom partners to deliver reliable communication solutions. * Code Quality: Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code while adhering to best practices in software development and version control (Git). **Mandatory Qualifications** * Education: Must be a College Graduate with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field. * SMPP Experience: Must have 1 to 2 years of hands-on experience specifically working with the SMPP Protocol (e.g., handling SMSC connections, parsing PDUs, managing SMPP sessions, and troubleshooting delivery receipts). * Full-Stack Experience: Must have 1 to 2 years of professional experience in Full-Stack Development, demonstrating proficiency in both front-end and back-end technologies. **Technical Skills & Competencies** * Backend Technologies: Proficiency in languages commonly used for SMPP and backend services (e.g., Java, Python, Node.js, Go, or PHP). * Frontend Technologies: Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue.js) and standard HTML/CSS. * SMPP Libraries: Familiarity with SMPP libraries such as Cloudhopper (Java), jSMPP, node-smpp, or Python's smpplib is highly advantageous. * Databases: Solid understanding of relational (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) databases. * APIs & Messaging: Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and message brokers/queues (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Redis). * Soft Skills: Strong analytical problem-solving skills, ability to work independently, and excellent communication skills. **Work Setup & Location Details** Hybrid Work Model (A mix of on-site and remote work, specific schedule to be discussed during the interview). On-Site Office: Ruko Citra 7, Jl. Peta Barat No.16 Blok A03, Desa/Kelurahan Kalideres, Kec. Kalideres, Kota Adm. Jakarta Barat, Provinsi DKI Jakarta 11840 **What We Offer** * Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses. * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits (HMO). * Government-mandated benefits * A collaborative and innovative work environment. * Opportunities for continuous learning and career growth in the telecom-tech space. Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * SMPP Protocol: 1 year (Required) * Full-Stack Development: 2 years (Required) Willingness to travel: * 50% (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Core
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer-1 Job Title Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Core Job Description We’re hiring **Junior Software Engineers (Backend)** to join the **Core Payment Platform team** at Flip. If you’re passionate about building reliable systems, eager to learn, and excited to work on products that impact millions of Indonesians, this is your chance. **About Core Payment Platform** As part of the Payment Platform group, our team builds and maintains the critical services that power Flip’s ecosystem. We run over 20 projects that are essential for all business verticals, from money transfers to financial products. Our current mission is to break down Flip’s monolith service and set new engineering standards across the company. This is a rare opportunity to work on systems at scale, while learning modern backend practices in a supportive environment. We primarily use **Go** for our backend services, with **PostgreSQL** and **Redis** as our main data stores. Depending on the project, we use a mix of in-house tools and **Google Cloud Platform** services. **About Flip** Flip was founded in 2015 by three friends from Universitas Indonesia — Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar — with the goal of making money transfers fairer for Indonesians. Today, millions of individuals and businesses trust Flip to send trillions of rupiah across banks every year. We’re backed by leading investors such as **Sequoia India, Insight Partners, and Insignia**, and our mission is simple: **to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world.** At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. **What you’ll do** * Work with senior engineers to build and maintain backend services used across Flip’s ecosystem. * Write clear, tested, and efficient code, mainly in Go. * Review and learn from code written by peers and provide constructive feedback. * Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver reliable features. * Help troubleshoot and resolve production issues under guidance. **What you’ll need** * Basic programming experience in any backend language (Go experience is a strong plus). * Understanding of core computer science concepts: data structures, algorithms, OOP, and clean code principles. * Willingness to learn new tools and technologies quickly. * Good problem-solving mindset and eagerness to grow. * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate in a team. * Alignment with Flip’s values of fairness, respect, and continuous learning. **Why join Flip?** * Learn directly from experienced engineers working on large-scale systems. * Be part of a mission-driven company making finance fairer in Indonesia. * Grow your career in a supportive and collaborative environment. * Enjoy fair rewards, clear goals, and recognition for your contributions.

jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer-2 Job Title Software Engineer (Backend) - E-Money [Go/Java] Job Description We are looking for Software Engineer (Backend). As a software engineer, you'll be the brain behind crafting, developing, testing, going live, and maintaining the system. You are passionate in understanding the business context for features built to drive better customer experience and adoption. **About E-Money** As part of Flip's Consumer Solutions group, you will be the go-to person to work on our e-money part, mainly the Flip Saldo feature. You will be working with a cross-functional team to answer various business questions e.g. increasing the number of transacting users with Flip Saldo. You will be utilizing different tech stacks for various use cases, such as Java (for E-Money core system), Go (cash top-up feature in one of the top Indonesian retailers), and PHP to a certain use case (integration with monolithic system). **About Flip** Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar, who were college friends in Universitas Indonesia, started Flip as a project in 2015 to transfer payments to each other at a fraction of what banks would charge them. They are pioneers in the Indonesian market, with their technology now helping millions of Indonesians, both individuals and businesses, carry out bank-to-bank money transfers through a reliable and seamless app. After nine years of operations, Flip has helped Indonesians transfer money worth several trillions of rupiah and has received double-digit funding from respectable investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partner, and Insignia. Flip’s ultimate mission is to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world. At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. **What you'll do** * Work cross-functionally with the Product, Design, Operations, and Backend teams across the squads to ship world-class products and features. * Write code that's clear, concise, performant, tested, and easily understood by others. * Partner with the product management team to execute the feature roadmap. * Work with the overall backend teams to execute the engineering roadmap. * Help debug production issues across services and levels of the stack. **What you'll need** * Have a solid background in common programming problems and solutions. * Experience working with payment and/or accounting system is preferrable. * Knowledge and experience in Java and Go, PHP Yii2 experience is a plus. * Experience in working with large data set and/or high concurrency system is a plus. * Solid understanding of algorithms, algorithmic complexities, OOP, design patterns, and clean code. * Ability to plan, prioritize, estimate, and execute a task with a good degree of predictability. * Ability to scope, review and refine user stories and/or tasks for technical completeness and to alleviate dependency risk.

jobs.descriptionHtml: **About the GEO Team** ---------------------- GEO stands for Generative Engine Optimization. The GEO team builds products that help multi-location brands understand and improve how they are represented, cited, and recommended across AI-powered search and answer engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. We are building backend capabilities that collect and analyse signals from rapidly evolving AI platforms, measure brand visibility, and turn complex data into actionable recommendations for our customers. **About the Role** ------------------ As Backend Engineering Lead for Uberall’s GEO team, you will combine hands-on technical leadership with responsibility for the growth and effectiveness of the engineering team. You will shape the architecture behind our AI-search products, lead the delivery of new capabilities, and help the team navigate a fast-moving and technically ambiguous domain. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders, you will translate customer needs and emerging developments in generative AI into reliable, scalable, and maintainable backend solutions. Historically, our backend has been built on Groovy and Kotlin. Today we work AI-first, and much of our engineering work runs through AI-assisted development. As a result, we place far less weight on a specific stack than we used to. What matters is that you know your way around backend engineering and can apply sound judgment, whatever the language. **Your Responsibilities** ------------------------- * Lead, develop, and grow the GEO engineering team, starting with two engineers and scaling as the product grows. * Define how the team builds, reviews, evaluates, and ships, including how it uses AI-assisted development day to day. * Guide the design and operation of backend systems that integrate with LLMs and AI-powered search platforms. * Establish robust approaches for evaluating the quality and consistency of AI-generated results. * Ensure that LLM-enabled capabilities are observable, testable, cost-efficient, and resilient to changing models and external providers. * Help the team manage the particular challenges of generative AI systems, including non-deterministic behaviour, latency, rate limits, data quality, and graceful degradation. * Stay informed about relevant developments in LLMs and AI search, assessing them pragmatically rather than adopting technology for its own sake. **Your Profile** ---------------- * Experience leading or mentoring engineers, whether as a tech lead or engineering manager, including hiring and developing team members. * Solid backend engineering experience with at least one object-oriented language (for example, Java, Kotlin, Groovy, C#, or Python). Prior experience with Groovy or Kotlin is helpful but not required. * Comfort working AI-first, using AI-assisted development as a core part of how you and your team build and ship. * Hands-on experience building or operating production systems that use LLMs, generative AI, or AI-powered external services. * An understanding of how to evaluate and monitor LLM-enabled features beyond traditional deterministic testing. * Experience designing reliable integrations with third-party APIs and managing concerns such as cost, latency, rate limits, observability, and provider failure. * The ability to distinguish between an effective AI use case and one better solved with conventional software. * Experience with prompt management, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, or LLM evaluation frameworks is beneficial but not essential. * No experience training foundation models is required; this is primarily a backend engineering and technical leadership role. No experience training foundation models is required; this is a backend engineering and engineering leadership role.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: #### **Build the backbone of BYD's supply chain digital ecosystem — architect high-performance backend systems powering operations across Indonesia and beyond.** #### **Location: Subang, Indonesia** ### **Job Responsibilities** * Oversee the back-end technical system planning, architecture design and continuous iteration of the supply chain business line, to guarantee the forward-looking design, stability and scalability of the systems. * Take the lead in major business projects and core system reconstruction, and resolve technical challenges including high concurrency, high availability and data consistency. * Formulate and drive the implementation of development specifications, quality standards and performance baselines for the team. * Act as the technical lead, take charge of core talent cultivation and echelon building, and conduct critical technical decision-making and technical reviews. * Gain an in-depth understanding of business, participate in product and business planning, and translate complex business requirements into efficient and implementable technical solutions. * Keep track of industry technical trends and formulate the evolution roadmap of the team's technology stack. ### **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree or above; majors related to Computer Science such as Software Engineering, Network Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Digital Media Technology and Electronic Information are preferred. * Solid English skills in reading, writing and communication; proficiency in an additional foreign language is a plus. * No less than 5 years of back-end development experience with proven experience in developing large-scale distributed systems. * Solid foundational knowledge of Java, proficient in IO, multithreading, collections and mainstream basic frameworks, in-depth research on underlying principles, and familiar with the internal operating mechanism of JVM. * Skilled in mainstream development frameworks including Spring Boot and Spring Cloud. * Experienced with message queues (Kafka), distributed cache, ElasticSearch and other middleware technologies. * Familiar with relational databases (Oracle) and NoSQL databases, capable of designing heterogeneous data systems. ### **Recruitment Fraud Notice** PT BYD Auto Indonesia **does not charge any fees** at any stage of the recruitment process. This includes, but is not limited to, application fees, testing fees, interview fees, medical examination (MCU) fees, processing fees, travel expenses, or any other recruitment-related costs. Please remain vigilant against fraudulent recruitment activities carried out in the name of PT BYD Auto Indonesia. All official recruitment communications will only be conducted through our authorized corporate channels.

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Please be informed that Foxelli Group hires exclusively in-house and doesn't work with any external recruitment agencies. Any company or individual claiming to recruit on behalf of Foxelli Group is not affiliated with us.** At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them. If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter -you’ll feel at home with us. **THE ROLE** ------------ We’re on the hunt for a Marketing Manager who can think big, move fast, and actually make things happen. This is not a “just run ads and wait” role. You will coordinate all the marketing initiatives, create new marketing angles, offers, and landing pages, manage the creative department, and brief Facebook ads. This is a full-stack marketing playground where you own projects from the first spark of an idea to seeing real sales roll in. You’ll be the glue between marketing, design, and development - turning customer insights into landing pages, funnels, and campaigns that people *actually want to click, read, and buy from*. If you love: * mixing strategy with execution * testing ideas * improving funnels * and making pretty things convert …and you’ve played with AI tools to move faster, build smarter, or test better ideas, you might be our person **WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING** ------------------------ ### **Strategy & Growth Stuff** * Build and run marketing strategies that support real business goals (not just vibes). * Dig into customer research and market trends to find new growth opportunities. * Analyze what’s working (and what’s not) and turn data into smart next steps. * Come up with fresh ideas to scale our funnels and campaigns. * Manage marketing projects from idea launch improvement. ### **Creative & Content Magic** * Write copy for ads, landing pages, and funnels that sounds human and sells. * Review design work and give feedback so it looks on-brand *and* converts. * Guide the creation and optimization of ad creatives with our design team. ### **Landing Pages & Website Optimization** * QA landing pages like a detective: checking UX, flow, and functionality. * Run A/B tests to improve conversion rates. * Work closely with developers to roll out website updates and improvements. ### **Team Glue (Cross-Functional Hero)** * Be the bridge between marketing, design, and development. * Create clear briefs so everyone knows what to build and why. * Track project progress and keep stakeholders in the loop. ### **Customer Research & Insights** * Collect and analyze customer feedback and data. * Identify pain points and opportunities for improvement. * Use insights to scale sales and improve acquisition. ### **AI Tools & Smarter Execution** * Bring AI into our workflow as a competitive edge. Use GPT, image/video generators, and automation platforms to compress timelines, run more experiments, and beat our own ideas. **WHAT YOU BRING** ------------------ You’re probably someone who: * Has experience as a Marketing Manager or full-stack marketer in e-commerce. * Have hands-on experience building with AI tools - vibe coding, workflow automations, etc. * Understands digital marketing and performance marketing deeply. * Can write clear, persuasive, not-boring copy. * Knows CRO and website optimization. * Loves looking at data and asking: “What actually sells?” * Is organized and good at managing projects. * Has worked with designers and developers before. * Can manage your own time and work remotely. * Cares about customers and research. * Gets excited about e-commerce growth. **BONUS POINTS IF YOU:** ------------------------ * Have used marketing automation tools. * Know your way around heat...

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (Next.js)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About us** ============ Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/ **About the role** ================== We are looking for a disciplined, highly autonomous Middle Next.js Developer to build and ship product features for one of our core D2C subscription products. You will own features end to end across a TypeScript monorepo — a Next.js App Router client, a Fastify + Payload CMS API on PostgreSQL, and Cloudflare Workers at the edge — from the moment you receive a task, through breaking it down, estimating, implementing, testing, and observability, to a clean release to production and confirmation that it works for real users. This is a hands-on engineering role suited for someone who treats production as the standard, not the finish line. Half-tested code, silent failures, and unverified AI-generated output are not acceptable. The codebase is convention-heavy — a layered Feature-Sliced Design structure with strict import rules — and you are expected to work inside those conventions rather than around them. You are accountable for every task you take on and for every area of the product you touch: if it breaks, regresses, or stays half-finished, that is yours to see through. We expect maximum autonomy and real involvement in the product — you work independently within a sprint, communicate risks before they become blockers, and escalate architectural decisions to senior engineers rather than guessing. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== ### **Feature Development** * Build features across the Next.js client and the Fastify + Payload CMS backend according to product requirements * Write code that follows the team's Feature-Sliced Design layering, naming, and import conventions * Ship changes behind feature flags and A/B experiments, fully localized across every supported locale * Integrate third-party providers — billing, email/CRM, analytics — over REST APIs and webhooks ### **Quality & Reliability** * Cover functionality with unit, integration, and e2e tests at the level the team expects * Run a thorough self-review before code review, and review teammates' code with the same rigour * Fix bugs and perform root-cause analysis for recurring issues * Optimize page and endpoint performance — rendering and caching strategy, database queries, bundle size ### **Security & Observability** * Apply secure development practices: schema validation, access control, safe handling of secrets * Follow observability practices — structured logging, metrics, and alerts — using existing tooling ### **Collaboration** * Break down, estimate, and ship your own tasks to production within the sprint — and stay accountable for them after release * Own the areas of the product you work in: their stability, performance, and follow-up fixes * Surface requirement clarifications, estimate changes, and risks early and in writing * Escalate complex architectural decisions and critical risks to senior engineers **Qualifications** ================== ### **Must-Have Experience** * 2+ years of commercial React experience, including 1+ year with Next.js (App Router, Server Components, route handlers, rendering and caching strategies) and solid TypeScript * Node.js backend experience on a typed HTTP framework (Fastify, Nest, or Express) with PostgreSQL — REST API design, schema migrations, integrations over REST and webhooks (signature verification, idempotency, retries) — plus a working understanding of HTTP/REST, auth mechanisms, and web security fundamentals * Hands-on with the modern client stack: TanStack Query, Zustand, React Hook Form + Zod, Tailwind CSS, and a React component library such as HeroUI, ...

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: Bangkok, Thailand, Khon Kaen, Thailand Full-time Permanent employee **What We Need** ---------------- Oivan is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to own the platform that runs our internal technology, including the AI agents we build and operate for ourselves. You will report directly to the CTO and shape how Oivan ships, runs and secures its own systems. This is an internal technology role, not a client delivery position. You will build and run the platform behind Oivan's own products and internal systems, the pipelines, clusters, cloud infrastructure and observability that everything else depends on. A large part of the work is deploying and operating AI agents. Oivan builds AI into its own operations, and you will be the engineer who takes those agents from a working prototype to something that runs reliably in production, with the model endpoints, orchestration, data stores, guardrails and monitoring that requires. You report directly to the CTO, which means you have a real say in platform direction, technology choices and build-versus-buy decisions. We are looking for someone who is comfortable owning a problem end to end rather than waiting for a ticket. We are offering relocation to **Khon Kaen** for people interested. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Design, build and operate the CI/CD pipelines and deployment platform for Oivan's internal applications and services. * Deploy, run and monitor AI agents and LLM-backed services in production, model endpoints, orchestration layers, vector stores, evaluation and the guardrails around them. * Own our Kubernetes clusters end to end: provisioning, upgrades, autoscaling, networking, ingress, secrets and workload management. * Manage cloud infrastructure, with clear cost visibility and sensible guardrails. * Build observability that people actually use, metrics, logs, traces, alerting and dashboards. * Automate everything repeatable with Infrastructure as Code. * Harden the platform: identity and access, secrets management, network policy, patching and vulnerability management. * Support the internal front-ends and the services behind them through build, release and runtime. * Work with the CTO on platform roadmap, tooling decisions and where we build versus buy. * Act as the escalation point for internal platform incidents, and drive the follow-up that stops them recurring. **What You Have** ----------------- Must have * 5+ years in DevOps, platform engineering or SRE, operating at strong medior to senior level. * Hands-on Kubernetes in production, GKE, EKS or on-premise. Not just deploying to a managed cluster, but owning it * CI/CD ownership — designing and running pipelines, not only using them. * Infrastructure as Code — Terraform, Pulumi or equivalent. * Cloud platform experience at production scale. * Linux administration and scripting — Bash and Python. * Containers and registries — Docker, image hygiene, supply chain basics. * Observability — Prometheus, Grafana, centralized logging and alerting. * Secrets management and identity across services and environments. * Networking fundamentals — DNS, TLS, load balancing, firewalls. * Advanced English and strong communication. You will work directly with the CTO and across teams, and you will be expected to explain technical decisions clearly to non-specialists. * Based in Thailand, able to work from Khon Kaen. Bangkok is also a possibility for the right candidate. Good to have * Deploying and operating AI agents or LLM-backed services in production — this is the fastest way to make an impact here. * Google Cloud Platform specifically — GKE, Cloud Run, Vertex AI, Cloud Build. * Angular — enough to support front-end build and release pipelines and to work with the front-end team. * GitOps — Argo CD, Flux or Rancher Fleet. * Service mesh or API gateway experience. * Building reusable Terraform modules and platform abstractions. * Cost optimisation and FinOps practice. * DevSecOps tooling and security certifications ...

jobs.descriptionHtml: **OWM Group** **Ltd** is a forward-thinking technology group comprising several innovative companies, including **OpenWeather Ltd** and **Ulla** **Technology Ltd**, all headquartered in the iconic Gherkin, one of London’s most recognised business centres. **OpenWeather** is a technologically innovative company that specialises in the development of intelligent environmental data products. The UK-based company has been operating on the market for a decade, adhering to its mission to provide high-quality data and analytical products that assist customers in transforming their businesses for the better. The organisation is proficient in the practical applications of artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and information technology (IT) in the context of environmental data. We are currently providing services to over 9 million consumers worldwide, with over 2 billion forecasts generated daily, and 5 PB of environmental data. **Ulla** **Technology Ltd**, our AI-powered assistant platform, is the latest addition to the group and is experiencing rapid growth. Ulla represents the future of AI-led business support, and we are just getting started. Both products run on infrastructure we build and operate ourselves, mostly on bare metal. That’s where you come in. We’re growing and looking for a DevOps Engineer who enjoys running real infrastructure on real hardware. You’ll have genuine ownership and a real say in how we work, and you’ll join a team that values automation over manual work. **What you’ll do** * Run the fleet: deploy, maintain and operate Linux servers, mostly bare-metal, with automation and security built in from the start. * Keep services up: own internal and external services from deployment through day-to-day uptime. * Share on-call: take part in a rotating on-call schedule. * Handle incidents: join incident response and lead root cause analysis. * Work across teams: partner with engineering teams to deliver infrastructure and keep services available. * Build what’s next: contribute to infrastructure and security projects. **What you bring** * 3+ years of Linux administration. * A solid understanding of network services (DNS, VPN, firewalls) and the TCP/IP stack. * Confidence with Docker / docker-compose, Ansible and GitLab CI. * An automation-first mindset and the scripting skills to back it up. **Nice to have experience** * Running Kubernetes in production. * Applying SRE practices. * Operating high-load systems. **Why Join OWM Group** **Ltd?** ● Be part of a global company providing weather services to millions of customers. ● Collaborate with a team of talented professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of weather prediction. ● Opportunities for professional growth and development. ● Flexible working schedule ● Annual performance bonus. ● 25 days of annual leave + 8 UK bank holidays. **OWM Group** **Ltd** is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Work Location: Remote

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Description:** * Mengembangkan, menguji, dan memelihara aplikasi menggunakan **PHP** atau **Java** sesuai kebutuhan proyek. * Merancang dan mengembangkan kode program yang aman, efisien, dan mudah dipelihara. * Mengintegrasikan aplikasi dengan database serta memastikan performa dan keamanan data tetap optimal. * Mengembangkan dan mengonsumsi **REST API** untuk kebutuhan integrasi sistem. * Melakukan debugging, troubleshooting, dan perbaikan bug guna memastikan aplikasi berjalan dengan baik. * Melakukan maintenance dan enhancement terhadap sistem yang sudah berjalan. * Berkolaborasi dengan System Analyst, QA, dan tim terkait selama proses pengembangan aplikasi. * Melakukan dokumentasi kode dan pengembangan sistem sesuai standar perusahaan. * Berpartisipasi dalam code review serta memberikan rekomendasi untuk peningkatan kualitas aplikasi. **Requirements:** * Minimal Diploma (D3) atau Sarjana (S1) di bidang **Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi**, atau jurusan terkait. * Terbuka untuk **Fresh Graduate** maupun kandidat dengan pengalaman **1–2 tahun** sebagai Programmer atau Software Developer. * Menguasai salah satu bahasa pemrograman **PHP** atau **Java**. * Memahami konsep **Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)** dan framework yang relevan. * Untuk Java, memiliki pemahaman mengenai **Core Java**, **Spring Boot**, atau **Hibernate** menjadi nilai tambah. * Menguasai database relasional seperti **MySQL** atau **PostgreSQL**. * Memahami dasar **HTML, CSS, JavaScript,** dan **jQuery**. * Memahami konsep **REST API** dan mampu melakukan integrasi API. * Terbiasa menggunakan **Git** sebagai version control. * Memiliki kemampuan problem solving dan analytical thinking yang baik. * Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. * Memiliki kemauan belajar yang tinggi serta mampu beradaptasi dengan teknologi baru. jobs.title: Product Builder (Product Manager)
jobs.descriptionHtml: ### **Deskripsi Pekerjaan** **SEVIMA mencari Product Builder yang mampu membangun solusi secara langsung, bukan menulis spesifikasi lalu menunggu. Produk yang Anda bangun akan digunakan oleh jutaan mahasiswa dan dosen di lebih dari 1.200 institusi pendidikan tinggi di Indonesia.** ### **Lingkup Pekerjaan** Anda memegang satu modul dari awal hingga akhir: memahami permasalahan pengguna di kampus, menentukan bentuk fitur, membuat prototype yang dapat diklik dengan bantuan AI, mengujinya ke pengguna, lalu bekerja bersama seorang Product Engineer hingga fitur tersebut benar-benar digunakan. Anda tidak mengelola orang. Anda mengelola hasil. **Onsite - Surabaya** **Tanggung jawab utama:** * Mengumpulkan kebutuhan langsung dari pengguna dan menyusunnya menjadi dokumen kerja yang jelas, termasuk alur, UI/UX, dan *acceptance criteria*. * Membuat prototype yang berfungsi dengan bantuan AI dan melibatkan pengguna sejak tahap awal. * Memeriksa hasil kerja AI dan menentukan bagian yang perlu diperbaiki. * Memantau tingkat pemakaian fitur pascarilis sebagai ukuran keberhasilan. ### **Kualifikasi** * Memiliki rekam jejak membuat sesuatu yang digunakan oleh orang lain dan dapat menunjukkannya. * Mampu mengarahkan AI untuk membuat prototype serta mengenali bagian hasilnya yang keliru. * Mampu memprioritaskan, termasuk menolak fitur yang tidak perlu dibuat. * Bersedia berinteraksi langsung dengan pengguna, tidak hanya melalui laporan. * Memiliki pemahaman teknis yang cukup untuk berdiskusi dengan Product Engineer mengenai dampak sebuah fitur terhadap data dan sistem. ### **Yang Tidak Menjadi Syarat** * Sertifikasi Scrum atau pengalaman mengelola tim besar. * Kemampuan coding dari nol. * Jumlah tahun pengalaman. Kami menilai apa yang telah Anda bangun. ### **Tahapan Seleksi** * **Portofolio karya:** Lampirkan satu karya yang Anda buat dengan bantuan AI dan telah digunakan oleh pengguna, dalam bentuk tautan atau tangkapan layar. Seleksi awal tidak didasarkan pada CV. * **Studi kasus satu hari:** Ubah permasalahan nyata dari institusi pendidikan menjadi prototype yang dapat diklik. Sertakan catatan tentang instruksi yang diberikan kepada AI, hal yang diperiksa, dan hal yang ditolak. * **Sesi evaluasi hasil AI:** Selama 60 menit, Anda menelaah hasil AI yang memuat sejumlah kesalahan dan menjelaskan temuan Anda. * **Wawancara pengguna dan keputusan produk:** Pembahasan mengenai pengalaman Anda dengan pengguna nyata dan cara Anda mengambil keputusan. ### **Komitmen Kami** * Boleh gagal, wajib belajar dari kegagalan * 4 jam belajar tiap minggu, di jam kerja * Tools AI terbaik, bukan versi gratis * Cara kerjamu bisa jadi standar perusahaan * Dinilai dari hasil, bukan jam duduk ### **Program Onboarding** Setiap Product Engineer – Builder yang bergabung menjalani program onboarding intensif selama **4 bulan**. Program ini memastikan Anda mampu mengarahkan agent, memeriksa hasilnya secara menyeluruh, dan bertanggung jawab atas aspek teknis produk secara mandiri. Program terdiri dari **tiga fase**. Setiap fase diakhiri dengan evaluasi, dan hanya peserta yang memenuhi standar yang dapat melanjutkan ke fase berikutnya. Tingkat kelulusan program ini sekitar **60%**. Pengembangan tidak berhenti setelah onboarding. Di SEVIMA, setiap karyawan dituntut untuk terus berkembang, dan standar kerja akan terus meningkat seiring waktu. **Benefit Tambahan:** Mentoring langsung dari senior engineer berpengalaman. Lingkungan kerja kolaboratif & suportif. Program continuous learning & tech sharing. Competitive salary & benefits. Work-life balance dan budaya #BuildForImpact. ### **Catatan Penting** Di SEVIMA, penggunaan AI merupakan syarat kerja. Seluruh tahapan tes memperbolehkan penggunaan AI. Penilaian kami berfokus pada instruksi yang Anda berikan, hasil yang Anda periksa, dan keputusan yang Anda tolak. Fulltime Surabaya, Jawa Timur

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Description** ------------------- 1. Job Purpose To lead loss elimination and process capability improvement in a designated area by driving the KHMS Zero Loss journey, owning the Centreline DMS system, developing control strategies, and building frontline problemsolving capability through coaching and technical leadership. 2. Key Responsibilities Loss Elimination & Problem Solving * Identify, prioritize, and eliminate chronic and sporadic losses using KHMS and reliability tools. * Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Universal Problem Solving (UPS) for critical issues. * Maintain structured loss analysis routines with regular updates to the CI action pipeline. Process Control & Standardization * Own and lead deployment of the Centerline Daily Management System (DMS) in the assigned area. * Define and maintain equipment standards and basic conditions (CIL and CL targets). * Implement and conduct health checks for Centerline and Defect Handling systems. * Lead change management processes related to Safety, Quality, Engineering, and KHMS. Daily Leadership & Rhythm Execution * Spend at least 80% of time on the floor, observing losses, supporting operators, and gathering data. * Lead CI daily routines, including data review, planned stops, RCFA, and floor coaching. * Actively participate in DDS (Daily Direction Setting) meetings (Level 1 and 2), reporting progress and flagging issues. * Partner with Process Owner and Maintenance Lead to prioritize and align on improvement actions. 3. Key Metrics/KPI * Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE) * Yield Losses * Right First Time (Quality) * Safety Metrics * KHMS Scorecard Compliance * Centerline DMS health status 4. Key Stakeholders * Line Operators * Team Leaders (Operations and Engineering) * Process Owner * Operations Manager * Maintenance Supervisors * Project Engineers 5. jobs.descriptionHtml: **Opportunity:** Graphic Designer 3D / Architect **Location:** Remote (Indonesia) | **Job Type:** Full-Time | **Contract Type:** Independent Contractor At The Sign Pack (www.thesignpack.com), we specialize in creative signage design for leading sign companies across the US, Canada, UK, and Australia. We’re looking for a talented 3D Designer with strong SketchUp experience to join our fully remote team in EMEA. This role is ideal for someone who loves building realistic 3D sign concepts, understands production realities, and enjoys working in a collaborative, deadline-driven environment. **What You’ll Do** * Create 3D sign concepts and realistic visualizations using SketchUp and V-Ray * Develop production-ready files for fabrication * Convert existing artwork into dimensional sign layouts * Work closely with your Team Lead and Project Manager * Manage job tickets and deadlines efficiently * Maintain quality standards and client satisfaction **What We’re Looking For** * Strong proficiency in **SketchUp (required)** * Experience with **V-Ray or other rendering engines** * Solid knowledge of **Adobe Illustrator** and **Photoshop** * Strong understanding of **vector vs raster and RGB vs CMYK workflows** * 3+ years of experience in 3D design or graphic design * Ability to interpret construction drawings and technical details * Organized, deadline-oriented, and comfortable in a fast-paced team environment **Nice to Have (But Not Required)** * Experience with signage, environmental graphics, or dimensional work (strong plus) * Experience in signage fabrication or materials * Knowledge of lighting, channel letters, and dimensional signage * Background in Architecture, Product Design, or Industrial Design **Why Join Us?** * Work 100% remotely with a supportive, international team * Collaborate on creative projects for well-known brands in the US, UK, Canada, and Australia * Opportunities for growth and senior responsibilities over time * Be part of a company that values teamwork, innovation, and treating all stakeholders as partners **How to Apply to our Graphic Designer 3D / Architect Position** Please apply through Indeed and include: * Your CV/resume in English * A link to your **portfolio** showcasing design work (signage projects are a big plus) Ready to design for the global signage industry? Apply today and join The Sign Pack team! Job Type: Full-time Application Question(s): * Describe your typical workflow when creating a 3D model in SketchUp from scratch. * Have you created 3D models intended for fabrication or technical approval (not just visualization)? Please explain. * What computer setup do you currently use for design/architecture work (processor, RAM, graphics capabilities)? Do you have a stable high-speed internet connection suitable for remote work (please include your average download/upload speeds if possible)? * What are your monthly compensation expectations for this role? Please indicate an amount in USD. Language: * English (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

jobs.descriptionHtml: **About AkzoNobel** Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together. For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com © 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved. **Job Purpose** --------------- The purpose of this job is to define and drive the company’s strategy for Pricing, Rebates and Customer Marketing to support sustainable revenue growth and margin optimization. The role leads the development and execution of segment and category pricing strategies, margin management initiatives, and in-store activation programs, including POST business management, that will directly influence both top and bottom performance of the company. This position will lead the team in developing and executing strategic programs that drive revenue across the value chain - from Sell-In to Offtake generation. It requires a strong understanding of market dynamics and a close engagement with key stakeholders, leveraging multiple sources of data (market, insights, pricing, GDP, and input from both strategic and market execution) to develop effective Trade and customer growth strategies. The role provides leadership to the team to ensure the implementation and execution of strategies, while maintaining compliance to AkzoNobel Expectation and Code of Conduct **Key Accountabilities** ------------------------ * Initiates and implements Pricing strategy, programs, and supporting activities (incl. capabilities, tools and training) to Market execution team (sales) within MSU Paints Indonesia, aligned with Global Pricing Program * Analyze demand, seasonality, customer booking valuation, and other inputs into revenue management system through SMART pricing * Ensure all sales and commercial processes, operational updates are well documented. Receive and provide regular inputs to Sales * Drive successful implementation of Pricing programs to standardize Rebates and Discounts across channels, ensure compliance. jobs.title: User Research Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml: ***User Research Lead - Data Lab Indonesia*** ***This is a hybrid position which requires 8 days per month in the office. You will be based in our office in WRI Indonesia, Jakarta. Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position.*** **Program Overview** WRI Indonesia is an independent research organization that turns big ideas into action at the nexus of environment, economic opportunity, and human well-being. At WRI Indonesia, we aim to bring innovations in research and business approaches in order to create the enabling conditions for Indonesia to achieve robust economic growth while respecting environmental and social values. We seek to contribute to the accomplishment of ambitious sustainable development goals through working with leaders in public and private sectors, as well as collaborating with civil society organizations, in turning big ideas into action. Within our Food-Land-Water (FLW) Program, we envision critical ecosystems such as forests and peatland across Indonesia to be governed fairly and sustainably. We believe sustainable land use management is key for Indonesia to meet its climate goal, in line with keeping the global climate target below the 1.5 degree Celcius warming threshold, while providing sustainable livelihoods to forest-dependent communities and conserve biodiversity in the landscape. We intend to achieve this through safeguarding the remaining forest and peatland from deforestation, degradation, and fragmentation; maintaining forests and peatland quality through sound stewardship; and restoring degraded ecosystem to improve its productivity, conservation value, and ecosystem services. To achieve Indonesia’s climate goal while at the same time improving the livelihood of the communities and protecting biodiversity, we work together with partners to mainstream nature-based solutions (NbS) as an approach to address global climate challenge. We aim to achieve this through research, policy advocacy, and creation of a community of practice to develop new financing model for forest conservation, advocate regulatory framework that are conducive for NbS approach, and development of multi-stakeholder platform to amplify and accelerate NbS approach in Indonesia and Southeast Asia region. ***Data Lab Indonesia*** The Data Lab Unit aims to establish a leading hub for open-source data, code, and visualizations, fostering data democratization and collaboration among NGOs and development partners. By addressing critical challenges such as unsustainable data platform management strategies, technical inconsistencies, and high employee turnover, the unit will ensure the long-term sustainability and impact of WRI Indonesia's platforms. This initiative transforms grant-dependent outputs into powerful tools for driving positive change in climate resilience, social equity, and nature conservation across Indonesia and Southeast Asia. Aligning with WRI's strategy, the Data Lab Unit promotes systemic, data-driven solutions, transitioning WRI's approach from isolated project delivery to broader systems change while enhancing institutional capabilities and addressing financial sustainability gaps to create scalable, impactful initiatives. **Job Highlight** The User Research Lead will support the Data Lab team in integrating design thinking with strategic objectives to advance Data Lab mission. Reporting to the Product and Engineering Manager, The User Research Lead will work closely with a dedicated team, including a Product Specialist, UI/UX Designer, and Visualization Designer. These collaborators will provide essential support, fostering a culture of teamwork and innovation. Based in Jakarta and tailored for teleworking, offering flexibility while requiring occasional travel to project sites or partner locations. The User Research Lead will be instrumental in creating user-centered tools and platforms that reflect WR...
