jobs.descriptionHtml: **Responsibilities** Responsibilities: * Develop, maintain, and enhance web-based applications using PHP. * Build application features and modules based on business requirements and defined specifications. * Develop applications using PHP frameworks such as Laravel or CodeIgniter. * Design, manage, and optimize MySQL databases. * Develop and integrate REST APIs with internal systems and third-party services. * Perform debugging, testing, and bug fixing. * Ensure applications function properly, securely, and with optimal performance. * Collaborate with developers, UI/UX designers, QA, and other relevant teams throughout the application development process. **Requirements** Requirements: * Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Informatics Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. * Min. 1 year of work experience as a PHP Programmer or Web Developer. * Proficiency in PHP programming and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts. * Experience using the Laravel PHP framework. * Understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap. * Experience using MySQL databases and understanding of SQL queries. * Understanding of REST API concepts and API integration. * Understanding of the MVC (Model-View-Controller) architecture. **About PT Metrodata Electronics Tbk** PT. Metrodata Electronics Tbk, known as Metrodata Group, is the leading information communication technology (ICT) companies in Indonesia. On 14 February 1990, Metrodata Group launched its Initial Public Offering on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX – MTDL) to raise funds for investment and working capital as well to allow public participation in its development and growth. With more than 40 years of experience in ICT, Metrodata Group has accompanied its customers as they’ve grown their business. Our professional employees continue to develop new innovations and ready to be challenges with the new era. We offer solutions in 8 areas: Cloud Services, Digital Business Platform, Big Data, Security, Business Application, Hybrid IT infrastructure, Consulting & Advisory Services, and Managed services. PT Metrodata Electronics Tbk has also been certified ISO 9001:2015. As prove, Metrodata Group has received number of awards and recognitions for its accomplishments including Forbes 50 Best of Companies 2020, Investor Award Best Listed Companies 2020: Electronics Sector, Warta Ekonomi Magazine: Living Legend Company - Leading ICT Integrator Company, 2019. We believes that a solid and customer satisfaction oriented team is the key to achieve ultimate success. To fulfill that commitment, we invite you, highly commitment professional to explore and be part of our team.

jobs.descriptionHtml: Job Posting Date2026.10.29 Job TypeRegular TeamProduct Management Location BSD City, Indonesia About TravelokaTraveloka is Southeast Asia’s leading all-in-one travel platform connecting millions globally with trusted, world-class experiences. With over 140 million app downloads and more than 40 million monthly active users, Traveloka stands as one of the most popular travel apps in the region. **Job Description** =================== *Job ID: MJ000427* We seek a talented and experienced Senior Product Manager with strong expertise in customer-facing mobile Apps and Desktop web platforms to join our dynamic team. Our Product Management team plays a vital role in transforming ideas into innovative products that address user experience needs and elevate the Traveloka experience. You will also be driving the development and implementation of critical technical products that enhance our platform's capabilities and help users discover and fulfill their travel inspiration and needs. * Contribute to the technical product vision and strategy across customer-facing Apps and Desktop product lines within Demand Products. * Develops and maintains detailed product roadmaps, incorporating technical input and aligning with business priorities, focusing on specific phases like ideation or post-launch optimization. * Guides and mentors junior team members, fostering technical literacy and collaboration with engineering teams. * Collaborate with engineering teams to define technical requirements, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance of customer-facing platforms across Apps and Desktop. * Conduct in-depth market research and competitive analysis on customer-facing app and web experiences, industry UX trends, and digital product benchmarks to identify opportunities for innovation. * Design, run, and analyze A/B tests and other experiments to validate product hypotheses and drive iterative improvements across Apps and Desktop. * Work with UX/UI designers and data scientists to support cohesive product strategies across platforms. * Help prioritize features and manage backlog with oversight from senior managers. * Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) for product performance and identify areas for technical improvement. * Stay informed on industry trends and emerging technologies relevant to the product line. Requirements: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field from a reputable university. * Minimum 8 years of product management experience, with at least 3 years managing customer-facing mobile Apps and/or Desktop web products. * Experience in travel, e-commerce, or other high-traffic consumer app environments. * Proven experience handling customer-facing Apps and Desktop platforms, with strong understanding of cross-platform user experience, app performance, and API-driven product development. * Experience designing and running A/B tests or other experimentation methods to inform product decisions. * Strong understanding of software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum). * Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to think strategically. * Proven track record of successful product launches and iterations. * Strong analytical skills with experience in data-driven decision-making. * Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to bridge the gap between business needs and technical implementation.

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Product Designer** ==================== Product On-site Jakarta, Indonesia **We’re Building the Future of Capital Markets;** ------------------------------------------------- ‍ enabling entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience*‍* *As Asia's largest licensed digital securities exchange for alternative investments, Alta is at the forefront of building critical capital market infrastructure. This end-to-end solution simplifies and expedites the trading of smaller asset blocks, ultimately facilitating access and liquidity in private markets. **Innovative Financial Ecosystem**: Our journey has seen us transition from securities trading and distribution of comprehensive products, including equities, private credit, funds, and asset-backed securities (“ABS”) (representing Real World Assets ("RWA") like whiskies, wines, art, watches, and real estate) to include fund management and digital custody services. As the only integrated securities exchange, brokerage, and fund management group with the necessary regulatory licenses and a proven track record in Southeast Asia, we are actively exploring new channels and partnerships to extend our impact to entrepreneurs and investors globally. Established in 2016 and headquartered in Singapore, Alta operates offices globally. We welcome energetic and creative individuals to be part of this ambitious journey with us. ‍ **About The Role** ------------------ We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our small, hands-on design team and help shape the platforms that power Alta’s marketplace for alternative investments. You’ll design features and flows across our core and client product suites, turning complex financial workflows and data into experiences that feel clear and intuitive for investors, issuers and internal teams. Working closely with a senior designer, product managers and engineers, you’ll be involved in the full design process, from understanding the problem and supporting user research to prototyping, handoff and iteration after launch. jobs.title: Senior Web Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Senior Web Designer - DotYeti** **Important Note:** This position operates within the Jakarta, Indonesia time zone (3 PM - 11 PM WIB). Flexibility with working hours is essential. **At DotYeti, we believe great design should feel as good to make as it does to look at.** We're a fully remote creative team helping businesses bring their ideas to life. Everything we make starts with two things: artistry in every detail and excellence in every delivery. The rest comes naturally: joy in the work, growth for everyone, and a team that has each other's backs. **What you'll do:** * **Creative Craft:** Develop high-level website concepts, landing pages, UI/UX systems, and conversion-focused digital designs, made with real artistry and the kind of detail people notice. * **Quality & Delivery:** Deliver responsive web designs, interactive layouts, and email templates that are polished, on-brand, and on time. You hold your work to a high bar before anyone else has to. * **Collaboration:** Work closely with design and development teams to turn briefs into high-performing web experiences, present design rationale clearly, share feedback openly, and keep projects moving (and fun). * **Problem Solving:** Optimize user journeys, resolve complex UI/UX layout roadblocks, and bridge design-to-development handoffs, finding fixes that last, not just quick patches. * **Learning & Tools:** Explore new tools, AI workflows, and techniques that help the team create better work. **Our ideal candidate:** * Has extensive experience in web and email design, with a strong portfolio showcasing landing pages, email marketing assets, and app interfaces. * Possesses deep expertise in design software and technologies (Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop). * Has a strong understanding of email marketing design principles, including responsive layouts, deliverability, and conversion optimization. * Has a great eye and cares how things look, feel, and work, not just whether they're finished. * Takes pride in the details and doesn't call it done until it's right. * Is naturally curious, always tinkering with a new tool, trick, or technique. * Communicates clearly, offers help, asks for it, and celebrates wins with the team. **Bonus Points for:** * Familiarity with Webflow, Shopify, WordPress, HTML/CSS for email template customizations. * Previous startup and/or design agency experience. * Experience handling design requests for MSMEs, large corporations, and entrepreneurial initiatives. **What We Offer:** * **Fully Remote Work:** Enjoy the flexibility of a remote work environment in an independent contractor setup. * **Paid Time Off & Benefits:** Generous paid time off and mental health leave. * **Competitive Compensation:** Competitive salary with yearly performance-based raises. * **Equipment Allowance:** Allowance provided to equip your home office. * **Professional Growth:** Opportunity to grow with a talented and collaborative team. **How we hire:** * **Let's get to know each other.** A relaxed first chat about how you work, how you communicate, and what makes work fun for you. * **Show us your craft.** This is the big one. A practical assessment where we look at your creativity, your attention to detail, and the polish of the final result. * **Final interview.** We'll talk through your work, how you tackle problems, and where you want to grow next. * **Job offer!** **Note:** We are currently not accepting meeting requests for this position through our website. Submit your application via this job ad.

jobs.descriptionHtml: Job Posting Date2026.07.28 Job TypeRegular TeamProduct Management Location BSD City, Indonesia About TravelokaTraveloka is Southeast Asia’s leading all-in-one travel platform connecting millions globally with trusted, world-class experiences. With over 140 million app downloads and more than 40 million monthly active users, Traveloka stands as one of the most popular travel apps in the region. **Job Description** =================== *Job ID: MJ000272* **Job Description** We seek an execution-focused Technical Product Manager to join our Flight System Integration team. You will be responsible for the day-to-day development and maintenance of API connections with our suppliers, ensuring they are optimized for performance and accuracy. In this role, you will be at the heart of our technical execution, ensuring the "pipes" that power our travel platform are robust and efficient. Familiarity with the Flight API ecosystem (GDS, NDC, PSS) is a significant plus. * Strong understanding of Agile and Scrum methodologies. * Data-driven decision-making skills with a focus on optimizing system metrics and performance. * Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to bridge the gap between business needs and technical implementation.

Berdasarkan *acceptance criteria*, Anda bersama agent AI membangun pengujian otomatis *end-to-end*, lalu memeriksa hasil agent coding sebelum rilis. Pengujian manual hanya digunakan untuk eksplorasi dan kasus baru, bukan untuk regresi. **Onsite Surabaya** **Tanggung jawab utama:** * Membangun pengujian otomatis *end-to-end* (misalnya dengan Playwright) dari *acceptance criteria* dengan bantuan agent. * Menelaah kode dan menemukan sumber bug, tidak sebatas mereproduksinya. * Memeriksa hasil agent testing dan memastikan setiap test benar-benar menguji sesuatu. * Melakukan pengujian eksploratif pada fitur dan kasus baru. Kami menilai automation yang pernah Anda bangun. * Jumlah tahun pengalaman pengujian manual. ### **Tahapan Seleksi** * **Portofolio karya:** Lampirkan satu automation yang Anda bangun dan telah digunakan oleh tim, dalam bentuk tautan atau tangkapan layar. Seleksi awal tidak didasarkan pada CV. * **Studi kasus satu hari:** Susun pengujian *end-to-end* dari *acceptance criteria* dengan bantuan agent. Sertakan catatan tentang instruksi yang diberikan kepada AI, hal yang diperiksa, dan hal yang ditolak. * **Sesi evaluasi test:** Selama 60 menit, Anda menelaah test hasil agent yang lolos tetapi sebenarnya tidak menguji apa pun, lalu menjelaskan temuan Anda. * **Wawancara kualitas:** Pembahasan mengenai bug paling sulit yang pernah Anda temukan dan cara Anda menemukannya. ### **Komitmen Kami** * Boleh gagal, wajib belajar dari kegagalan * 4 jam belajar tiap minggu, di jam kerja * Tools AI terbaik, bukan versi gratis * Cara kerjamu bisa jadi standar perusahaan * Dinilai dari hasil, bukan jam duduk Benefit lainnya meliputi remunerasi yang kompetitif, makan siang, serta akses ke konferensi dan workshop teknologi. **Benefit Tambahan:** Mentoring langsung dari senior engineer berpengalaman. Lingkungan kerja kolaboratif & suportif. Program continuous learning & tech sharing. Competitive salary & benefits. Work-life balance dan budaya #BuildForImpact. ### **Program Onboarding** Setiap Product Engineer – Quality yang bergabung menjalani program onboarding intensif selama **4 bulan**. Program ini memastikan Anda mampu membangun pengujian otomatis, memeriksa hasil agent, dan menjaga kualitas produk secara mandiri. Program terdiri dari **tiga fase**. Setiap fase diakhiri dengan evaluasi, dan hanya peserta yang memenuhi standar yang dapat melanjutkan ke fase berikutnya. Tingkat kelulusan program ini sekitar **60%**. Pengembangan tidak berhenti setelah onboarding. Di SEVIMA, setiap karyawan dituntut untuk terus berkembang, dan standar kerja akan terus meningkat seiring waktu. ### **Catatan Penting** Posisi QA manual tidak kami buka. Apabila Anda belum dapat membaca kode, posisi ini belum sesuai untuk saat ini. Di SEVIMA, penggunaan AI merupakan syarat kerja. Seluruh tahapan tes memperbolehkan penggunaan AI. jobs.title: QA Project and Data Management (SPX)
jobs.descriptionHtml: Department Operations LevelEntry Level LocationBangkok The Operation teams at Shopee covers the operational end-to-end process, from when the buyer searches for a product listed on the Shopee platform, to the moment the buyer receives the products. The team analyses and monitors operational KPIs across the region and conducts root cause analysis when operation performance fluctuates. The Operations team comprises Customer Service, Payment, Listings, Warehouse, Logistics, Seller Operations and Fraud. Job Description: The Associate will be responsible for driving key QA projects and managing data workflows to improve compliance, efficiency, and audit accuracy across SPX operations. This role combines project management, stakeholder coordination, and data analysis to ensure smooth execution of QA initiatives and to provide actionable insights to leadership. * Lead and support different projects. Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders (Ops, BI, Product, Costing, etc.) to ensure alignment and smooth execution of the initiatives * Conduct deep-dive data analysis to identify non-compliance trends, operational inefficiencies, and potential fraud cases * Provide data-backed recommendations to improve frameworks, SOPs, and training * Prepare regular reports and insights for management on the performance metrics, compliance trends, and initiative progress * Support audit design and automation efforts to reduce manual work and increase audit accuracy * Conduct site visits to validate on ground practices and identify gaps * Act as a subject matter expert for the team’s data and processes, supporting continuous improvement Requirements: * Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, or related fields * Minimum 2–4 years of experience in operations, data analysis, or project management * Strong skills in GSheet/Excel and SQL * Experience in data cleaning, root cause analysis, and translating raw data into actionable insights * Strong project management skills: able to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously with tight timelines * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, both in Thai and English * Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work independently * Willingness to conduct occasional on-site visits to hubs or warehouses

jobs.descriptionHtml: At Pepperl+Fuchs, we combine a strong commitment to innovation with a deep respect for the traditions that have shaped our success. From renewable energy and automotive production to water treatment plants and chemical systems, our advanced electronic sensors and automation components enable smooth and safe operations around the globe. We take pride in fostering a supportive and collaborative workplace culture, where employees feel connected and valued - much like a close-knit family. As we continue to grow, we are excited to welcome a new team member for the following position: HR Manager **Role Purpose:** We are seeking a dynamic and people-focused HR Manager to lead and enhance our human resources strategy, ensuring a positive employee experience and strong organizational performance. This role will oversee the full employee lifecycle, support business leaders with effective people solutions, foster a high-performance culture, and ensure compliance with employment legislation and company policies. **Role Responsibilities:** * Develop and implement HR strategies, policies, and initiatives aligned with business objectives. * Manage the full employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, development, and offboarding. * Partner with managers to provide guidance on employee relations, disciplinary matters, grievances, and workplace concerns. * Lead talent acquisition activities to attract, assess, and retain high-quality employees. * Develop and coordinate learning, training, career development, and succession planning programs. * Oversee performance management processes and promote a culture of continuous feedback and improvement. * Ensure compliance with employment laws, regulations, company policies, and best HR practices. Analyze HR data and prepare reports to support workforce planning and informed business decisions. **Role Requirements:** * Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline. * Minimum 10 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 5 years in a managerial or leadership role. * Strong knowledge of employment legislation, HR policies, and people management practices. * Proven experience managing recruitment, employee relations, performance management, and HR operations. * Excellent communication, interpersonal, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills. * Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with employees, managers, and senior stakeholders. * Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. * High level of professionalism, integrity, confidentiality, commercial awareness, and proficiency in HR systems and Microsoft Office. Are you excited about this opportunity? We can’t wait to get to know you! Submit your application online — we’re looking forward to hearing from you! Pepperl+Fuchs actively promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion and is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity. We welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of ethnicity, country of origin, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, skin color, physical or mental abilities, social background, or any other protected characteristic. All employment decisions are made based on these principles and in full compliance with applicable federal and state laws.

jobs.title: Human Resource Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Tentang Perusahaan** Tentang Perusahaan RACC Migration and Education Services adalah perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang layanan migrasi dan pendidikan. Kami mencari seorang HR Specialist yang kompeten, analitis, teliti, dan berintegritas untuk memperkuat sistem pengelolaan sumber daya manusia, memastikan kepatuhan terhadap peraturan ketenagakerjaan yang berlaku di Indonesia, serta mengembangkan sistem manajemen kinerja yang efektif dan terukur. Kandidat terpilih akan berperan penting dalam memberikan rekomendasi HR kepada manajemen, mengelola hubungan karyawan, serta memastikan penerapan kebijakan dan prosedur perusahaan berjalan secara konsisten, adil, dan profesional. **Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan:** **1. Kepatuhan Hukum Ketenagakerjaan (Employment Law & Compliance)** * Meninjau dan memastikan kesesuaian kontrak kerja, surat penawaran kerja, kebijakan HR, serta dokumen ketenagakerjaan dengan peraturan yang berlaku di Indonesia. * Memberikan arahan terkait PKWT, PKWTT, masa percobaan, hak dan kewajiban karyawan, jam kerja, lembur, cuti, serta kompensasi. * Memberikan rekomendasi kepada manajemen terkait prosedur disipliner, pengunduran diri, dan pemutusan hubungan kerja. * Mengidentifikasi risiko ketenagakerjaan dan menyusun rekomendasi untuk meminimalkan risiko hukum maupun operasional. **2. Manajemen KPI dan Kinerja (Performance Management)** * Mengembangkan dan menerapkan sistem Key Performance Indicators (KPI) yang selaras dengan target perusahaan dan tanggung jawab masing-masing jabatan. * Menyusun indikator kinerja, target, metode penilaian, sistem pembobotan, dan periode evaluasi yang terukur. * Mengembangkan sistem penilaian kinerja yang sesuai untuk berbagai divisi dan posisi. * Membimbing manajer dalam melakukan evaluasi kinerja serta menangani karyawan dengan kinerja di bawah standar. * Menyusun Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) dan merekomendasikan tindak lanjut berdasarkan hasil evaluasi. **3. jobs.title: HR Generalist
jobs.descriptionHtml: ### **About the Role** BYD is seeking an experienced and hands-on **HR Generalist** to manage end-to-end Human Resources operations for our growing organization. This role plays a key part in establishing and maintaining operational excellence across HR functions, ensuring full compliance with Indonesian employment regulations, and supporting business scaling. The ideal candidate brings comprehensive, multi-disciplinary HR expertise—spanning talent acquisition, total rewards, labor relations, statutory compliance, and expatriate management—with the autonomy to drive daily operations with minimal supervision. ### **Key Responsibilities** * **Talent Acquisition & Development:** Lead end-to-end recruitment processes, manage smooth onboarding programs, and coordinate employee training and career development initiatives. * **Compensation, Benefits & Payroll:** Oversee monthly payroll processing, tax calculations (PPh 21), statutory benefits administration (BPJS Ketenagakerjaan & BPJS Kesehatan), and employee welfare schemes. * **Employee Relations & Manpower Compliance:** Oversee labor relations, handle employment contracts (PKWT/PKWTT), manage employee grievances, and ensure strict alignment with Indonesian labor laws and company regulations (PP/PKB). * **Expatriate Management:** Coordinate expatriate administration, including end-to-end processing of work permits (RPTKA, IMTA/Notifikasi), visas, ITAS/KITAS, and local residency compliance. * **Policies, SOPs & Documentation:** Maintain accurate employee database records, draft and update HR policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs), and safeguard confidential HR files. * **HR Reporting & Continuous Improvement:** Generate comprehensive HR metrics and operational reports, identifying continuous process improvements to support operational efficiency and business growth. ### **Qualifications & Requirements** * **Position:** HR Generalist * **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree in Psychology, Human Resource Management, Law, Business Administration, or related disciplines. * **Experience:** Minimum 5 years of proven, hands-on experience across full-spectrum HR operations; prior experience in manufacturing or large-scale multinational enterprises is highly preferred. * **Functional Expertise:** Strong mastery of end-to-end payroll computation, C&B structures, Indonesian manpower regulations (UU Ketenagakerjaan & UU Cipta Kerja), and grievance handling. * **Certifications:** Brevet A/B tax certification or formal training in Indonesian payroll/employment taxation is a plus. * **Language Skills:** + Fluent professional working proficiency in **English** (written and verbal). + Professional working proficiency in **Mandarin** is an advantage for cross-border alignment. * **Core Competencies:** Strong analytical thinking, solid cross-cultural communication, structured organizational skills, problem-solving mindset, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter

CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

jobs.title: Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) IT Support
jobs.company: SUXXEED Sales for your Success GmbH
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Das erwartet dich bei uns:

  • Du wirst zur ersten Anlaufstelle bei IT-Fragen: Im 1st- und 2nd-Level-Support unterstützt du unsere Kolleg:innen bei technischen Herausforderungen und findest pragmatische Lösungen, damit sie schnell wieder arbeitsfähig sind

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Arbeitsplätze funktionieren: Von der Einrichtung bis zur laufenden Betreuung kümmerst du dich um unsere Arbeitsplatzinstallationen sowie die dazugehörigen IT- und Netzwerkkomponenten

  • Du gehst Problemen auf den Grund: Technische Herausforderungen analysierst du strukturiert und selbstständig. Egal ob Microsoft-Umgebung, Hard- und Software oder LAN/WLAN, du suchst nicht nur nach dem Fehler, sondern nach einer guten und nachhaltigen Lösung

  • Du behältst unsere Technik im Blick: Du kümmerst dich um die Verwaltung und Wartung unserer Hardware und stellst sicher, dass unsere technischen Firmenwerte zuverlässig einsatzbereit bleiben

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung: Eigeninitiative ist bei uns ausdrücklich erwünscht. Du denkst mit, packst an und hilfst dabei, unseren IT-Support jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu machen

Mit diesem Profil überzeugst du:

  • Du hast eine solide IT-Basis: Du hast deine Ausbildung zum:r Fachinformatiker:in für Systemintegration erfolgreich abgeschlossen und bereits mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung im IT-Support beziehungsweise User-Helpdesk gesammelt

  • Microsoft is dein berufliches Zuhause: Im Microsoft-Ökosystem fühlst du dich sicher und bringst praktische Erfahrung im Client-/Server-Umfeld, mit Microsoft 365 sowie im Umgang mit AAD-/AD-Objekten mit

  • Netzwerke schrecken dich nicht ab: Du kannst Probleme in LAN- und WLAN-Umgebungen identifizieren und gehst technische Fragestellungen strukturiert und lösungsorientiert an

  • Service bedeutet für dich echte Unterstützung: Du kommunizierst verständlich, arbeitest zuverlässig und behältst auch bei wiederkehrenden Aufgaben deine Sorgfalt. Eine gute Dokumentation gehört für dich genauso dazu wie ein wertschätzender Umgang mit deinen Kolleg:innen

  • Du möchtest dich weiterentwickeln: Neue Technologien und wechselnde Anforderungen siehst du als Chance, dein Wissen kontinuierlich auszubauen. Gute Englischkenntnisse und sehr sichere Deutschkenntnisse bringst du ebenfalls mit

  • Du bist mobil: Da du bei Bedarf auch unsere weiteren Standorte unterstützt, besitzt du einen Führerschein der Klasse B und bist zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen bereit

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Für deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung: ein professionelles Onboarding sowie eine hausinterne Academy

  • Boni für deine gute Performance

  • Selbstverständlich einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag

  • Einen Zuschuss zum Jobticket sowie zusätzliche Rabatte über die Vodafone-Mitarbeitertarife und Benefit-Partnerportale

  • Ein individuelles Benefitsystem, welches nach Betriebszugehörigkeit bezuschusst wird

  • Bis zu 35 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Dein SUXXEED-Recruiting Team

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

We want you as a talented Lead Commercial Sales & Business Development professional to help us in our mission by driving commercial B2B success across our key technologies, Nyx, and future programmes, while supporting our Chief Commercial Officer in expanding our government business outside Europe.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as a Lead Commercial Sales & Business Development professional, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include B2B sales responsibilities:

  • Owning the sales pipeline for key technologies e.g. Additive Manufacturing, Thermal Protection, and Propulsion technologies offered through the "Space Store" as well as supporting the commercialization and expansion plan for European Astrotech (EAL) propulsion services.

  • Identifying, qualifying, and developing customers across satellite operators, launch providers, defense and prime contractors

  • Building technical and commercial proposals with our engineering teams and negotiating contract terms

  • Defining the Space Store go-to-market approach, including positioning, pricing, and sales enablement

  • Leading commercial sales for Nyx cargo and crew services, including commercial station (CLD) and payload opportunities.

  • Developing commercial strategies for future programs, including lunar and launcher offerings

  • Developing a qualified pipeline of future clients for future programs to support bid and fundraising efforts.

  • Managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting and bid preparation to contract signature and handover to programme teams

  • Supporting the Chief Commercial Officer in developing and executing the sales strategy for government customers outside Europe.

  • Supporting the European and USA Government teams where needed.

  • Preparing responses, capability presentations, and pitch materials

  • Representing the company at trade shows, conferences, and customer meetings

What we would love to see from you

In the role of Lead Commercial Sales & Business Development professional, ideally, you will have the following:

  • 8+ years of B2B sales or business development experience, ideally in aerospace, space, defence, or other high-technology industries

  • A proven track record of closing complex, high-value commercial B2B deals and technical sales, such as hardware, engineering services, or systems

  • Experience selling to government agencies or prime contractors, including international government markets

  • An understanding of technical products such as additive manufacturing, thermal protection, propulsion, or spacecraft systems, and the ability to translate them into customer value

  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and proposal-writing skills

  • Fluency in English; additional fluency in German, French, or Italian is a strong advantage, depending on your location

jobs.descriptionHtml:
🎤 WARUM voize? WEIL ES UM MEHR GEHT ALS EINEN JOB.

Bei voize glauben wir: Das Wertvollste, was wir Menschen in der Pflege geben können, ist Zeit. Zeit für Zuwendung, für Gespräche, fürs Dasein. Heute geht genau diese Zeit in Verwaltungsarbeit und komplexen Systemen verloren.

Das wollen wir ändern: mit KI-Begleitern, die digitale Abläufe im Hintergrund übernehmen. Wir ersetzen keine Menschen durch Technik, wir verstärken ihre Wirkung.

Hinter unserer Mission steht eine Series-A-Finanzierung über 50 Mio. US-Dollar unter Führung von Balderton Capital, gemeinsam mit HV Capital, Y Combinator und weiteren führenden VCs. Über 2.000 Einrichtungen vertrauen heute auf voize, mehr als 200.000 Nutzer:innen entlastet unser KI-Begleiter im Alltag.

Wir verbinden erstklassige Technologie mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Nutzen. Und jetzt suchen wir dich.

💡 DEINE MISSION

voize arbeitet direkt mit der Pflegesoftware unserer Kunden zusammen. Im ambulanten Dienst dokumentieren Pflegekräfte unterwegs, zwischen zwei Einsätzen und oft unter Zeitdruck. Wie gut voize dort trägt, hängt davon ab, wie Vivendi oder MediFox DAN beim Pflegedienst eingerichtet sind. Genau da setzt du an.

Du kennst mindestens eines der beiden Systeme aus der Praxis eines ambulanten Pflegedienstes oder eines Trägers. Als Care Expert berätst du unsere Kunden, wie ihre Konfiguration aussehen muss, damit Pflegeteams auf Tour mit voize wirklich Zeit zurückgewinnen. Du arbeitest beratend auf Augenhöhe mit QM, Pflegedienstleitung, Einsatzplanung und Anwendungsbetreuung. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich darin, dass Einführungen ohne Reibung laufen und Teams voize nach dem Go-live gern nutzen.

🚀 DEIN ALLTAG

  • Konfiguration prüfen, bevor es zählt: Vor Schulung und Go-live führst du mit QM und Anwendungsbetreuung unsere Dokuchecks durch. Ihr prüft gemeinsam, ob Vivendi bzw. MediFox DAN ambulant zu voize passt, von Klienten- und Leistungsstammdaten über Leistungskomplexe und Einsatzplanung bis zur mobilen Dokumentation.

  • Beraten statt nur prüfen: Wo etwas nicht passt, zeigst du konkrete Lösungen im System. Du bringst Ideen ein, wie Abläufe auf Tour und im Büro des Pflegedienstes einfacher werden.

  • Zwischen Pflege und System übersetzen: Pflegefachliche und vertragliche Anforderungen wie SIS ambulant, Leistungskomplexe nach SGB XI, Behandlungspflege nach SGB V oder Leistungsnachweise machst du in der Konfiguration greifbar, und umgekehrt.

  • Sauber einordnen: Läuft etwas nicht wie erwartet, findest du heraus, ob es an der Einrichtung im System, am Prozess beim Kunden oder am Produkt liegt. Deine Einschätzung geht klar an Customer Success, Support und Product.

  • Kunden begleiten: Remote und bei Bedarf vor Ort begleitest du Einführungen über den Go-live hinaus, eng abgestimmt mit dem zuständigen Customer Success Manager.

  • Wissen aufbauen, das skaliert: Gemeinsam mit dem Team entwickelst du Playbooks, Checklisten, Help-Center-Artikel und interne Enablements für Vivendi und MediFox weiter.

🤝 DEIN PROFIL

  • Du hast mehrere Jahre intensiv mit Vivendi oder MediFox DAN ambulant gearbeitet, etwa als Anwendungsbetreuer:in, Key User, QM-Beauftragte:r, Pflegedienstleitung oder in der Einsatzplanung eines amb...

jobs.title: First Legal Counsel (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why voize? Because we’re more than just a job!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

Your Mission

As our first Legal Counsel you own voize's legal function and report directly to the COO. You make legal fast and scalable across commercial, employment and corporate law, so Sales, People and Finance can move quickly while we protect what matters as we grow into new markets.

For this role, you need to be strategic and hands-on at the same time. You set the standards for our legal function and become a trusted partner to our management team but yet work closely with the teams on their day-to-day challenges. If you love getting your hands dirty, building from scratch, and having wide impact across the entire organization, this job is for you.

Your Daily Business - No two days are alike

  • Build voize’s legal function from scratch and set the standard for a fast moving and modern approach to risk management

  • Build playbooks, automations approval rules and self-serve flows, such as NDAs, so the team can move fast without waiting for legal

  • Draft, negotiate and approve customer and partner contracts across Germany, Europe, and the US

  • Advise on employment law, from contracts and policies to terminations and settlements, across our markets

  • Lead the legal side of financing rounds, equity plans, new entities and board matters

  • Manage external counsel and budgets, and bring recurring work in-house

Your Skillset - What you bring to the table

  • A law degree with German-law competence (Volljurist) or an international equivalent

  • 7+ years in tech or SaaS commercial law, at least 2 of them in-house

  • Hands-on experience negotiating liability, IP and termination terms with international customers, plus working knowledge of German employment and US corporate law

  • A pragmatic, commercial mindset: you decide fast, give clear recommendations and are comfortable managing risk instead of avoiding it

  • Excitement for AI legal tools and for building scalable processes rather than acting as a gatekeeper

  • Fluent German and English and a short, clear communication style

  • Exposure to US, UK or French law is a plus

Growing together - what you can expect at voize

jobs.title: Account Executive, Public Sector, DACH
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary:

As our Enterprise Sales Executive, you will be instrumental in shaping Mistral’s adoption with our largest customers across the Public Sector. You will be driving deals end2end: from prospective, first intro call until closing and beyond — together with our dedicated implementation specialist, tech and legal teams.

What you will do:

Lead development (strategic outbound and qualified inbound):

- Handle strategic outreach as well as warm introductions to promising enterprise customers

- Converting inbound deals where upselling / more bespoke agreements can be achieved

Value prop validation for customer:

- Provide hands-on support and guidance to clients during a potential Proof of Concept (POC) phase, ensuring a smooth and successful evaluation process

- Leverage successful POC outcomes to facilitate the conversion of POCs into long-term, revenue-generating contracts

Deal management & closing:

- Develop and execute strategic sales plans to convert leads into valued customers — you are the first point of contact for all external stakeholders and are responsible for properly managing deals and aligning all stakeholders (heavy involvement of customer engineering, product, and commercial teams, both on operational and C-level)

- Handle customer negotiation end2end, together with our legal and implementation specialist team

Executive Engagement:

- Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives, heads of innovation/AI, and other key decision-makers within target Public Sector organisations

- Comprehend their specific challenges and needs, positioning our solution as an integral part of their strategic initiatives

Technical Aptitude:

- Demonstrate a deep understanding of the technical intricacies of our product and articulate its value proposition effectively to potential clients

- Work side-by-side with our implementation team to ensure that customer’s questions, concerns and challenges are taken care of during pre-sales, deployment and post-deployment phase

- Collaborate with our technical team to address any customer inquiries or concerns

Training and enablement:

-Empower internal teams with the knowledge and resources that you collect in customer conversations to drive product roadmap and align on priorities

jobs.title: GTM Engineer - Sales Automation and Analytics Management
jobs.descriptionHtml:
As a GTM Engineer - Sales Automation and Analytics Management (m/w/d), you will make our sales engine more productive across all PERGOLUX markets globally: more revenue per worked sales hour, less leakage between lead and order, and a lower cost per sale. Reporting to the Head of Sales Operations, you will own two pillars of work, insight and planning on one side, orchestration and automation on the other, partnering daily with Sales Leads in every market, the Data team, Marketing, Customer Service and our Tier 1 partner. This is a builder-operator role: the Data team owns the data foundation, and you use it to find what is holding sales back, then fix it with a mix of planning, incentives, process automation and AI.

PERGOLUX designs and sells premium, Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from aluminium pergolas to awnings and garden furniture, directly to consumers. We are a company that has grown consistently across Europe and beyond, with around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue and operations across eight markets.

What You'll Do

- Analyse the full funnel (lead, contact, qualification, draft order, order) by market, tier, channel and rep, mine call, chat and CRM activity for conversion patterns, and run a monthly insight cycle of three to five prioritised findings, each with an owner, an action and a measured result.

- Own the global capacity model for Tier 1, Tier 2, showroom and Customer Service fallback coverage, run the monthly refresh and seasonal peak plan, and flag hiring, reallocation or BPO volume changes early while tracking planned versus actual coverage with Sales Leads and Finance.

- Run the monthly and quarterly bonus calculations for Sales Leads, Tier 2 reps and the Tier 1 partner payout, test and model each scheme before changes go live, and automate the calculation and reporting so payouts need checks rather than manual builds.

- Own revenue per worked hour as the core productivity KPI, from definition and baseline to targets and monthly reporting by market and tier, and lead initiatives that move its drivers of productive time, conversion and order value.

- Orchestrate sales activity through task queues, lead prioritisation, follow-up cadences and reactivation, map and automate our sales processes in HubSpot (with Aircall, Shopify and messaging integrations), and run AI pilots across the funnel with clear success metrics and a running business case per use case.

What You'll Bring

- Proven experience in sales operations, revenue operations or GTM engineering, turning sales, call and order data into decisions and measurable KPI movement.

- Strong analytical skills across the full funnel, with the ability to write clear requirements for a data team and validate what they ship.

- Hands-on experience building HubSpot workflows and integrations with tools such as Aircall, Shopify and messaging platforms, within agreed data governance.

- A builder-operator mindset: you design capacity models, incentive schemes and process automation, then operate and iterate on them rather than only reporting.

- Practical experience deploying AI use cases across a sales funnel (speed-to-lead, qualification, summaries, next-best-action, follow-up drafting) is a strong plus.

💼 Compensation — Attractive, competitive salary · Company pension plan · Capped overtime, fully paid, with no endless unpaid crunch · 20% commission on base salary plus a maximum 30% additional bonus for exceeding targets

- Own Aircall configuration (numbers, IVRs, routing, ring groups, overflow per market) and the Aircall–HubSpot integration, so every call, recording, outcome and AI summary lands on the right record, and support call pick-up SLAs and Conversation Intelligence for coaching and quality programmes.

jobs.title: (Senior) Performance Marketing Manager (all genders)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Holidu is one of the world’s fastest-growing holiday rental technology companies. Our mission is to make booking and hosting holiday homes free of doubt and full of joy, by helping hosts generate more bookings with less work and helping guests find a holiday home they truly enjoy. Our team of 700 colleagues from 60+ nations shares a passion for tech, an ambition for constant improvement, and a relentless drive to bring the best experience to more than 40k holiday rental hosts and 4 million annual guests.

Your future team

You will be part of the Paid Search team, the growth engine of Holidu's Performance Marketing: we run Google Ads and Microsoft Ads across all Holidu domains and brands in Europe, on both sides of the marketplace - Guest (B2C, bookings) and Host (B2B, lead generation). We are a small, international and highly analytical team: value-based bidding at scale, our own bidding infrastructure, and data-driven in every decision. We work AI-first, and we are early: as marketers, we build our own analyses, automations and internal apps with LLM tooling (mainly Claude), together with our MarTech team. The team is led by Andreas, who has two decades of experience in digital marketing, and you will work closely with Rasmus, one of Holidu's Co-Founders.

What you will do

This role suits a proactive builder: strong numerical mindset, comfortable creating structure where none exists yet, at home in both strategy and hands-on execution.

  • Own large-scale Search Engine Advertising across multiple European markets (Google Ads and Microsoft Ads), from account structure to value-based bidding that grows efficiently

  • Challenge how we do paid search today: question our bidding logic, structures and processes, and bring perspectives we have not considered. With us, arguments and data weigh more than job titles

  • Co-build internal marketing apps with Claude Code and GitHub, as a marketer, not an engineer. We are first movers here: you will learn a skill almost nobody in the market has yet, and you will shape our tooling together with our MarTech team

  • Own your numbers end-to-end: find the improvement potential others walk past, run high-impact A/B tests across large budgets, decide with data, and turn results into playbooks instead of one-off learnings

  • Pilot what is next in paid search: AI Max, the first generation of LLM advertising (OpenAI/ChatGPT Ads), and AI-powered workflows from anomaly detection to statistical analysis

What you bring

  • A sharp, quantitative mindset and strong analytical thinking: you make decisions with data, spot what others miss, and can argue your case clearly

  • Ownership of business results: you think in outcomes, not processes, and build solutions rather than wait for instructions

  • Hands-on experience in paid search (Google Ads; Microsoft Ads as a plus): trajectory and depth of thinking matter more to us than years

  • Genuine curiosity about AI in marketing: you’ve already used AI tools to change how you work, not just to draft texts, and want to go deeper. No engineering background needed, curiosity is the requirement

  • Fluent English (our working language); any additional language is a plus

What we offer

  • Impact: Make a difference for hundreds of thousands of monthly users.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (m/f/x)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager to own the relationship with the customers connected to our out‑of‑home (OOH) delivery platform.

You will be the first contact for our customers. You know their numbers, and when a customer is stuck, you are the one who gets things moving inside GLS/NXT. You work at the intersection of product, engineering, data and commercial, and you are measured on customer outcomes rather than on activity.

This role is perfect for someone who likes owning results across organisational boundaries, is comfortable with data, and can hold their own with a customer's operations director in the morning and our engineering leads in the afternoon.

What you will do

  • Own customer relationships: Act as the main contact for connected customers across markets, from onboarding through to steady‑state growth

  • Drive customer performance: Own adoption and performance KPIs per customer, such as platform utilisation and integration health, and deliver measurable improvement Resolve blockers: Spot what is holding customers back and bring in the right GLS/NXT teams to solve it

  • Shape the roadmap: Turn customer requirements into prioritised roadmap input, and separate market‑specific requests from true platform needs

  • Generate insights: Use platform and operational data (Looker, BigQuery, Mixpanel) to produce insights that customers act on, and share best practices across customers and markets

  • Run a structured engagement rhythm: Lead monthly reviews and quarterly deep‑dives per customer and track the actions that come out of them

  • Build growth cases: Identify growth opportunities per market and build the business case for them

What you bring

  • Multiple years of experience in customer success, account or partner management in a B2B platform, SaaS or logistics‑tech environment

  • A track record of moving KPIs, not just maintaining relationships

  • Hands‑on with data: comfortable in Looker, Mixpanel or SQL/BigQuery, and able to turn numbers into a clear story

  • Experience with technical products and integrations, and credibility with engineers and product managers

  • Strong structuring and communication skills for business reviews, management reports and action follow‑up

  • The ability to influence teams you do not manage, across functions and countries in Fluent English, both written and spoken

Nice to have

  • German language skills

  • Experience in logistics, parcel delivery or out‑of‑home delivery

  • Familiarity with APIs or platform integrations

What we at GLS/NXT offer

  • Dynamic workplace: A digital environment with international projects and space to learn and grow.

  • Flexible work environment: Hybrid working mode with a tailored remote policy. Professional growth: A personal budget of €1,000 for learning and development initiatives. Modern workspace: Great office space in Berlin Mitte with top‑tier equipment.

  • Competitive compensation: A transparent salary package that reflects your expertise and experience.

  • Bonus system: A clear bonus model that lets you share in your own and the team's performance.

  • Engaging team culture: Monthly team cooking, regular events and offsites. Vacation: 30 days of holiday per year.

  • Referral rewards: Rewards for recommending new team members.

Even if you do not meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply if you believe you are well‑suited for the role and can contribute meaningfully ...

  • Begleitung von Produkteinführungen, Vertriebsaktionen und kommerziellen Initiativen im Händlernetzwerk.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schnittstellen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Vertriebsprozessen, Kundenzufriedenheit und Verkaufsleistung.

  • Förderung und Weiterentwicklung der Vertriebskompetenzen im Händlernetzwerk durch nachhaltige Trainings- und Entwicklungsprogramme.

Ihr Profil

  • Mehrjährige Verkaufserfahrung in einem Autohaus oder einer vergleichbaren automobilen Handelsorganisation.

  • Erfahrung im Bereich Training, Coaching, Personalentwicklung, Vertrieb oder Händlerentwicklung ist von Vorteil.

  • Ausgeprägte Präsentations-, Kommunikations- und Coachingfähigkeiten.

  • Selbstständige Arbeitsweise sowie Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Dienstreisen innerhalb Deutschlands.

  • Begeisterung für Motorräder und Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse von Motorradkunden und -händlern.

  • Erfahrung in der Motorradbranche ist von Vorteil, jedoch keine Voraussetzung.

  • Motorradführerschein Klasse A ist wünschenswert.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sowie fließende Spanischkenntnisse sind erforderlich. Die Rolle beinhaltet eine regelmäßige Teilnahme an Trainingsprogrammen und fachlichen Austauschformaten in Spanien.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
„Es liegt nur eine Zukunft vor uns, und zwar die, die aus unseren Träumen besteht – sofern wir den Mut haben, mit Konventionen zu brechen.“ - Soichiro Honda

Unsere Philosophie beruht auf Gleichberechtigung, Respekt und der Initiative kreative Ideen umzusetzen. Die Freude, die wir am Schaffen und Verkaufen unserer Produkte haben, möchten wir über unsere Finanzierungslösungen für Neuwagen und Motorräder an unsere Kunden weitergeben. Dies gelingt uns durch den direkten und unkomplizierten Weg über die Vertragshändler, sowie durch unsere starken Kooperationspartner.

Wir sind als 100%ige Tochter des Honda Konzerns seit 1998 in Deutschland tätig und haben seit 2007 eine Filiale in Barcelona, Spanien. Weiterhin betreiben wir das Finanzdienstleistungsgeschäft mit kooperierenden Partnerbanken in 15 europäischen Ländern.

Wenn Sie unser Bankgeschäft kennenlernen und mitgestalten möchten, dann werden Sie Teil unseres Teams am Standort Frankfurt am Main.

Aufgaben

  • Analyse und Bewertung von Kreditrisiken im Wholesale-Geschäft

  • Durchführung von Finanzanalysen sowie Erstellung von Ratings und Kreditanträgen

  • Überwachung und Steuerung bestehender Finanzierungen, Limits und Sicherheiten

  • Betreuung des Händlernetzes im Rahmen von Kreditvergabe, Verlängerungen und Problemkreditmanagement

  • Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise im Bankenumfeld, oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Kenntnisse in Kreditrisikomanagement und Bilanzanalyse

  • Sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse

  • Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Analytische Denkweise sowie strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise

Benefits

  • Teilweise Home-Office möglich

  • Kostenfreier Parkplatz

  • Mitarbeiterleasing für PKW und Zweirad

DIE ZUKUNFT PLANEN MIT VERTICAS

Zur weiteren Unterstützung unseres Teams suchen wir Dich in Teilzeit (30 Stunden) oder Vollzeit als:

Kaufmännischer Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt Buchhaltung

  • Du kümmerst Dich um die Kreditoren- und Debitorenbuchhaltung sowie die Pflege und Abstimmung offener Posten.

jobs.title: CRO Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über diese Rolle

Du liebst es, den Engpass im Funnel zu finden und $100 Million Offers zu bauen?

Als CRO Manager (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Performance unseres Onlineshops vom ersten Klick auf die Ad bis zum letzten Upsell. Du analysierst den Funnel von A bis Z, findest den Engpass und löst ihn mit besseren Offers, Funnels und Tests.

Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes E-Commerce Scale Up mit Sitz in der Speicherstadt Hamburg. Unsere Mission ist es, Kinder mit innovativen Produkten für das lebenslange Lernen zu begeistern und das Leben von Millionen Familien liebevoller und bunter zu gestalten.

Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte aktiv die Zukunft eines dynamischen Unternehmens mit!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Offer Building: Du entwickelst Offers, Bundles und Angebotsmechaniken auf Basis von Consumer Psychology, die Conversion Rate und AOV steigern.

  • Funnel Building: Du konzipierst Listicles, Advertorials, Quiz-Funnels, VSLs und Produktseiten, die verkaufen.

  • Funnel-Analyse: Du analysierst den Funnel von Creative über Landingpage und Checkout bis zum Upsell, identifizierst den Engpass und entwickelst die Lösung.

  • A/B-Testing: Du baust eine Testing-Roadmap auf, setzt Tests technisch um und wertest sie statistisch sauber aus.

  • Upsells & Tracking: Du baust Upsell-Strecken im Checkout und nach dem Kauf auf und stellst sicher, dass sauberes Tracking jede Entscheidung absichert.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in CRO oder Funnel Building bei einer D2C E-Commerce Brand.

  • Du weißt genau, was ein gutes Offer ausmacht. Bundling und Offer Stacking setzt du sicher ein.

  • Du hast Listicles, Advertorials, Quiz-Funnels oder VSLs selbst gebaut und optimiert.

  • Du beherrschst A/B-Testing technisch und statistisch.

  • Du bist sicher im Shopify-Ökosystem und in Tracking-Tools wie Triple Whale, GA4 oder Clarity.

  • Du arbeitest hypothesengetrieben und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von harten Daten statt Bauchgefühl.

Deine Vorteile

  • Attraktive Vergütung & echte Aufstiegschancen – Leistung wird gesehen und außergewöhnlicher Einsatz auch außergewöhnlich belohnt.

  • Karriere ohne Politik & Hierarchien – Kein langes Warten auf Beförderungen – wenn du wächst, wächst die Verantwortung mit dir.

  • Flexibles Arbeiten, das zu dir passt – Remote, hybrid oder im Office – du entscheidest.

  • Teamreisen & coole Offsites – Team-Events, Workations & eine Kultur, in der Leistung und Spaß zusammenpassen.

  • Modernste Ausstattung – MacBook, höhenverstellbarer Schreibtisch & alles, was du für Höchstleistung brauchst.

  • Modernes Office in der Speicherstadt Hamburg – Ein inspirierender Arbeitsplatz mit Blick auf die Elbphilharmonie im Herzen der Stadt.

jobs.title: Head of Finance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über diese Rolle

Du willst nicht nur Zahlen berichten, sondern mitentscheiden, wie ein Unternehmen wächst?

Als Head of Finance (m/w/d) sorgst du dafür, dass wir jederzeit wissen, wo wir finanziell stehen: wie viel Liquidität wir haben, mit welchen Produkten und Kanälen wir Geld verdienen und wie viel wir in Marketing, Ware und neue Märkte investieren können. Du lieferst die Zahlen, auf deren Basis wir entscheiden, und sorgst dafür, dass unser Wachstum solide finanziert ist.

Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes E-Commerce Scale Up mit Sitz in der Speicherstadt Hamburg. Unsere Mission ist es, Kinder mit innovativen Produkten für das lebenslange Lernen zu begeistern und das Leben von Millionen Familien liebevoller und bunter zu gestalten.

Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte aktiv die Zukunft eines dynamischen Unternehmens mit!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Liquidität & Cashflow: Du verantwortest unsere rollierende Liquiditätsplanung, damit wir jederzeit wissen, wie viel Geld für Marketing, Wareneinkauf und Saisonspitzen zur Verfügung steht.

  • P&L & Controlling: Du pflegst unsere monatliche P&L auf und zeigst mit dem Deckungsbeitrag von DB1 bis DB4, mit welchen Produkten und Kanälen wir Geld verdienen.

  • Abschluss & Finanzierung: Du verantwortest Bilanz und Jahresabschluss gemeinsam mit dem Steuerberater und führst die Gespräche mit Banken und Finanzierungspartnern.

  • Automatisierung: Du automatisierst unsere Finance-Prozesse, damit die Zahlen schnell und verlässlich vorliegen.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in Finance oder Controlling, idealerweise davon mehrere Jahre in einer 8-stelligen D2C E-Commerce Brand.

  • Du verstehst die Dynamiken im E-Commerce: Ad Spend, Saisonalität, Wareneinkauf in Asien sowie Payouts von Shopify und Amazon.

  • Du baust komplexe Finanzmodelle selbst in Google Sheets oder Excel.

  • Du arbeitest hypothesengetrieben und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von harten Daten statt Bauchgefühl.

Deine Vorteile

  • Attraktive Vergütung & echte Aufstiegschancen – Leistung wird gesehen und außergewöhnlicher Einsatz auch außergewöhnlich belohnt.

  • Karriere ohne Politik & Hierarchien – Kein langes Warten auf Beförderungen – wenn du wächst, wächst die Verantwortung mit dir.

jobs.title: Haustechniker (m/w/d)
jobs.company: NEXT DOOR HV GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Ihre Aufgaben

Bei NEXT DOOR HV GmbH & Co. KG erwarten Sie in Frechen abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben rund um die Instandhaltung und Betreuung unserer digitalisierten Fitnessstudios. Sie übernehmen eigenverantwortlich die regelmäßige Wartung, Inspektion und Instandsetzung der technischen Anlagen sowie der Fitnessgeräte. Kleinere Reparaturen im handwerklichen Bereich führen Sie selbstständig aus und koordinieren bei Bedarf externe Dienstleister. Zudem sorgen Sie dafür, dass alle gebäudetechnischen Systeme reibungslos funktionieren und unsere Standards eingehalten werden.

Das bringen Sie mit

Sie haben eine abgeschlossene handwerkliche oder technische Ausbildung, idealerweise im Bereich der Gebäude-, Versorgungs- oder Sicherheitstechnik. Fundierte Berufserfahrung in der Instandhaltung und ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis zeichnen Sie aus. Sie arbeiten lösungsorientiert, packen gerne selbst an und bringen einen Führerschein für Ihre Einsätze mit. Wenn Sie zudem flexibel sind und die Arbeit in einem wachsenden Umfeld schätzen, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung – auch wenn Sie nicht jede Anforderung zu hundert Prozent erfüllen.

Das erwartet Sie

  • Kostenloses Fitnessabo für das Training in unseren Studios.

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge für Ihre Zukunft.

  • Entschädigung für Reisekosten sowie Vorteile bei öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln für Ihren Arbeitsweg.

  • Bezahlte Krankheitstage und zusätzliche Urlaubstage neben Ihren 25 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr.

  • Elternzeitregelungen, ein Firmenhandy sowie kostenlose Getränke und kostenloses Parken vor Ort.

  • Regelmäßige Teamevents und Firmenfeiern zur Stärkung des Miteinanders.

Vergütung

Für diese Position gilt ein monatliches Gehalt im Rahmen von EUR 2,800–3,200.

Ihre ersten Monate bei NEXT DOOR HV GmbH & Co. KG

In den ersten Monaten machen Sie sich mit unseren digitalisierten Studios und den spezifischen technischen Anlagen in Frechen vertraut. Sie übernehmen schrittweise die eigenständige Instandhaltung und lernen das Team sowie die Abläufe im laufenden Betrieb kennen. So sind Sie schnell ein fester Ansprechpartner für alle technischen Fragen vor Ort.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Die hairfree GmbH ist Marktführer für dauerhafte Haarentfernung¹ in der DACH-Region. Mit über 70 Standorten in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz sowie mehr als 100 Mitarbeitenden gehören wir zu den führenden Anbietern im Bereich ästhetischer Dienstleistungen.

Seit über 20 Jahren verbinden wir professionelle Beratung, innovative Behandlungskonzepte und echte Leidenschaft für Beauty. Unser Ziel ist es, Menschen zu einem neuen Hautgefühl zu verhelfen, sicher, individuell und mit höchstem Qualitätsanspruch.

Bei hairfree erwarten dich klare Strukturen, moderne Prozesse, ein starkes Team und echte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Deine Rolle

Du begeisterst Menschen, hast Freude am Verkauf und möchtest gemeinsam mit deinem Team einen Standort voranbringen? Dann komm zu hairfree in München-Schwabing.

In unserer Lounge verbindest du persönliche Kundenberatung mit aktivem Vertrieb und Teamführung. Du hörst aufmerksam zu, erkennst individuelle Wünsche und überzeugst Interessierte von der passenden Behandlungslösung. Dabei begleitest du sie vom ersten Gespräch bis zum Vertragsabschluss.

Gleichzeitig übernimmst du Verantwortung für die Entwicklung deiner Lounge. Du setzt Prioritäten, unterstützt dein Team und sorgst dafür, dass gute Beratung, zufriedene Kunden und gemeinsame Vertriebsziele zusammenkommen.

Dein Vorteil im Vertrieb: Du arbeitest mit vorqualifizierten Anfragen von Menschen, die bereits Interesse an dauerhafter Haarentfernung¹ haben. So kannst du direkt an ihren Bedürfnissen anknüpfen und dich auf persönliche Beratung und erfolgreiche Abschlüsse konzentrieren.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Festgehalt plus ungedeckelte Provisionen: Du erhältst ein verlässliches Grundgehalt und verdienst an deinem Verkaufserfolg mit.

  • Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst deinen Standort gemeinsam mit deinem Team weiter.

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Du lernst unsere Leistungen, Beratungsabläufe und Systeme Schritt für Schritt kennen.

  • Regelmäßige Vertriebscoachings: Unsere Academy und interne Trainings stärken dich in Beratung, Verkauf und Führung.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Du baust deine Fähigkeiten aus und kannst bei entsprechender Eignung weitere Verantwortung übernehmen.

  • Abgestimmte Arbeitszeiten: Wir planen deine Einsätze gemeinsam und passend zu den Kundenterminen.

  • Unterstützung im Alltag: Du arbeitest eng mit der Vertriebsleitung zusammen und tauschst dich mit anderen Standorten aus.

  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung und gute technische Ausstattung.

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte, Vergünstigungen und gemeinsame Events.

  • Gute Erreichbarkeit und Parkmöglichkeiten.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Kunden beraten und gewinnen: Du führst persönliche Beratungsgespräche, erkennst Bedürfnisse und empfiehlst die passende Behandlung.

jobs.title: Senior Penetration Tester API, Web & Cloud – 6 Months Contract (all genders)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Penetration Tester to join us on a 6-month contract, and start as soon as possible. You will run hands-on, authenticated security testing across a real attack surface: public partner-facing booking APIs, payment flows, web and mobile apps used by millions of travellers, and the cloud infrastructure behind them. You’ll plan and run your own testing, work directly with our engineering squads to get findings fixed, and see your impact in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Test our partner-facing booking APIs against the OWASP API Security Top 10, with a focus on object- and function-level authorization, tenant isolation, mass assignment, data exposure and rate limiting.

  • Assess API authentication and integrity end to end, including OAuth 2.0/OIDC, API keys, JWTs, webhooks and request signing.

  • Hunt for business-logic abuse in booking, checkout, payment and refund flows, including race conditions and pricing manipulation.

  • Run authenticated tests of traveller-, partner- and operator-facing web and mobile apps following OWASP WSTG and ASVS, including how passenger personal data is stored, shown and exported.

  • Review cloud, Kubernetes and CI/CD configurations and secrets handling for attack paths that could be chained from an application bug.

  • Map and regularly test our internet-facing attack surface.

  • Red-team our AI features (assistants, agents, support bots) against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

  • Write clear, reproducible, risk-rated findings with practical remediation guidance, walk engineers through fixes and verify them with retests.

Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.



Who you are:

  • You bring 5+ years of hands-on penetration testing, mainly of web applications and APIs, and can point to recent engagements you’ve led end to end.

  • You have deep, practical knowledge of the OWASP API Security Top 10, WSTG and ASVS, including authentication/authorization models (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT), IDOR/BOLA, mass assignment, SSRF, injection and XSS.

  • You have found business-logic and race-condition vulnerabilities in transactional systems such as booking, e-commerce, payments or fintech.

  • You are fluent with Burp Suite Pro (or similar) and write your own scripts and tooling (Python, Go or similar).

  • You are comfortable assessing cloud and container environments (GCP preferred, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines.

  • You work independently: you scope, prioritise, test and report with minimal guidance, and you explain complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

  • You are available to start at short notice.

  • Bonus Points: OSCP, OSWE, BSCP or similar certifications; experience re...

jobs.title: Founders Associate Intern: AI Product Consultant (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are building the AI platform for procurement.

Procurement manages the largest cost in enterprises. With tools from the past, trying to find savings in scattered data systems. Increasing cost pressure puts CPOs on the spot to change this.

Our integrated AI agents autonomously run negotiations, ensure contracted savings actually reach the bottom line, and add intelligence to boring, manual tasks.

We don’t shy away from tapping into complex data and add intelligence that changes the economics of procurement, moving far beyond simple agentic workflows.

We are funded by top tier VCs (10x and Plug and Play) and business angels, and our founders have strategy consulting and high growth startup experience.

We are three friends that have known each other for years. We have fun while moving quickly, and care about real outcomes.

Tasks

You're a Swiss Army knife: technically fluent and brilliant with customers, energized switching between topics five times a day. One hour you're across the table from a CPO making our AI click; the next you're in the product, debugging why an agent didn't deliver and shaping the fix.

You want to turn an "interesting AI demo" into a signed enterprise contract with proven value, and you refuse to let great ideas die in translation between customers and techies. This is a Founders Associate role in the truest sense: you work shoulder-to-shoulder with the founders, responsible for Customers and Product, with a front-row seat to how an enterprise AI company actually gets built, and real ownership of product and customer relationships from day one. You'll learn directly from founders who've built and scaled before.

You sit at the intersection of product, sales, and the customer, working directly with the founders. Concretely:

  • Build demos that make CPOs lean forward. You craft sharp, tailored demos that turn our agents' capabilities into an obvious "we need this," built around the prospect's real data and real pain, not a generic walkthrough.
  • Drive Proof of Values to success. You support the POV from kickoff to outcome: define what "success" means up front, keep the customer engaged, debug what isn't working, and land a business case the customer can defend internally.
