You’ll forge deep, strategic relationships with influential customers and key ecosystem partners, driving collaboration and uncovering emerging trends that will guide KIOXIA’s product roadmap. Your technical insights will be essential in analyzing shifts in technology and the broader ecosystem, directly influencing next-generation strategies. Beyond that, our Sr. Principal be the bridge between cutting-edge developments and our internal teams, educating them on new trends and technologies while representing KIOXIA as a thought leader at high-profile industry events

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain deep technical relationships with key customers and partners, driving mutual value through collaboration.
  • Analyze industry trends and emerging technologies, identifying those likely to impact future product needs.
  • Act as a technical advisor and resource within KIOXIA, educating internal teams on advancements and helping shape technology strategy.
  • Represent KIOXIA at key industry events, contributing to the company’s visibility and leadership in the storage ecosystem.
  • Engage in open source communities, collaborating on storage-related projects and influencing the development process.
  • Participate in the evaluation of potential technology partnerships or acquisitions, providing technical insights for due diligence.
  • BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field; advanced degrees are a plus.
  • 12+ years of experience developing Data Center Infrastructure class Linux software or Enterprise-class storage solutions.
  • At least 10 years of experience in architecting filesystems, block device layer drivers, or data management functionality for storage systems.
  • Strong background in evaluating new technologies for partnerships or acquisitions, including market evaluation and technical due diligence (5+ years of experience).
  • Familiarity with the open-source industry, including active participation in community development processes.
  • Knowledge of AI workflows, including data access patterns and infrastructure requirements.
  • Extensive knowledge of how storage systems interface with software applications.
  • Strong technical leadership and mentoring abilities, with a track record of guiding teams through complex challenges.
  • Excellent verbal communication and strong written skills, able to convey complex technical concepts clearly.
  • Travel roughly 25% both domestic and international

Preferred:

  • Prior experience as a member of a CTO staff or in a similar high-level technical advisory role.

Req#2279;

The expected salary for this position is $225,370.00 - 375,620.00.

At KIOXIA, we value the following:

  • Investment in you

  • Open-minded management
    • Empowering employees by listening and responding to ideas, issues, and approaches
  • Flexible work-life balance
    • Offering a generous PTO allotment, holiday shutdown, and flexible work options
  • Variety of cultures, perspectives, backgrounds and experiences of all our team members
    • Through our opportunity, belonging and respect initiatives, our focus is to strengthen our company culture to create an environment of belonging for all
  • Benefits for our team members
    • Excellent medical and non-medical benefits, 401(k) matching, pet insurance

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Zenzero
Zenzero is one of the UK's fastest-growing technology companies. Named a Top 8 Technology Company at the British Business Awards 2026, recognised by Deloitte as a Best Managed Company, and featured in the Sunday Times Hundred (an annual ranking of the UK's fastest-growing private companies) in both 2025 and 2026, we hold Microsoft Solutions Partner status across all six designations, putting us in the top tier of UK Microsoft partners. The accolades reflect something real: a business that is scaling fast, executing well, and building something that lasts.

We're on a mission to make technology genuinely work for mid-market businesses, covering managed IT, cyber security, cloud, and AI solutions that actually move the needle. The demand is growing, and so are we.

We're also a certified B Corp and Scale Up Award winner. That combination matters to us: high growth and high standards aren't in conflict here. Fast growth, high standards, real impact. If that sounds like your kind of place, keep reading.

About the Role
We are looking for a technically proficient and commercially aware Presales Architect to join our growing Presales team. This role is central to helping customers solve complex business and technology challenges through well-designed, practical solutions.

Working closely with Account Managers, the Head of Presales, and delivery teams, you will act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the sales cycle. You will shape solution designs, create compelling technical proposals, and provide accurate delivery estimates that enable customers to make informed decisions.

Success in this role means becoming a trusted technical point of contact for key customers, consistently producing high-quality solution designs, and helping to standardise and improve our presales capability as Zenzero continues to grow.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities
• Act as the primary technical point of contact for presales engagements, supporting customers and internal stakeholders with expert guidance.
• Partner with Account Managers to understand client requirements and develop tailored technology solutions.
• Design and present solution architectures, technical proposals, and delivery estimates that align with customer objectives.
• Produce clear, high-quality technical documentation, including solution overviews, implementation plans, and design diagrams.
• Ensure all proposed solutions align with best practices, security standards, and customer requirements.
• Work with the Head of Presales to develop and maintain standardised solution libraries, templates, and frameworks.
• Collaborate closely with delivery teams to ensure a smooth transition from sales to implementation.
• Provide technical enablement and knowledge sharing to sales and account management teams.

Requirements

Essential
• Experience in a Presales Architect, Solution Architect, or similar technical consulting role within an IT MSP or related environment.
• Strong understanding of modern IT infrastructure, cloud, security, and workplace technologies.
• Expertise across Microsoft 365, Azure, and Modern Workplace solutions.
• Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to manage multiple concurrent presales opportunities while maintaining quality and accuracy.
• Strong documentation and solution design capabilities.

Desirable
• Experience designing and estimating Microsoft Purview-based solutions.
• Experience designing networking solutions including LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, ZTNA, and SASE.
• Microsoft certifications such as MS-100, AZ-104, AZ-140, or equivalent.
• Fortinet certifications.
• Familiarity with ITIL, project management methodologies, PSA tools, RMM platforms, and standardised solution frameworks.

jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist, Lead Generation
jobs.descriptionHtml:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

BASE SALARY: $175,000 to $200,000 per year, paid semi-monthly

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of v...

jobs.title: Senior Technical Recruiter
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ABOUT ENTRADA AI
Entrada AI is a specialized consulting partner and a strategic portfolio company of Databricks Ventures. We were recently named the Genie Partner of the Year (2026) for our work deploying Databricks Genie at enterprise scale—bridging the gap between AI ambition and the trusted, governed data required for accurate responses. With over 150 Databricks projects delivered, we unlock self-service analytics for Fortune 500 leaders.

Databricks invested in us because of our technical excellence, placing us in the "inner circle" of the ecosystem. For our engineers, this means direct access to product roadmaps, private previews, and the teams building the platform. You will join a team of industry veterans who value clean architecture over quick fixes. We don't just maintain pipelines; we solve complex architectural challenges.

Key Responsibilities

• Full-cycle recruitment for Data Engineers, Data Architects, Analytics Engineers, and Platform Engineers

• Develop sourcing strategies for Poland and Romanian and Eastern European markets using LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, and technical channels

• Partner with leadership on technical requirements, market intelligence, compensation trends, and hiring strategy

• Conduct technical screens assessing experience with Databricks, cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP), Spark, Python, and SQL

• Coordinate technical interviews and provide detailed candidate assessments

• Manage ATS workflows, track recruiting metrics, and ensure compliance with Polish labor laws

Required Qualifications

• 5-8 years technical recruiting experience, preferably in consulting/professional services

• Proven track record hiring data engineering, analytics, and cloud platform roles

• Understanding of data technologies: Databricks, Snowflake, Spark, cloud platforms, ETL/ELT, modern data stack

• Deep knowledge of European talent market and local hiring landscape

• Advanced LinkedIn Recruiter proficiency and experience with modern ATS platforms

• Strong stakeholder management and ability to handle multiple searches simultaneously

The Offer

Cooperation Models:

Poland: Available via Employment Contract (UoP) or B2B.

  • 100% Remote: Full flexibility to work from anywhere in Poland.

  • High-End Tech: Apple MacBook Air M4 15" provided to all.

  • Bonus: Bonus for bringing other top-tier engineers to the team.

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

  • Introductory Call (20 min): Short conversation with our Recruiter to discuss your background and expectations.

  • 2nd Interview (60 min): Deep dive into your skills with our managers.

  • 3rd Interview (Optional) : Required only in specific cases.

  • Decision & Offer: We aim to close the process efficiently.

Junior Account Manager

About Us

Fluke Health Solutions’ Landauer business is a trusted leader in radiation safety, offering advanced monitoring and occupational health solutions globally. We pride ourselves on fostering strong, value-driven partnerships with our clients, contributing to improved safety and regulatory compliance. Join our team and drive growth as you partner with clients to elevate their experience, identify opportunities, and deliver measurable impact.

Position Overview

The Junior Account Manager will support Sales Representatives with post sale activities and act as the primary contact for customer support as well as drive cross-sell and upsell opportunities within assigned accounts. This role will work with closely with assigned sales reps to understand key account needs - tracking customer orders; following up on delivery timelines; as well as assisting in managing renewals, and contract follow-ups. This role will also manage & resolve customer issues - triaging incoming customer complaints and determine the appropriate resolution path; coordinating with internal departments to drive fast resolutions; and ensuring consistent and empathetic communication with customers during resolution processes.

Nerdio adds value on top of the powerful capabilities in Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, and Microsoft Intune by delivering hundreds of features that simplify management, ensure efficient operations, and lower Azure compute and storage costs by up to 80% via automation.

Leveraging Nerdio, partners can manage customers’ cloud environments through streamlined, multi-tenant, workflow-powered technology that allows them to create and grow cloud-based recurring revenues. Enterprise IT professionals can deliver and maintain a wide range of virtual Windows endpoints across hybrid workforces with ease and fine-tune end-user computing (EUC) approaches for maximum effectiveness using powerful monitoring and analytics capabilities.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for individuals who are collaborative, empathetic, driven and who love to move at the speed of light. If you want to be part of the AVD transformation that Microsoft and Nerdio are leading, then we want to speak with you.

As a Corporate Account Executive, you will partner and align with Microsoft’s sales teams, including but not limited to Cloud Solutions Architects, Azure Specialists, Global Black Belts, Enterprise Channel Managers, and Account Technology Specialists to uncover AVD opportunities where Nerdio can plugin and help companies deploy, manage, optimize, and secure an AVD environment. Alignment with Microsoft is essential.  

Our ideal CAE is highly skilled with a partnership selling approach. We need relationship builders with a strong understanding of VDI and EUC technologies to continue to grow our most prized partnership with Microsoft and its sales teams. You must be highly motivated and take an entrepreneurial approach to growing the relationship and revenue in addition to being a team player.

Integrity means everything to us – so you will need to do what you say you are going to do. This may involve coordinating with other departments in the wider team, putting your excellent listening, written and verbal communication skills to good use!

  • Manage and close Nerdio opportunities in alignment with Microsoft's sales teams, channel partners, and direct customers.

  • Use a partnership selling approach to uncover, qualify, and close AVD opportunities.

Company Description

Candidly was founded in 2016 to flip the script on what it means to plan, borrow, repay, and save for college. jobs.descriptionHtml:
Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for a Student Retention Specialist to support students in their learning journey and help them stay committed to their educational goals.

This role is responsible for driving student engagement, retention, and overall satisfaction by building meaningful relationships, identifying potential challenges, and providing proactive support. You will work closely with students to help them stay motivated, overcome obstacles, and successfully achieve their educational goals.

What you will do

  • Engage with students through retention-focused calls and chats, addressing refund and cancellation requests with empathy and professionalism.
  • Identify the underlying reasons behind student dissatisfaction and provide personalized solutions to improve their experience and commitment.
  • Manage renewal and recurring payment conversations, proactively reaching out to students before their current term ends to support extensions and continued enrollment.
  • Consistently meet or exceed weekly retention (save rate) and renewal performance goals.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed records of all student interactions within CRM systems.
  • Participate in call reviews, coaching sessions, and continuous development initiatives to enhance performance and student outcomes.

Requirements

  • 1+ years of experience in Retention, Customer Success, Sales, or another customer-facing role.
  • Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal, as you'll be supporting English-speaking students.
  • Strong empathy, active listening, and relationship-building skills, with a genuine desire to help others succeed.
  • Comfortable working in a target-driven environment and meeting performance goals.
  • Resilient, adaptable, and able to remain calm and solution-oriented during challenging conversations.
  • Experience using CRM platforms to manage customer interactions and maintain accurate records.

What we can offer you

  • Clear performance expectations, fast feedback loops, and full ownership of your work and results.
  • Join a mission-driven company helping thousands of people transform their careers through education and technology.
  • A fast-paced environment built on accountability, ownership, and impact—without unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely with a high level of autonomy, trust, and minimal micromanagement.
  • Collaborate with talented professionals from diverse backgrounds across tech, ed-tech, and other industries.
  • Work with platforms like Notion, Miro, Google Workspace, and other digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.
  • Your work will directly contribute to improving student retention, engagement, and long-term success.

Compensation & Schedule

  • Compensation: 1,500 USD fix + performance-based bonus per month.
  • Schedule: Monday to Friday.
  • Working Hours: Approximately 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM CET (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Colombia time).
  • Work Arrangement: Fully remote.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Job Description:

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented VP, Chief Audit Executive (CAE) to join our team!

POSITION OVERVIEW:

The CAE is responsible for the company’s Internal Audit function and audits of the company’s business. The CAE establishes a systematic, objective, and disciplined approach to evaluate and improve the effectiveness and efficiency of risk management, internal controls, compliance, governance, and operational processes. Leverages artificial intelligence, big data analytics and other technologies to make audits more effective, efficient, and agile. In addition, the CAE serves as the leader of the company’s Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) Program Management Office (PMO), ensuring an integrated approach between internal audit activities, enterprise risk management, internal controls over financial reporting (ICFR), and regulatory compliance. The CAE oversees the planning, coordination, execution, and reporting of the SOX 404 compliance program across the enterprise. The CAE reports from a functional standpoint to the Chairperson of the Audit & Risk Committee of the company’s Board of Directors, and from an administrative standpoint to the Chief Financial Officer.


What You'll Be Doing:

  • Determines whether the company’s network of risk management, internal controls, and operational and governance processes is functioning such that: financial statements and managerial information are accurate, reliable, and timely.

Risks to company objectives are identified and managed; effective interaction exists among governance groups; actions are in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, standards, policies, and procedures; activities are free of fraud and abuse; and resources are economically acquired, efficiently used, and adequately protected.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

LMI is seeking an Atlassian Migration Engineer at the Level IV level to modernize enterprise Jira and Confluence environments and connect work management to development delivery pipelines for Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) modernization initiatives. This role combines technical migration execution, scripting, API integration, automation engineering, and validation to move complex workloads to Atlassian Cloud with reliable data and minimal disruption.

The Atlassian Migration Engineer will evaluate source environments, use approved migration tooling, reconcile users and permissions, transform incompatible data and configurations, and verify results through repeatable testing. The engineer will also implement Jira automations and integrations linking GitHub repositories, work items, builds, and deployment status, collaborating closely with cloud architects, administrators, and security and identity teams.

This is not a copy-and-move-only role. Success requires diagnosing legacy configuration constraints, selecting safe remediation approaches, proving that critical links and histories remain usable, and creating clear cutover and recovery evidence. The ideal candidate pairs strong troubleshooting and scripting skills with disciplined change control and attention to operational handover.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Inventory legacy Jira/Confluence projects, spaces, workflows, identities, marketplace apps, and integrations to assess migration readiness.
  • Plan and execute phased migrations with Jira Cloud Migration Assistant and other approved Atlassian migration tools.
  • Write and test migration scripts, bulk transformations, reconciliation checks, and post-cutover remediation procedures.
  • Design Jira automation, REST API interfaces, and Forge or ScriptRunner extensions where appropriate.
  • Connect GitHub repositories to Jira, enabling issue linkage, smart commits, and build/deployment visibility using approved integrations and GitHub Actions.
  • Document test plans, validation evidence, fallback options, migration defects, and technical handover artifacts.
  • Resolve migration blockers with security, identity, architecture, and customer teams.

  • Test migrations in nonproduction environments where available; compare record counts, histories, attachments, relationships, permissions, and workflows against approved baselines.
  • Use approved APIs and scripts for bulk corrections, automation, link repair, integration health checks, and reconciliation of post-migration issues.
  • Implement and verify GitHub-to-JCC issue links, smart commits where supported, and CI/CD build and deploy signals while protecting credentials and secrets.
  • Coordinate technical releases with change authorities and document repeatable procedures, integration ownership, monitoring, and maintenance responsibilities.

Job Type: Full-Time
Experience: 2–6 Years
Salary Range: $75,000 – $115,000 per year
Work Mode: 100% Remote
Industry: Information Technology

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled End User Computing (EUC) Engineer to manage, maintain, and optimize enterprise end-user computing environments. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with desktop management, endpoint security, virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI), device management, and enterprise IT support solutions.

You will be responsible for ensuring secure, reliable, and efficient computing experiences for employees across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, deploy, and maintain end-user computing environments.

  • Manage Windows and macOS desktops, laptops, and mobile devices.

  • Administer Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (SCCM), and Active Directory.

  • Support Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) solutions such as Citrix and VMware Horizon.

  • Manage software installations, updates, patches, and endpoint configurations.

  • Implement endpoint security policies and device compliance standards.

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, and connectivity issues.

  • Manage user accounts, permissions, and access controls.

  • Support Microsoft 365 applications, Teams, Outlook, and OneDrive.

  • Automate endpoint management tasks using PowerShell scripting.

  • Monitor endpoint performance and resolve technical issues.

  • Collaborate with infrastructure, cybersecurity, and service desk teams.

  • Maintain technical documentation and IT support procedures.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 2–6 years of experience in End User Computing, Desktop Engineering, or IT Infrastructure.

  • Strong knowledge of Windows 10/11 and Windows Server environments.

  • Experience with Microsoft Intune and SCCM/MECM.

  • Knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, and Azure Active Directory (Microsoft Entra ID).

  • Experience with endpoint management and device deployment.

  • Familiarity with Citrix, VMware Horizon, or other VDI technologies.

  • Knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications and administration.

  • Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation.

  • Understanding of endpoint security, patch management, and device compliance.

  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Windows Autopilot and mobile device management (MDM).

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

  • Experience with macOS device management.

  • Familiarity with ServiceNow or other ITSM platforms.

  • Knowledge of Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD).

  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft 365, Endpoint Administrator, or CompTIA certifications.

Salary & Benefits

  • Annual Salary: $75,000 – $115,000, depending on experience and qualifications.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

  • 401(k) retirement benefits.

  • Paid vacation and holidays.

  • Flexible remote working environment.

  • Professional development and certification assistance.

  • Performance-based bonuses (where applicable).

Position Summary:

The Senior Clinical Data Manager is responsible and manages all aspects of the clinical trial data management process from study start up to post database lock for assigned projects. Standard Operating Procedures / Work Instructions (SOPs/WIs); regulatory directives; study specific plans and guidelines will be followed. This position will also oversee and/or perform database development and testing.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

May support another Lead DM as a back-up and/or team member. May include DM oversight of sponsor programs.

  • Coordinate SAE/AE reconciliation
  • Liaises with third-party vendors such as external data and EDC vendors in a project manager capacity in support of timelines and data-related deliverables

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Sr. Business Development Manager, Combatant Commands & Department of War

BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & SALES

Location

Remote (U.S.). Must live within commuting distance of a named customer hub: DC metro, Huntsville AL, Tampa FL, Colorado Springs CO, Dayton OH, St. Louis MO, Norfolk VA, or Omaha NE.

Employment Type

Full-Time

Clearance

Active Secret required; TS/SCI strongly preferred

Department

Growth

Compensation

$150,000–185,000 base (market band; final pending Finance confirmation)

About EarthDaily Federal

EarthDaily Federal is a geospatial intelligence company at the intersection of space, AI, and national security. Our products power mission-critical insights for federal agencies and prime contractors across defense, intelligence, environmental monitoring, and disaster response.

About the Role

This is a hunter seat covering the combatant commands and the Department of War enterprise. You will build pipeline across COCOM and department-level customers, run early capture against operational and theater requirements, and carry a number in a fast-moving, mission-driven market.

What You'll Do

  • Own pipeline development across the combatant commands and the Department of War (formerly Department of Defense) enterprise
  • Engage operational and theater customers to shape geospatial requirements and competitive positioning
  • Build and manage a disciplined pipeline with accurate CRM hygiene and forecasting
  • Run early-stage capture across COCOM and department-level pursuits
  • Develop account plans aligned to combatant command priorities and DoW enterprise initiatives
  • Coordinate with sales engineering and proposal teams to advance qualified pursuits
  • Represent the company at defense industry events and customer engagements

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of federal business development experience selling into DoD/Department of War or combatant command customers
  • Demonstrated quota attainment and pipeline ownership
  • Working knowledge of the federal acquisition process and DoW contract vehicles
  • Established relationships across combatant commands or department-level geospatial customers
  • Experience at startups or smaller companies with strong track records

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active TS/SCI clearance
  • Prior military service or COCOM staff experience
  • Existing relationships at one or more combatant commands
  • Capture management training (Shipley or equivalent)

Security Notice

In the course of their duties, EarthDaily Federal personnel may or may not have access to classified national security information or controlled unclassified information (CUI). All employees, regardless of role or clearance status, are required to handle such information in strict accordance with applicable U.S. Government laws and regulations, the National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (32 CFR Part 117), company security policies, and the terms of any individual clearance or access authorization. Unauthorized access, handling, or disclosure of classified information or CUI is strictly prohibited and must be reported immediately to the Facility Security Officer.

Salary: 140000 - 180000

Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Principal Security Consultant
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Zensec is one of the UK's fastest-growing cyber security providers. As part of the award-winning Zenzero Group, recognised as a Top 8 Technology Company at the British Business Awards 2026, a Deloitte Best Managed Company, and featured in the Sunday Times Hundred in both 2025 and 2026, we're helping ambitious organisations strengthen their security posture in an increasingly complex digital world.

Our mission is simple: to make cyber security practical, proactive, and effective for mid-market businesses. From managed detection and response, security operations, and threat monitoring to governance, risk, compliance, and security consulting, we help organisations stay secure, resilient, and ready for what's next.

Demand for cyber security expertise has never been greater, and neither has our ambition. As a certified B Corp and Scale Up Award winner, we believe high growth and high standards go hand in hand. We're building a business where talented people can do meaningful work, make a real impact, and help shape the future of cyber security.

Fast growth. High standards. Real impact. If that sounds like your kind of place, we'd love to hear from you.


About the Role
As a Principal Security Consultant, you will lead high-impact digital forensics and incident response (DFIR) engagements for clients facing some of today's most challenging cyber threats, including ransomware, business email compromise (BEC), and ClickFix attacks. Acting as the senior technical lead throughout the incident lifecycle, you will guide investigations from initial triage through containment, forensic analysis, recovery, and final reporting.

Working within the DFIR Forensics team, you will collaborate with incident managers, SOC specialists, account teams, insurers, legal partners, and client leadership. This is an opportunity to shape investigation methodology, strengthen tooling, mentor consultants, and influence the development of a growing cyber security practice.

Success in this role means delivering exceptional client outcomes, providing trusted technical leadership during live incidents, developing team capability, and continuously improving forensic processes and services.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end incident response engagements involving ransomware, BEC, and ClickFix attacks.
  • Own forensic investigations across Windows environments, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Azure, and endpoint platforms.
  • Drive the production of executive-level and technical reports that clearly communicate root cause, attacker activity, and business impact.
  • Advise clients on containment strategies, recovery planning, and security improvement actions during live incidents.
  • Mentor and coach consultants and analysts, raising technical capability across the DFIR team.
  • Build and enhance forensic tooling, playbooks, investigation timelines, and MITRE ATT&CK-aligned methodologies.
  • Partner with pre-sales and business development teams to support scoping discussions and client proposals.

Requirements

Essential
  • Proven ability to lead complex DFIR investigations and manage client-facing incident response engagements.
  • Deep understanding of ransomware intrusion lifecycles and adversary tradecraft.
  • Strong expertise in Microsoft 365 and BEC investigations, including audit log analysis and identity compromise scenarios.
  • Advanced knowledge of Windows host forensics, evidence collection, event log analysis, and memory analysis techniques.
  • Experience presenting technical findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Strong communication, judgement, and decision-making skills under pressure.
  • Degree-level education in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience.
Desirable
  • Experience supporting insurer-led or legally privileged investigations...

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Senior ROR Product Technical Support Engineer
Location: Remote

Note: Candidates must be willing and comfortable to work night shifts.

Job Summary:
We are looking for a Senior Product Technical Support Engineer with strong hands-on debugging and problem-solving skills to support and troubleshoot a large-scale Ruby on Rails monolithic application. You will work across the application, database, integrations, and hosting layers to diagnose complex production issues and ensure a reliable customer experience.
Key Responsibilities:
· Troubleshoot complex production issues across Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, background jobs, APIs, and third-party integrations using logs, stack traces, database queries, and debugging tools.
· Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for production incidents and work closely with Engineering, Product, QA, and Customer Support teams to drive issues to resolution.
· Diagnose PostgreSQL issues including slow queries, data inconsistencies, database locks/deadlocks, connection issues, indexing, and data-related problems.
· Troubleshoot REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, data synchronization, and third-party integrations, including Stripe and AWS S3.
· Support and troubleshoot applications hosted on Heroku, including dynos, workers, deployments, configuration/environment variables, logs, build failures, and application performance.
· Investigate Stripe payment, subscription, refund, and webhook-related issues, including discrepancies between Stripe and application data.
· Analyze customer-reported issues, trace problems through the application and database layers, reproduce issues, and provide appropriate fixes or workarounds.
· Make small-to-medium code fixes, SQL queries, scripts, configuration changes, and production fixes where required.
· Monitor recurring production issues and proactively identify opportunities to improve application stability, performance, monitoring, and support processes.
· Create and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, runbooks, and RCA reports.

Required Skills & Experience:
· 4+ years of experience in technical support, application support, production support, or a similar engineering role.
· Strong hands-on experience with Ruby/Ruby on Rails and debugging web applications.
· Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL and SQL, including query analysis and troubleshooting.
· Experience with Heroku or similar cloud application hosting platforms.
· Good understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, JSON, webhooks, and third-party integrations.
· Experience working with AWS S3 and cloud-based services.
· Familiarity with Stripe APIs, payments, subscriptions, and webhooks is highly desirable.
· Working knowledge of Git, background jobs, caching, Linux/Unix, and application performance troubleshooting.
· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical issues.
· Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering, Product, QA, and Customer Support teams.

Good to Have:
· Experience supporting large monolithic Rails applications in production.
· Experience with monitoring/logging tools and production incident management.
· Familiarity with CI/CD, automated deployments, and application performance monitoring.
· Experience writing scripts or automation to reduce repetitive support and troubleshooting activities.
Keywords:Ruby on Rails, Ruby, PostgreSQL, SQL, Heroku, AWS S3, Stripe, REST API, Webhooks, Production Support, Application Support, Technical Support, Troubleshooting, Root Cause Analysis, RCA, Incident Management, Debugging, SaaS, Cloud, Git.

jobs.title: Senior Atlassian Solution Architect
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

LMI is seeking an Atlassian Solution Architect at the Senior level to design secure, scalable enterprise Atlassian Cloud environments supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) technology modernization initiatives. This role combines solution architecture, cloud migration strategy, identity and access integration, Jira and Confluence in Commercial Cloud governance, and technical leadership to establish sustainable platform standards for diverse teams.

The Atlassian Solution Architect will define the target-state site and organization architecture, guide configuration decisions, assess legacy Data Center assets, and establish migration patterns for projects, permissions, users, marketplace apps, and integrations. The architect will work with security, identity, engineering, administration, portfolio, and government stakeholders to make well-supported design choices and oversee technical implementation.

This is not a diagram-only architecture position. The successful candidate must anticipate operational constraints, validate designs through implementation and testing, resolve platform tradeoffs, and help teams adopt standards without sacrificing necessary functionality. The ideal candidate pairs deep Atlassian expertise with pragmatic delivery judgment, risk management, and the ability to explain complex technical decisions to senior leaders.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Define target-state Atlassian Commercial Cloud organization and site architecture, governance standards, and configuration patterns.
  • Develop reference architecture, solution decisions, site and organization standards, and documented exceptions covering Jira Commercial Cloud (JCC), Confluence Commercial Cloud (CCC), identity, and governance.
  • Design identity federation, SSO, MFA-aligned access, group mapping, role-based permissions, and appropriate security controls.
  • Lead current-state assessment and Data Center and GovCloud-to-Commercial Cloud migration strategy, including phased cutover, coexistence, and rollback considerations.
  • Set standards for projects, workflows, fields, templates, apps, Confluence spaces, and enterprise reporting.
  • Oversee migration and integration designs, including JCC-to-GitHub/CI-CD connectivity and portfolio reporting interfaces.
  • Evaluate marketplace app compatibility, license and site options, technical risks, and tradeoffs; document architecture decisions.
  • Lead technical reviews, validation criteria, and knowledge transfer to operations teams.
  • Lead migration readiness reviews, application dependency mapping, coexistence strategy, cutover approvals, and validation criteria for legacy environments.
  • Evaluate permission models, least-privilege access, SAML/OIDC federation, MFA requirements, group synchronization, and secure administrative practices with security teams.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell

Chainguard Containers is our core product, and this team builds it. As a Senior Software Engineer in Container Product Engineering you will design and ship the features, services, and build systems behind Chainguard Containers, working in a small sub-team of two to four engineers that owns one project end to end.

Chainguard is growing explosively. Every line of code is now written with AI in the loop, which means the foundation it runs on has to be secure by default. You will build that foundation: the hardened container images, the registry that serves them, and the tooling that lets engineers and AI agents adopt them.

This is a product role. You will work directly with Product Managers and customers, make the trade-off calls on the features you own, and ship them.

What the team owns

  • Product features for Chainguard Containers. Letting customers push their own images to our registry, Custom Assembly (customers compose images from our hardened packages), Helm charts, notifications, and compliance views such as STIG dashboards (STIG is the US government's hardening standard).
  • The image build pipeline. The systems that turn packages from Wolfi, our Linux distribution, into signed and attested container images at scale, including moving image builds onto our own runner infrastructure.
  • Registry performance and distribution. Work such as lazy loading, so a container starts before its whole image has downloaded, and image signing with Sigstore.
  • Adoption tooling for engineers and AI agents. Migration tools that convert existing Dockerfiles to Chainguard Containers, and MCP servers (Model Context Protocol, the standard that lets AI agents call tools) so agents can discover and pull our images directly.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and ship new features and services for Chainguard Containers, from a one-page design through production and the first week of customer use.
  • Own the trade-offs on your work: scope, sequencing, what to cut, and when "good enough to ship" beats "complete". Say so clearly when a plan is at risk.
  • Work with AI coding agents as part of how you build, review, and operate, and help the team raise the bar on how it uses them safely.
  • Follow a problem wherever it goes: into another team's service, a customer call, a support ticket, or go-to-market data, rather than stopping at the edge of your own repository.
  • Keep the systems you touch healthy: observability, on-call, and the fixes that stop the same page from coming back.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At MySpectrum Counseling & Coaching, we believe clients deserve to feel seen, understood, and respected in therapy.

WHY JOIN MYSPECTRUM?

  • Flexible telehealth opportunities
  • In-person opportunities where available
  • Control over your schedule and preferred caseload
  • Consistent biweekly pay based on completed, billed sessions
  • Administrative, scheduling, credentialing, and billing support
  • Access to clients across a broad range of insurance plans
  • A collaborative clinical community
  • The freedom to practice with authenticity and cultural responsiveness
  • A nationally recognized, fast-growing behavioral health organization
  • A workplace recognized as a Top Place to Work for six consecutive years

We are expanding our clinician team to more closely reflect the diverse communities we serve. We welcome licensed therapists who bring cultural humility, varied perspectives, and demonstrated experience supporting Black and African American individuals, couples, and families, as well as other historically underserved communities.

MySpectrum is a practice, not a platform. Our clinicians are direct employees (W-2) who receive the operational support they need while maintaining the clinical independence necessary to provide excellent care. Part-time and full-time opportunities are available.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Hold an active, unrestricted behavioral health license
  • Provide compassionate, evidence-based care
  • Understand how culture, identity, family, community, and lived experience can influence mental health
  • Have experience serving culturally diverse populations
  • Want to help reduce barriers to high-quality behavioral healthcare
  • Value clinical autonomy while being part of a supportive practice

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

  • Must be licensed as an LCSW, LPC, LMFT, or LCP in the state of Texas and eligible for credentialing with major insurance panels; those with clinical licenses in multiple states, in addition to Texas, are encouraged to apply.
  • Experience working with diverse populations
  • Flexibility to commit to joining us now and the drive to stick with us so that your caseload can grow
  • Must have access to a personal computer suitable for telehealth sessions and required job duties
  • Must have high-speed internet access
  • Must have a HIPAA-protected space to use consistently for sessions
  • Must be comfortable working remotely and seeing clients via telehealth

Company: Celerity Consulting Group
Location: Remote (work from home eligible) with the ability to travel for client meetings and workshops

Our background and expertise enable us to drive and deliver transformation and operational excellence for our clients. Our background and expertise also enable us to implement enterprise systems & solutions, driving digital transformation and operational excellence for our clients.

jobs.title: Enterprise Transformation Program Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Position Summary:

Leads the planning and execution of Penn Foster Group's enterprise migration of partners and learners from a legacy platform to the company's newest technology stack. Coordinates technical, operational, and change management work across teams and partners, keeping stakeholders informed, resolving blockers, and managing readiness through migration, cutover, and stabilization. Brings strong technical understanding, careful attention to detail, and experience delivering large, complex change initiatives.

Essential Job Functions:

Coordinates the migration of partner and learner populations from legacy platforms to Penn Foster Group's newest technology stack, aligning scope, cohorts, sequencing, readiness, cutover, and stabilization. Maintains an integrated plan of milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, decisions, and blockers; communicates progress, impacts, and needed actions to key stakeholders. Translates legacy processes and partner needs into detailed technical and operational requirements for target-state systems, integrations, workflows, and configurations; works closely with IT, Product, Operations, and partner teams. Coordinates data, content, program, and assessment mapping and validation; leads test planning, user acceptance testing, reconciliation, and readiness reviews to confirm accurate migration outcomes. Leads change management and transition planning with partners and internal teams, including communications, training, support readiness, and learner continuity. Drives cross-functional issue resolution and decisions, removes blockers, manages risks and exceptions, and coordinates cutover and contingency plans. Monitors migration quality and post-launch outcomes, including data and enrollment accuracy, defects, partner and learner impacts, and support needs; resolves root causes and improves migration standards for subsequent waves.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

Experience leading complex implementations, migrations, integrations, or partner launches from intake through launch and stabilization. Experience partnering with IT and developers on integrations, data flows, system configuration, enhancements, and migrations. Knowledge of test planning, user acceptance testing, defect triage, launch readiness, deployment coordination, and support after launch. Strong project management skills across scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, decisions, follow-ups, and stakeholder communication. Analytical problem-solving and root cause analysis across enrollment, configuration, billing, reporting, and workflow issues; distinguishes one-time exceptions from systemic problems. Process improvement skills, including designing scalable workflows, dashboards, self-service resources, procedures, and repeatable standards. Clear written and verbal communication, documentation, and facilitation skills with internal teams and external partners.

Working Conditions & Hiring Process:

U.S. Work Location Requirement: All employees must reside in and perform work within the United States. We do not support international remote work arrangements for this role. Travel Expectations: While this is a remote position, occasional travel may be required for team meetings, company events, conferences, summits, etc. Candidates must be willing and able to travel as needed. On-Camera Work Environment: We operate in a highly collaborative, remote, on-camera culture. Employees are expected to be on camera during meetings unless extenuating circumstances apply. Recorded Video Interviews: All video interviews conducted during the hiring process will be recorded to support internal hiring consistency and process improvement. jobs.descriptionHtml:
What's the Vibe?
Our founders started Creative Force with a single goal in mind: to build industry-leading software with really cool people.
As we’ve grown, we’ve stayed true to that vision. Our products are ushering in a new era of creative operations for some of the world’s largest brands and retailers.
And all along the way, hiring great people has remained a critical business priority...
...See, we have this crazy idea that effective collaboration is THE skill of the future and critical to our success. As a remote company with staff across the globe, we've seen firsthand how important it is for our teams to work well together.
And that's why we focus on hiring talented people who are also great to work with.
That means we don't always hire the people with the most experience. Some of us have PhDs. Others have spent multiple decades working at the top of our field. But we've also hired former tennis coaches, film students, photographers, hotel front desk workers, freelance travel agents, and fashion designers.
While our backgrounds are diverse, we all share a few important traits:
  • We love solving challenging problems.
  • We're passionate about the work we do.
  • And we're the kind of good humans who make you look forward to that morning coffee chat, who bring positive energy to every meeting, who go the extra mile to support one another, and who make work feel a little less like work.
But hey, there are lots of job posts out there that are cool and vibey and explain how unique their company culture is (look, a ping-pong table!). We know, we’ve seen them. Some might be truer than others. As for us, we think you’ll notice the good vibes the first time we chat.

What we offer YOU

  • A fast-growing, exciting, and fun scaleup environment — with multiple international Employer Awards — and not those awards you can pay for, but the kind of awards given based on Employee reviews. It just doesn’t get any better than that. 💜
  • A flat and transparent organizational structure — no bureaucratic red tape. Your ideas and initiatives will be heard and embraced!
  • True work-life balance — we see our team members as people, not numbers, and know that a balanced personal and professional life is critical to happiness and long-term fulfillment
  • A collaborative international environment with colleagues across Europe and USA
  • A growing Technical Success function with opportunities to influence processes, strategy, and customer experience
  • A vibrant work culture grounded in the belief that we’re better together
  • Company trips and events, and much more!

What’s the Role?

Still interested? Awesome. Here's the deal:

At Creative Force, we work with some of the world's biggest brands and retailers. Our customers operate at scale, move fast, and rely on our platform to power complex creative workflows across teams, regions, and markets.

And that's where you come in.

We're looking for a Technical Account Manager to become the trusted technical partner for our Enterprise customers throughout their entire journey with Creative Force.
You'll be involved from the very beginning — partnering with Sales during the pre-sales process to understand customer needs, design the right technical solutions, and help show how Creative Force can solve complex workflow challenges.

jobs.title: Sr. AI/ML Engineer - Life Science
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Position Overview:

The Sr. Machine Learning Engineer is largely self-driven, working in collaboration with others on one or more projects which are extremely complex in scope. This role is responsible for successfully leading the planning and execution of projects. Working in a team setting, this position applies deep knowledge of advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms and models to solve complex problems involving biological, genomic, clinical and healthcare data within a setting of advanced cancer screening and precision oncology. This position provides technical leadership at every step of the solution development process, from ideation, design, implementation and deployment. The Lead Machine Learning Engineer will help craft the strategic vision for the application of cutting-edge AI methodologies at Exact Sciences and work as a partner with biostatisticians, bioinformatics scientists, and data scientists to further our goal of helping eradicate cancer by preventing it, detecting it earlier, and guiding personalized treatment.

Essential Duties
Include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Lead development of perspectives on technology “affordance”: what do these advances in AI technology allow us to do (more efficiently and / or more effectively) that we couldn’t do before
  • Work with stakeholders to identify, refine, prioritize and formalize requirements for ML- and AI-based solutions to business problems with a focus on bioinformatics, biostatistics and data engineering applications.
  • Collaborate with other ML/AI engineers and relevant partners to provide technical and strategic leadership for the design of software solutions that utilize state-of-the art artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques.
  • Work with other AI and ML engineers and software engineers to lead the implementation and deployment of ML and AI solutions.
  • Set up Agile framework focused on delivering iterative, “rapid” solutions that demonstrate the promise of selected AI technologies.
  • Provide leadership in the development of an AI strategy at Exact Sciences that empowers the team to leverage both existing AI and ML tools and those developed in-house to accelerate and enhance bioinformatics, biostatistics and data science processes and outcomes.
  • Lead internal initiatives to build training resources, develop knowledge bases, and educate on advanced AI and ML technologies and best practices for leveraging them.
  • Lead “AI evangelism” for biostatistics, bioinformatics and data science at Exact Sciences.
  • Assist team to solve complex problems using sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgement and identify innovative solution
  • Provide mentorship and coaching to more junior level team members.
  • Act as resource and subject matter expert in core team and/or cross-functional meetings.
  • Contribute to the intellectual property portfolio by implementing innovative and creative ideas to solve problems or improve on current methods.
  • Exercise discretion and judgment within broadly defined practices and policies in selecting methods and techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining and interpreting results.

jobs.title: PDF Accessibility Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Title: PDF Accessibility Specialist (Freelance / Independent Contractor)

Hours: 5–20 hours per week (Flexible / Remote – Philippines Timezone Preferred)

Overview:

Promet Source is seeking an Independent PDF Accessibility Specialist to consult with our clients on PDF accessibility best practices and remediate documents to meet WCAG, Section 508, and PDF/UA standards. This role ensures that all PDF content is fully usable by individuals relying on assistive technologies, including screen readers.

Responsibilities:

  • Remediate PDFs for accessibility, including tagging, reading order, alternative text, headings, tables, forms, and bookmarks.
  • Test documents using screen readers (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver) and automated tools (Adobe Acrobat Accessibility Checker, PAC, CommonLook).
  • Convert scanned or image-based PDFs into accessible, searchable documents using OCR.
  • Review source files (Word, InDesign, PowerPoint) and recommend upstream accessibility fixes to streamline remediation.
  • Conduct accessibility audits and produce VPAT/ACR documentation as needed.
  • Track and prioritize remediation tasks across a document backlog while consistently meeting deadlines and quality standards.
  • Stay current on WCAG 2.1/2.2, Section 508, ADA, and PDF/UA requirements.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience remediating PDFs for accessibility compliance.
  • In-depth working knowledge of WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA guidelines and Section 508 standards.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Acrobat Pro, AEM Designer (tagging, reading order, form design), and automated accessibility testing tools.
  • Practical familiarity with screen reader testing and assistive technology.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage a high-volume document workload.
  • IAAP certification (CPACC, WAS, or CPWA) is highly preferred.

Preferred Experience:

  • Remediating complex structures, including interactive forms, multi-page tables, charts, and multi-column layouts.
  • Working with source authoring tools (Microsoft Word, Adobe InDesign, PowerPoint) using accessible-by-design principles.

We are an equal opportunity organization. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Grupo QuintoAndar

Grupo QuintoAndar is the largest real estate ecosystem in Latin America, with brands and solutions across six countries.

Our purpose is to help people love where they live by making the housing journey simpler, from finding a home to managing life in it.

We’re also investing R$ 2 billion in technology and AI over the next two years, expanding our engineering capabilities and developing more conversational product experiences. To learn more about our story, visit:.

Location & Remote Work

Our technology team operates under a "remote-first" model, which means we work from home and can live anywhere in Brazil. We also offer the option of working from our São Paulo office. Furthermore, we offer the Work From Anywhere program, allowing you to work from any country for up to 90 days a year, ensuring you have the flexibility to do the best work of your career.

The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a core driver of our technical execution. Here, you won't just "maintain old systems" or "take tickets." We are an organization of builders guided by deep technical density. You will use our Leadership Principles, like Dive Deep and Make it Great, to solve high-impact distribution problems and build the systems of our next decade.

We believe that technology scales execution, but senior talent scales judgment. You will be at the forefront of our AI-First pivot, designing highly scalable, resilient systems capable of supporting low-latency conversational journeys, heavy microservices orchestration, and real-time ML processing.

Our Tech Stack: We work with Java, Kotlin, Node.js, Go, Python, React, and more, primarily hosted on AWS. Our daily workflow also incorporates various AI tools, including Claude Code.

Don't worry if you haven't mastered our exact stack. We value strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, and an engineering mindset over specific technology experience.

Position & Technical Challenges:

We hire Senior Software Engineers through a unified selection process for multiple engineering teams.

At the final stage, you'll have the opportunity to explore which team best matches your experience and interests, alongside our hiring needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build at Scale: Design, develop, and maintain highly scalable and resilient microservices capable of handling our 50M+ monthly accesses and high-concurrency environments.
  • AI-First Integration: Actively participate in the architectural evolution of our platform, paving the road to integrate robust backend systems with our new AI/LLM conversational capabilities and massive data ecosystems.
  • End-to-End Ownership: Be responsible for the entire software development lifecycle: definition, development, testing, production, and maintenance. Adopt an "owner's mindset", creating observability and taking proactive actions on post-mortems.
  • Quality Guardian: Be a guardian of your team's delivery quality by reinforcing the adoption of excellent software development practices, participating rigorously in code and design reviews.
  • Mentorship: Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, raising the technical bar of your team and sharing knowledge across our teams.

What we are looking for:

  • Solid experience building and evolving software architecture from the ground up for high-volume, distributed systems.
  • Strong understanding of database design, evolution, and complex data modeling.
  • Skilled in creating and maintaining RESTful APIs, with a strong grasp of system integration.

jobs.title: AI Native Software Engineer - Digital Core - Americas Market
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Accenture:


Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 814,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com.


We are:


A forward-thinking services company at the forefront of AI-native engineering. We partner with enterprise clients to design, build, and run production systems in which AI is a first-class engineering capability, engineered into the product and into the way our teams build it. Our engineers embed deeply with customers, own the code they ship, and move work past experimentation into operational reality.


You are:


An engineer who builds across the stack: front end, APIs, services, data, and the infrastructure it runs on. You take ownership of a feature through to production, including the parts that sit outside your strongest layer, and you have shipped software that real users depend on. You can explain the design decisions behind your work and what you would do differently.

About Omnidian

Omnidian, Inc. is a fast-growing Series C tech-enabled service company revolutionizing performance assurance for the distributed solar and energy storage industries. Omnidian is building a more sustainable future for the planet through our passionate teams, our innovative technology, and by creating an amazing customer experience. We are a certified B Corps, headquartered in Seattle, WA

The Job

Are you ready to make a meaningful impact in the solar industry? As a Customer Experience Specialist at Omnidian, you'll play a pivotal role in managing high-sentiment escalations and ensuring our customers receive a path to total system recovery. In this role, you will be the main point of contact for escalated customer escalations, helping them find a clear path to getting their solar systems back up and running. Combining deep technical solar expertise with empathetic communication. You will report to the Customer Experience Manager and act as a central hub, coordinating with internal teams to resolve routine friction and keep the planet’s energy assets performing at their best.

    • Escalation Ownership & Resolution

  • Settlement Authority: Authorized to negotiate and settle financial disputes up to established limits to achieve first-contact resolution within the escalation layer.
  • Professional Updates: Respond to inbound escalations from homeowners, clients, and external partners with clear, professional, and empathetic communication that resolves friction and explains technical trade-offs.
  • Executive Case Management: Handle executive-level customer concerns, balancing customer advocacy with company policy to drive timely, equitable resolutions.

    • Regulatory & Legal Case Management

  • Regulatory Complaint Ownership: Receive, investigate, and respond to complaints from Attorneys General, the Better Business Bureau (BBB), consumer protection agencies, and other regulatory organizations while ensuring all response deadlines are met.

  • Risk Assessment: Identify situations with elevated legal, financial, or reputational risk and escalate appropriately while maintaining accurate, defensible documentation.

    • Technical Solar Expert

  • System Recovery: Identify root causes of technical failures and execute policy overrides to restore system accuracy and performance.
  • Advanced Troubleshooting: Apply specialized knowledge in high-complexity areas, including roof leak protocols, electrical and safety concerns, and remote troubleshooting for all standard solar equipment.

Why Apply to New Frontier Immigration Law

Join the New Frontier Immigration Law team and help change the lives of 1 million undocumented immigrants in the USA. Our mid-sized law firm in Phoenix, AZ is committed to humanitarian-based immigration and finding innovative solutions for seemingly impossible problems.

Are you ready to join one of the fastest-growing law firms in the US, where incredible opportunities await? Here, we don’t just offer a job: we provide an environment that challenges you to become the best version of yourself.

  • Learn more about New Frontier Immigration here.
  • Learn more about our CEO/Founder Hillary here.
  • Learn more about our Core Values here.

Role Objective

The Sales Attorney is a client-facing role that sits at the intersection of legal expertise and consultative sales. This position is responsible for conducting strategy sessions with prospective clients, assessing their immigration situation, and guiding qualified individuals toward retaining the firm's services. The ideal candidate is a licensed attorney in Mexico with a strong command of immigration law, a genuine empathy for the communities we serve, and a proven ability to close.

This is not a traditional legal practice role - it is a client-facing position where legal expertise and genuine human connection work together. Success in this role means helping people understand their options clearly, building trust from the very first conversation, and guiding qualified individuals toward the support they need - same day.

Responsibilities/Duties

  • Conduct strategy sessions as the primary daily activity (4–5 hours/day) - assess each client's immigration situation, explain available pathways, and present the firm's services with clarity and confidence.
  • Complete priming calls and proposal preparation before each strategy session to ensure readiness and maximize conversion.
  • Close contracts, collect payments, and book client onboarding appointments on the same day as hire - same-day close is the standard.
  • Execute timely follow-up calls on all pending and undecided clients from prior strategy sessions - no potential client is left without a follow-up.
  • Ensure complete and accurate handoff to the Legal team for every retained client - documentation, onboarding checklist, and case details transferred without gaps.
  • Maintain accurate records of all client interactions, session outcomes, and pipeline activity in the firm's CRM.
  • Meet and exceed individual session conversion targets and monthly retention goals.

Requirements

  • Licensed attorney in Mexico in good standing - required; Licenciatura en Derecho and Cédula Profesional required.
  • Bilingual in Spanish and English - native-level Spanish required; strong English communication skills essential for collaboration with US-based leadership.
  • Knowledge of immigration law - ability to assess client eligibility, explain case types, and identify viable pathways with confidence.
  • Demonstrated success in a sales or client conversion role - track record of meeting or exceeding quota in a performance-based environment.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills - able to build trust quickly, handle sensitive conversations with empathy, and guide clients through complex decisions.
  • Strong active listening skills - able to identify client needs accurately and respond with relevant, accurate information.

jobs.title: Communications Lead, Wikimedia Enterprise (Contract)
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>COMMUNICATIONS LEAD, WIKIMEDIA ENTERPRISE (CONTRACT)</strong></p> <p><strong>Contract terms:</strong> 40 hours/week, initial 6-month contract, with potential to extend based on organizational needs</p> <p><strong>Reports to: </strong>Communications Manager (dotted line to President of Wikimedia Enterprise)</p> <p><strong>Summary</strong></p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our mission is to bring free educational content to the world.</p> <p>Wikimedia Enterprise is the Wikimedia Foundation's commercial product for large-scale reusers and distributors of Wikimedia content. Through Enterprise agreements, companies gain improved, commercial-grade access to Wikimedia content at a volume and scale they need,  while directly supporting the Wikimedia Foundation's free knowledge mission. As AI systems increasingly scrape Wikipedia at scale, Wikimedia Enterprise has become critical to a sustainable model for Wikimedia projects and the open knowledge ecosystem.</p> <p>We're looking for an experienced communications lead to serve as the primary communications partner to the Wikimedia Enterprise team — shaping external messaging, media relations, and thought leadership to drive organic demand for Wikimedia Enterprise services, while ensuring narrative and strategic alignment with the Foundation's broader communications priorities.  This role sits in the Media Relations team, within the Foundation’s <a href="https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation/Communications">Communications Department</a>, with a dotted line to the President of Wikimedia Enterprise.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and own the external communications strategy for Wikimedia Enterprise across media/trade press, speaking engagements, and other channels that build visibility and organic demand for Enterprise offerings.</li> <li>Build relationships with reporters (mainstream and B2B tech trade press) and conference organizers to secure speaking opportunities and position Wikimedia Enterprise as the go-to product for commercial content reusers.</li> <li>Serve as a primary media liaison for Wikimedia Enterprise, working with the wider media relations team to manage daily press inquiries, prepping spokespeople/staffing interviews, information requests, and speaking engagement requests in a timely manner. This includes leading rapid response media efforts — triaging sensitive, fast-moving situations with sound judgment.</li> <li>Partner with internal teams to develop narratives and thought leadership that strengthens Wikimedia Enterprise's brand relevance and positioning.</li> <li>Guide, produce, and review marketing and communications materials — press statements, blogs, pitch notes and lists, briefing docs, and more — ensuring key messages about Wikimedia Enterprise are shaped consistently and clearly for public audiences.</li> <li>Coordinate  the end-to-end communications workflow for major external launches and announcements together with the Enterprise Growth team, from drafting through internal review, stakeholder approvals, and release.</li> <li>Ensure alignment between the Wikimedia Enterprise growth plan and the Foundation's annual communications calendar.</li> <li>Build relationships and lead cooperative efforts with internal and external stakeholders — Wikimedia Foundation colleagues, Wikimedia volunteers and affiliates, and external partners — to enable the successful delivery of communications plans.</li> <li>Manage relationships with external vendors (such as PR agencies) as directed to deliver...
