jobs.title: Lead Learning Experience Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The Wikimedia Foundation is seeking a <strong>Lead Learning Experience Designer</strong> to create innovative, engaging, and accessible learning experiences that strengthen the capacity of volunteers and communities across the Wikimedia movement. You'll help contributors develop the confidence, skills, and knowledge they need to participate effectively, navigate Wikimedia’s communities and practices, and grow as contributors. </span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">In this role, you'll partner with Foundation teams, affiliates, researchers, subject matter experts, and volunteers to understand learner needs, identify barriers to participation, and develop learning experiences that support contributors at different stages of their journey. </span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">This role goes beyond traditional instructional design. You’ll think like a learning product designer, finding the right approach for each challenge, whether that means creating an online course on Wikimedia’s learning management system (LMS), WikiLearn, producing multimedia content, experimenting with emerging technologies, or embedding learning into existing experiences and workflows. You will do all this while ensuring the experiences you create are culturally responsive, accessible, and relevant to a global audience. This role is intended for an experienced individual who is comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and making decisions in complex, evolving environments.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Success in this role means being a curious, resourceful problem solver who understands how people learn, grow, and participate. You can think big about how learning can strengthen the Wikimedia movement, while also rolling up your sleeves to build, experiment, and iterate on solutions that make a meaningful difference. </span></p> <h4><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Design and develop innovative digital learning experiences, capacity-strengthening resources, and performance support solutions for contributors across the Wikimedia movement.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Partner with product teams, community groups, researchers, and subject matter experts to identify learning needs, contributor challenges, and opportunities to strengthen participation.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Determine the right learning approach for each opportunity, whether that be a self-paced course, video, interactive experience, AI-enabled support, workshop, or embedded guidance. </span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Develop learning experiences that support contributors in understanding new tools, workflows, policies, governance processes, and community practices across Wikimedia projects.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Rapidly prototype, test and iterate on learning experiences, using modern authoring tools, mult...

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Safety & Security
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>Summary</strong></p> <p>Wikipedia is a trusted source of knowledge the world over, read by over a billion people a month in over 300 languages. It’s offered for free and operated independently by the non-profit Wikimedia Foundation (that’s us), powered mainly by small donations.</p> <p>We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist to help guide Wikipedia’s anti-abuse and security strategy as a member of our <a href="https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Product_Analytics">Product Analytics</a> team. In this role, you will inform our product development strategy by collaborating with product managers, engineers, and others to help our features and interventions make the impact they should. </p> <p>As the Senior Data Scientist, Safety & Security, you will partner closely with the <a href="https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Product_Safety_and_Integrity">Product Safety and Integrity team</a>, whose strategy is built around bringing <a href="https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Product_Safety_and_Integrity/Detecting_abusive_content">cutting-edge AI</a> and <a href="https://diff.wikimedia.org/2026/05/04/better-detecting-bots-and-replacing-our-captcha-part-2/">machine learning</a> techniques to bear on difficult problems in the field of safety and security. You will amplify the impact of the safety and security roadmap through creative data analysis, identifying the right metrics for the job, and developing data strategies that advance our product decisions.</p> <p>This role is an opportunity to be at the center of a pivotal time for Wikipedia, as AI changes how people access knowledge and presents new risks and opportunities in online safety and security.</p> <p>Examples of the kinds of projects you may work on include:</p> <ul> <li>Setting the strategy for how we measure the success of efforts to detect bots and inauthentic account activity (<a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Sockpuppetry">sockpuppetry</a>, in wiki terms).</li> <li>Providing analysis to inform the development of new heuristics and approaches to detect potentially abusive activity on the platform.</li> <li>Collaborating with research scientists and security engineers to develop and evaluate AI models to find malicious user-authored code.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Please note that this role requires availability for critical meetings and synchronous collaboration between 13:00 and 19:00 UTC.</strong></p> <p><strong>You are responsible for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serving as a strategic partner for product managers, engineers, designers, and other colleagues in product development teams.</li> <li>Proactively making recommendations on product direction and data strategy, surfacing insights and interpreting results.</li> <li>Timely delivery of accurate quantitative data and insights to inform strategy, guide product decisions, and assess the impact of product development work – balancing the need to operate in a fast-changing environment with appropriate rigor.</li> <li>Clearly communicating results and data-backed recommendations to stakeholders across different functions, ensuring understanding and guiding decision-making.</li> <li>Building and executing measurement strategy, evaluating experiments using Bayesian & Frequentist approaches, and performing quantitative research to inform product decisions.</li> <li>Developing queries & code to work with large-scale internal and external data jobs.title: Senior Program Officer, Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA)
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>Senior Program Officer, Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA)</strong></p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>Remote and must be based in a country within our <a href="https://wikimediafoundation.org/jobs/#section-13">current hiring locations</a> in the Sub-Saharan Africa region</p> <h3><strong>Summary</strong></h3> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a non-profit organization supporting Wikipedia and other Wikimedia projects. The Foundation operates one of the world’s top five websites and has global reach and impact. At the core of the projects are volunteers who curate the knowledge that the world has come to rely on.  </p> <p>The Community Resources team is the primary funding function of the Wikimedia Foundation ensuring that we support the Affiliates and volunteer contributors of the Wikimedia Movement by offering institutional and individual funding to help achieve the Movement’s goals. To support the movement’s commitment to Knowledge Equity, the team prioritizes proactive outreach to communities that structures of power and privilege have left out.</p> <p>The Senior Program Officer will implement the regional funding programs serving Wikimedian communities in Sub-Saharan Africa. </p> <p><strong>Roles and Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Funding Strategy & Portfolio Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Implement the Community Resources grantmaking strategy while taking into consideration community needs, opportunities, movement trends, and the regional geopolitical and cultural context.</li> <li>Analyze regional and global patterns to shape funding rationales and priorities.</li> <li>Design program activities with colleagues to achieve significant, scalable impact.</li> <li>Manage, implement and monitor the regional grant portfolio to ensure alignment with strategy, criteria, and impact goals.</li> <li>Lead annual grant planning: identify and support prospective and returning grantees, review proposals, co-develop funding rationales with the regional funding committee. This also includes conducting organizational assessments (financial and narrative) to inform funding rationales. </li> <li>Work collaboratively across Foundation teams to support implementation of funding program and team objectives.</li> <li>Represent the Foundation internally and externally as an ambassador for regional knowledge, priorities and insights.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Committee Development</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Build, onboard, and develop regional funding committees aligned with regional needs and opportunities to enable transparent decision-making as part of participatory grantmaking approaches.</li> <li>Set agendas for committee discussions (priorities, financial analysis, partner and regional insights) and facilitate inclusive funding deliberations.</li> <li>Provide context, analysis, and synthesis of committee feedback into funding recommendations and decisions.</li> <li>Provide constructive feedback to applicants and grantees on outcomes and expectations linked to funding decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Community & Funding Partner Management </strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and sustain trust-based relationships with communities, grantees, and applicants across the region; act as primary liaison between WMF and partners.</li> <li>Understand community needs, dynamics, and challenges; support conflict resolution or sensitive discussions when required.</li> <li>Support community, organizational/institutional strengthening of grantee partners; connect them with relevant a...

Breaks down initiatives into features, drive estimation and manage scope. Identifies risks early, and helps the team make pragmatic tradeoffs across quality, velocity, maintainability, and user impact.</li> <li><strong>Implementation</strong> - Improving the mobile Wikipedia product experiences that serve a global, multilingual audience on Android. Leads system design for medium-sized projects and can design and build accessible, adaptable, scalable components. </li> <li><strong>Quality, testing and observability</strong> - Consistently builds software that is easy to test, observe and debug. jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>Software Engineering Internship Program</strong></p> <p><strong>Location: Remote (US)*</strong></p> <p><strong>Duration: 4 months (start in late February 2027)</strong></p> <p><strong>Hours: 40 hrs/week paid experience</strong></p> <p><em>Application Deadline: All interested applicants must apply by November 20, 2026.</em></p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the non-profit organization that operates Wikipedia – one of the most popular websites in the world, accessed by over 1.8 billion unique devices every month. It is the only non-profit in the top 50 websites, supported by a community of millions of individual donors around the world.</p> <p>We are looking for <strong>graduates, non-graduates, or those seeking a career change</strong> who are interested in developing software engineering skills through an immersive “learn on the job” internship program. As an intern, you will be embedded into an engineering team within our Product and Technology departments and assigned a primary project with clear deliverables. Alongside your manager and dedicated mentor, you will learn the inner workings of our open source code that helps to create “a world in which everyone can freely share in the sum of all knowledge”.  You will work with software that serves over half a billion page views per day through Wikipedia (and <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Wikimedia_sister_projects">other Wikimedia projects</a>). The outcome of your work will impact how all people everywhere discover, share, and contribute to free knowledge.</p> <p>Additionally, you will have the opportunity to learn about various departments at the Foundation and connect with the wider volunteer movement and community.</p> <p>Applicants who identify from a group that is underrepresented in the global conversation of technology advancement are encouraged to apply. We’re also welcoming applicants from communities where access to free knowledge and Wikimedia projects are just emerging.</p> <p><strong>PROGRAM DETAILS</strong></p> <p>Successful candidates must be able to commit to a four month, 40hr/week internship which will fall between late February to late June 2027. We will provide laptops and necessary software installed for the duration of the program. This role is 100% remote, and in some cases there may be potential opportunities to participate in in-person events to meet other fellow interns and teams.</p> <p><strong>POTENTIAL TEAM OPPORTUNITIES</strong></p> <p><a href="https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Apps/Team"><strong>Mobile Apps Engineering Team</strong><br></a>The Mobile Apps team's primary objective lies in constructing native Android and iOS applications for the Wikimedia Foundation.</p> <p><a href="https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Editing_team"><strong>Editing</strong><br></a>The Editing team is part of the <a href="https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Contributors">Contributors</a> group. jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Gecko platform is the core engine of our product experience. To maintain competitiveness and user satisfaction, we must move beyond surface-level metrics to understand the deep correlations between engine performance and real-world user behavior. We currently face challenges with data quality, such as bot contamination in nightly telemetry, which obscures our understanding of true performance trends. A dedicated analyst is required to bridge the gap between engineering telemetry and actionable product strategy, ensuring that leadership has high-fidelity data to prioritize performance guardrails and technical budgets.</span></p> <h3><strong>Engineering Deliverables</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Automated Dashboards:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Create and maintain high-level overview dashboards that translate complex performance data into consumable formats for Product Managers and leadership.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Telemetry Gap Analysis:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Audit the Gecko codebase to identify missing collection points or "probes" necessary for a complete understanding of the jobs.title: Director, Portfolio Management (Mozilla.org)
jobs.descriptionHtml: <h1><strong>About Mozilla.org</strong></h1> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/">Mozilla</a> is a mission-driven portfolio of companies and organizations working together to shape an internet that serves people and the public good. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Currently, this portfolio includes: the Mozilla Foundation, which champions our mission through philanthropic risk capital; Mozilla Corporation, which makes Firefox; MZLA, which makes Thunderbird; Mozilla Ventures, which invests in responsible tech startups; Mozilla.ai, which creates open source AI developer tools; Mozilla Data Collective, a data sharing platform for human agency and fair value exchange. It also includes a handful of smaller strategic investments and Mozilla's investment reserve.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Mozilla.org serves as a steward of this portfolio, managing Mozilla's assets and investments to ensure they are used to advance the vision outlined in the Mozilla Manifesto. In this role, it shapes long term strategy, allocates funding and manages Mozilla’s brands. Ultimately, its job is to enable the success of all of Mozilla’s organizations in the pursuit of the overall nonprofit mission.  Over the coming years, our ambition is to actively grow the portfolio—helping existing organizations grow and mature while creating or investing in new organizations that can extend Mozilla’s reach and build long-term financial value.</span></p> <p> </p> <h1><strong>About the Role</strong></h1> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">As a part of the Mozilla.org team,  the </span><strong>Director, Portfolio Management</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> sits at the intersection of portfolio planning, governance, performance management, and cross-organizational execution. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role for an operator who can bring structure to complexity, translate portfolio priorities into clear plans and processes, and ensure leaders across Mozilla have the information, forums, and operating rhythms needed to make effective decisions.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The role reports directly to Mozilla’s COO and, along with everyone on the Mozilla.org team, is housed within the Mozilla Management Company.</span></p> <h1><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h1> <h3><strong>Portfolio Planning & Performance</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Lead the portfolio planning process, integrating organizational strategies, operating plans, capital requirements and portfolio-level priorities. You'll join a Rust-first team that values clear ownership, thoughtful system design, and rigorous thinking about data and reliability.</p> <p>The Knowledge Graph service is a Rust backend that builds a property graph from GitLab’s software development lifecycle (SDLC) and code data. It uses ClickHouse, NATS JetStream, and the Data Insights Platform. It exposes secure graph queries and MCP tools used by AI agents and product features. In this role, you’ll deliver features and improvements in well-scoped areas, learn the broader architecture, and contribute to reliability, observability, and operational readiness.</p> <p>In your first year, you’ll take clear ownership of specific components or features (for example, parts of the SDLC indexing pipeline or query paths). You’ll help reduce single points of failure with better tests and runbooks, and you’ll help the team ship analytical services that are easier to maintain and evolve over time.</p> <p><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll do</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li value="1">Implement and iterate on backend features in the Rust-based Knowledge Graph service, including changes to the query engine, SDLC and code indexing flows, and API endpoints (including MCP endpoints) under guidance from senior and staff engineers.</li> <li value="2">Maintain integrations between Knowledge Graph and the rest of the GitLab platform, working in areas that touch GitLab Rails, the Data Insights Platform (Siphon, NATS, ClickHouse), and GitLab Duo Agent Platform.</li> <li value="3">Contribute to system design discussions by proposing options, raising questions, and documenting decisions, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and maintainability for analytical graph workloads.</li> <li value="4">Improve the operational maturity of the service by adding or enhancing metrics, logging, runbooks, alerts, and small readiness tasks, and by participating in on-call rotation as appropriate for your level and experience.<...

This is a backend-focused role for an engineer with full-stack experience who enjoys balancing work on existing systems with new product development.</p> <p>That work happens in one of GitLab’s oldest and most complex product areas, where you’ll use Ruby on Rails to improve a critical system serving GitLab.com, self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated. jobs.descriptionHtml: <p>Our Enterprise Sales Executives target and close new business with Datadog’s largest, most strategic customers and prospects. In this role you’ll be focused on uncovering the pain points organizations face as they operate in or migrate to a cloud environment at scale as well as delivering the appropriate Datadog solution.</p> <p><em>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. </em></p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prospect into large Fortune 1000 companies while running an efficient sales process</li> <li>Maintain, build and own specific relationship maps for your territory including existing relationships and aspirational contacts</li> <li>Develop a deep comprehension of customer's business</li> <li>Negotiate favorable pricing and business terms with large commercial enterprises by selling value and ROI</li> <li>Handle existing customer expectations while expanding reach and depth into assigned territory</li> <li>Demonstrate resourcefulness when faced with challenges that defy easy solution</li> <li>Have intuitive sense of necessary steps to close business and gain customer validation</li> <li>Identify robust set of business drivers behind all opportunities</li> <li>Ensure high forecasting accuracy and consistency</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Someone with 3+ years closing experience (mix of field selling within mid-market or enterprise)</li> <li>Driven and have met/exceeded direct sales goals of 1M+ and operated with an average deal size of $100k+</li> <li>Able to demonstrate methodology to prospect and build pipeline on your own</li> <li>Experienced in working for an innovative tech company (SaaS, IT infrastructure or similar preferred)</li> <li>Experienced in selling into large Fortune 1000 companies with the ability to win new logos</li> <li>Role requires regular travel to client sites, within your area and other regions, using various modes of transportation (car, train, air), depending on business needs.</li> </ul> <p><em>Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. jobs.descriptionHtml: <h1>Account Executive, DACH, Commercial (Existing Business)</h1> <h2><strong>About Stripe</strong></h2> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Commercial Grower team works with the most ambitious and fastest growing companies in the Commercial segment. Our Commercial segment includes businesses typically processing $20M–$50M in annual payment volume. Stripe’s payments and financial infrastructure unlocks new revenue streams and growth opportunities for these businesses. The Commercial Grower team supports our users to increase their domestic presence whilst expanding into new territories and unlocking new revenue streams. This is a role that can be based out of our Dublin or Berlin office or Germany remote. </p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As an Account Executive (Existing Business), you will deepen and expand partnerships between Stripe and the most innovative and fastest-growing companies in EMEA by helping them to understand how Stripe’s online commerce infrastructure can make payments a competitive advantage for their businesses.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Directly manage and nurture a named account list and develop territory and account plans for winning and expanding business with the Commercial segment.</li> <li>Own the renewal and retention strategy for your territory, proactively identifying and mitigating churn risk.</li> <li>Build and maintain key relationships with C-level executives, while orchestrating the right executive touch points as well.</li> <li>Work with company leaders from multiple functions (e.g., Engineering, Product, and Finance) to lead complex product workshops and financial analyses</li> <li>Orchestrate cross-functional teams including Solutions Architects, Customer Success, and Product Specialists to deliver technical value and drive activation</li> <li>Contribute to shaping our Commercial strategy and building repeatable processes and scaled engagement models.</li> <li>Develop strategies for growing wallet share, driving multi-product adoption, and defending/expanding existing revenue for your named account list.</li> <li>Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process</li> <li>Engage with internal Product and Engineering teams to help drive product and DACH market strategy.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>You are a top class salesperson and relationship manager capable of engaging in business and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including the CTO, COO, and CFO. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding, combined with technical knowledge. A positive attitude and tireless work ethic when encountering blockers to success, whether external or internal. You are naturally curious and analytical and enjoy digging into business models and helping customers quantify their investment decisions.</p> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>Fluent in German</li> <li>7+ years of sales experience, preferably selling a technical p...

jobs.descriptionHtml: <h2><strong>Who we are</strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As an Account Executive, Existing Business, you’ll be managing existing relationships and identifying new opportunities to expand Stripe’s footprint within existing accounts. Specifically, we’re looking for someone who can execute on long-term sales strategies, engage with internal and external stakeholders, align on technical and business requirements with product teams, build value in competitive situations, lead commercial negotiations, and close deals.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Work with existing Stripe customers to develop and execute long-term sales strategies to expand Stripe’s revenue</li> <li>Own the full sales cycle, from business case development, to deal structuring and negotiating, to close</li> <li>Develop account plans and cross sell into your list of strategic customers, driving growth through expansion and new revenue streams </li> <li>Drive deal strategy and commercial negotiations for large, complex renewals</li> <li>Develop relationships with executive stakeholders within your book of business, deeply understanding problems they are solving and helping drive to solutions</li> <li>Be responsible for account mapping and coordinating effective meetings with the appropriate external stakeholders expanding the customer relationship</li> <li>Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process and help shape the Stripe sales culture</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>7+ years of sales experience, preferably selling a technical product, with a track record of top performance</li> <li>5+ years leading complex sales cycles with Enterprise organizations required</li> <li>Ability to understand technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple products</li> <li>Ability to develop and execute account plans spanning multiple business units across complex organizations</li> <li>A knack for working well with a wide range of people, both internally and externally</li> <li>Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders</li> <li>Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements</li> <li>Superior verbal and written communication skills</li> <li>Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment</li> <li>Strong interest in technology and a deep understanding of the space</li> </ul> <p>In office locations include: Chicago, New York</p> <p>Remote locations include: Remote - East  </p>

jobs.title: Senior Principal, Sales Compensation Design & Strategy
jobs.descriptionHtml: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations</h3> <ul> <li>US</li> </ul> <p><strong>Applications will be accepted until October 13, 2026.</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>The Global GTM Strategy, Planning and Operations team at Cloudflare supports our high-growth Sales organization through scalable, AI supported GTM planning and operations. We focus on thoughtful planning of sales capacity, segmentation, territory carving, quota setting, and compensation design while ensuring clear rules of engagement for our Sales Team. Our goal is to establish a cohesive, consistent process framework that can support high growth, enable the Company's strategy, and accelerate Cloudflare's leadership in the developer and AI-native business segments.</p> <p>As the Senior Principal, Sales Compensation Design & Strategy, you will design and manage Cloudflare's Sales Compensation Plans across all customer facing teams including Sales, Technical Sales, Partner Sales, and Customer Success & Experience, to ensure they are motivating, aligned with Cloudflare's strategy, and industry leading. This is a high visibility role with significant executive engagement, including leading C-level discussions with our CRO, CFO, CPO, and COO, and serving as the design authority on the Executive Compensation Steering Committee.</p> <p>You will architect new compensation metrics that reflect how Cloudflare monetizes a developer first, AI supportive business - including consumption, adoption, and platform attach - and ensure roles, territories, and quotas align with compensation plans to achieve our GTM objectives. You will establish a governance framework for efficient compensation planning and partner closely with the Compensation Administration and Operations Teams to ensure effective implementation and accurate payouts. A strong understanding of SaaS bookings, monetization approaches, and consumption and adoption models is essential.</p> <p>The scope of executive influence, the architectural work required to support our developer/AI business model, and the AI-native transformation of the compensation design function make this seat fundamental to our GTM execution strateg...

jobs.title: Support Engineer (APAC - Weekends)
jobs.descriptionHtml: Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. We are seeking Support Engineers to provide world-class developer support for anyone experiencing issues or seeking guidance when using Supabase. The support team is globally distributed with a strong focus on minimizing time to fix, and works closely with the product engineering and growth teams. You will: Provide initial and timely responses to all support cases for a variety of topics, from billing or pre-sales requests to optimization or implementation questions. Triage support cases including directing users to previous answers, code examples, documentation, or escalating to specific technical or business team members. Monitor multiple feedback channels, e.g. Github Issues & Discussions (check them here: https://github.com/supabase/supabase/issues ). Identify where internal tooling might be developed or obtained to improve support efficiency. Reproduce issues, create test cases and improve test coverage, if you have experience with testing. You are: Experienced in customer support, with 3+ years of experience providing developer support to technical customers. Proficient in SQL (ideally PostgreSQL). You feel comfortable with complex SQL queries. If you have a database administration experience, it’s a plus. Excellent communication skills and fluency in English. Skilled in using Linux/Unix operating systems and the command line. Experienced working with GitHub Issues and Discussions. Bonus points if you're familiar with popular JavaScript frameworks like React, Vue, and Svelte and have some experience with Node.js. Having a degree in Computer Science is a plus too. Timezones & Logistics It’s a full-time position permanently, with four 10-hour shifts covering weekends during APAC Hours: 00:00-10:00 UTC We are primarily looking for someone in Southeast Asia or India time zones for this shift. This position covers Friday → Monday based on the above UTC times, so this may vary slightly for your specific timezone. What We Offer Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. About the Team Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. ~400 team members 60+ countries 20+ languages spoken Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.title: Account Manager - India
jobs.descriptionHtml: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role This role partners directly with enterprise customers building and deploying conversational agents on the ElevenLabs Agents Platform. The focus is hands-on execution - advising on agent design, personas, conversation flows, tool integrations, and voice customisation to deliver clear business outcomes in production environments. You will guide customers through best practices for deploying and scaling agents across web, mobile, and telephony, and for integrating agents with existing data sources and systems. You will analyze agent performance data and conversational logs to identify friction points and optimization opportunities that improve accuracy, user experience, and reliability at scale. In parallel, you will own expansion outcomes across a defined portfolio of enterprise accounts. Success is measured by net revenue retention and sustained multi-product adoption. You will identify expansion opportunities, drive cross-sell through deeper agent usage, and partner with Sales, Engineering, and Account Managers to convert technical success into durable revenue growth and long-term customer commitment. Requirements 7-11 years of Customer Success or Account Management experience supporting complex B2B SaaS, Developer Tools, or AI/ML products in India Familiarity and experience with building and deploying AI agents Familiarity and experience with API Integration...

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Our world-class sales organization is looking for self-motivated teammates with high social intelligence and a natural inclination for selling and partnering to accelerate our growth as we scale rapidly! Individuals who are eager to learn, embrace challenges, and passionate about succeeding will thrive at Ramp. Our Partner Development Representatives act as the initial point of contact and are responsible for hunting and qualifying partners to build new partnerships that drive sales opportunities for Ramp.

What You’ll Do

  • Identify and source new partner opportunities with the accounting sector through inbound qualification and direct outreach

  • Engage and qualify prospective partners via a variety of methods, including but not limited to: emails, calls, social channels, conferences and events

  • Conduct in-depth primary and secondary research to understand service offerings, firmographics, organizational structure and key stakeholders to assess potential fit

  • Collarboate cross-functionally with Channel partner Managers, Marketing, Operations and Direct Sales to strategically grow Ramp’s Partner ecosystem

  • Educate accounting leaders and firm stakeholders on Ramp’s partnership program and convey the value Ramp can provide to the prospective partner firm and their clients 

  • Ideate on new and unique ways to build and develop partner relationships

  • Maintain accurate partner relationship data within Salesforce

What You Need

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Excellent listening skills and energetic and professional phone and Zoom presence

  • High level of comfort with sales, prospecting and both virtual and in-person

  • Dedication to tracking and improving performance and efficiency on a daily basis

  • Deep interest in understanding specific business challenges with the different verticals

  • Sense of entrepreneurship: a self-starter with a high sense of urgency, ability to work within undefined processes and a will to find a way

About the Role

You will be a front-line manager to a group of Account Executives (AEs) who will be hunting, pitching, and closing new business for Ramp. You will be responsible for 1:1 coaching, mentoring, and strategy development, working closely with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Product, and the executive team to drive positive outcomes for this segment. As a key member of the sales leadership team, you will have the opportunity to help build and refine Ramp’s sales development motion.

What You'll Do

  • Manage, develop and execute career development and leadership plan for a group of Account Executives and provide daily 1:1 mentoring and coaching

  • Set and maintain a high-performing culture and morale by overseeing the daily activities and quota performance management of individual AEs to ensure key performance metrics are met

  • Hire and train new AEs on Ramp’s product, buyer personas, competition, and tools through various methods (ie. role-plays)

  • Strategize with sales and marketing counterparts on pipeline and prospecting initiatives to meet company objectives

  • Build dashboards and report on customer and team performance and forecast to senior leadership

  • Improve team output and efficiency over time by optimizing systems and processes

  • Build and execute on pipeline with new clients and partners to run the end-to-end sales process

  • Establish a library of playbook resources for the AE team

  • Partner with Ops to create and polish existing metrics that evaluate the individual and team’s performance

  • Represent the AE team cross-functionally with leaders of other departments

What You’ll Need

  • Minimum 5 years of quota carrying sales experience as an individual contributor

  • Minimum 3 years of experience building and leading successful, high-performing sales teams

  • Demonstrated success in fast-paced, results-oriented GTM environments, ideally at SaaS companies, and history of consistently performing above quota in an outbound sales environment

  • Passion and excitement for hiring, with a thoughtful approach to team planning and development

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml: About Sentry Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building. Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future. About the role Sentry already sees the moment software breaks: the error, the trace, the replay, the commit that caused it. Seer, our AI debugger, uses all of that to figure out what went wrong and how to fix it. We're looking for a Staff engineer to help decide how that system should evolve as models improve every few months. Some of what we build today will be obsolete by next spring. Part of the job is knowing which parts, and building the rest to last. In this role you will Build state-of-the-art agentic AI systems to triage, debug, and solve real production issues Set technical direction for how our agents get context, use tools, and decide when they're done Build the evals that tell us whether a new model or prompt actually helped, fast enough that people use them Decide when to use a frontier model, a smaller one, or one we trained, and revisit that as cost and capability shift Leverage Sentry’s novel (and massive) dataset of errors, spans, and profiles Own major AI initiatives end to end, alongside the developers and product teams shipping them Run what you ship in production and debug it with Sentry You'll love this job if you Are driven by impact and enjoy working on high-stakes, high-visibility projects Enjoy building things. You will have the opportunity to join the AI/ML team as one of its foundational members Thrive in cross-functional teams and enjoy building features alongside developers and product teams Qualifications You've shipped an LLM-backed system people depended on, and can tell us what broke You have strong opinions on agent design and have changed at least one in the last year You've trained or fine-tuned models when it was the right call, and you know when it isn't You write solid production Python You've owned a system or component and led work across multiple engineers and teams, with a design doc people actually read You write clear technical documentation, mentor other engineers, and present to technical audiences The base salary range (or hourly wage range, if applicable) that Sentry reasonably expects to pay for this position is $240,000 to $400,000. A successful candidate’s actual base salary (or hourly wage) amount will be determined by a variety of relevant factors including, without limitation, the candidate’s work location, education, work and other relevant experience, skills, and job-related knowledge. A successful candidate will be eligible to participate in Sentry’s employee benefit plans/programs applicable to the candidate’s position (including incentive compensation, equity grants, paid time off, and group health insurance coverage). See Sentry Benefits for more details about the Company’s benefit plans/programs. Equal Opportunity at Sentry Sentry is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to its employees and candidates for employment regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or other legally-protected characteristic. This commitment includes the provision of reasonable accommodations to employees and candidates for employment with physical or mental disabilities who require such accommodations in order to (a) perform the essential functions of their jobs, or (b) seek employment with Sentry. We strive to build a diverse team, with an inclusive culture where every teammate can thrive. Sentry is an open-source company because we believe that everyone, everywhere, should have the ability and tools to make great software. Software should be accessible. jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager - EMEA
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About PostHog

PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.

We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:

  • A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics, replay vision, AI observability, and error tracking

  • PostHog MCP for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data

  • Data warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

We are:

  1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

  2. Default alive. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

  3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible.

 

Things we care about

  • Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

  • Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams and make product decisions. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

  • Shipping fast: Why not now? We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-eff...

PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.

  • PostHog MCP for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data

  • Data warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

We are:

  1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

  2. Default alive. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

  3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the role: 

We are seeking talented distributed systems engineers who are passionate about building innovative solutions for application deployment. Your mission will be to enhance the capabilities of Replit Infrastructure, optimize performance across global regions, and drive efficiency while delivering an exceptional user experience. If you have a strong foundation in software development, a deep understanding of cloud technologies, and a track record of delivering high-quality code, we want to hear from you. 

In this role you will:

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement these features, empowering developers with a comprehensive suite of tools to build and deploy their applications efficiently.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Mobile
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the role:

We're seeking an Engineering Manager, Mobile to lead the future of our mobile experiences at Replit. In this role, you'll build and manage a team that bridges design and engineering to create intuitive, performant mobile interfaces that make software creation accessible on any device. You'll guide your team in building production-ready frameworks and patterns that enable high-quality in-product experiences, ensuring users can create apps from their phones or tablets with the same power as desktop.

You will:

  • Build, mentor, and grow a team of mobile design engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and design craftsmanship

  • Define the technical vision and strategy for mobile design systems, establishing frameworks and patterns that ship to production and scale across iOS, Android, and responsive web

  • Partner closely with design, product, and engineering leadership to prioritize mobile initiatives and ensure seamless collaboration between design and development teams

  • Drive best practices for mobile-first development, ensuring your team builds production-grade patterns that deliver consistent, high-quality experiences while optimizing for performance

  • Oversee the architecture of complex mobile UI components and systems, providing technical guidance and code review to maintain high standards

  • Champion accessible, responsive interfaces through well-architected frameworks, and establish processes that improve mobile design-to-development workflow

  • Balance hands-on technical contribution with people management, staying close enough to the code to guide architectural decisions

Required skills and experience:

  • 3+ years of engineering management experience with a track record of building and scaling high-performing teams, plus proven experience building production frameworks and component systems that scale across products

  • Deep technical background with mobile development, including experience with some of the following: mobile-specific web APIs, native mobile development (Swift/Kotlin), React and React Native (or similar cross-platform frameworks), PWAs, mobile design patterns, and complex UI animations and gesture-based interactions

  • Excellent communication skills to balance technical leadership with people management, including mentoring, performance management, and career development

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Active Replit mobile user passionate about accessible software creation, with experience building or leading mobile design or developer tools teams

  • Interest in AI on mobile devices and contributions to open-source mobile design systems or UI libraries

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml: About Us: AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal. Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now. Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp , Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale. We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation. Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g., Seaborn , Luigi ), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience. About the Role: We're hiring the first Account Managers at Modal. You'll report to the Regional Director of Account Management and be a founding member of the team. This function does not exist yet. There is no playbook, no territory map, no established motion. You'll own a book of business from day one and build the motion at the same time — from fast-moving AI startups to large enterprise teams running critical infrastructure on Modal. This is a commercial role with a revenue target. You'll be measured on retention and expansion across your accounts. While you won't be delivering the technical recommendations and implementation, the work is technical by nature. Our customers are engineers running GPU workloads, inference, and batch jobs in production, and you need to hold your own in those conversations. The profile we're hiring is a technical account manager. You've worked at companies that are deeply technical and consumption in nature. You bring the commercial instincts to grow revenue from an existing base and enough technical depth to know which conversation actually matters. And you can credibly work with a CxO all the way down to a Developer. What the Role Is: A founding seat. You're helping build the AM function with us, not joining one that already runs. The account plans, expansion motions, and customer cadence you and the rest of the founding team figure out are what we scale to every AM we hire after you. A technical customer-facing role. You'll work directly with Developers and ML teams on what they're building and how Modal fits. You translate and triage the deeper technical work to FDEs and Product when it's needed. A book of business. You’ll own a set of accounts and be responsible for the revenue that comes from them. Expect to be meeting with customers in your first few days because the best playbooks are built from real experiences. What the Role Is Not: A traditional post-sales role. You're measured on revenue, not health scores. An on-call support function. You're not fixing bugs or triaging tickets. You're driving growth. A technical delivery role. You're not implementing for the customer. You know where the technical work goes and you pull in the right people. An inherited motion. Nothing is handed to you. If you identify gaps in process, tooling, or a playbook — you help build it. A single-lane job. Our priorities go customer → company → team → me. We focus on delivering maximum impact vs. "this is my job". What You'll Achieve: Build Modal's account management function and iterate on it as we scale the business Own and deliver on a revenue target across your book of accounts Grow an account's first use case, expand into a second, and drive standardization across the Modal platform Get fluent enough in Modal to hold your own with engineering teams on their workloads, and know when to pull in FDEs, Support, or Product Work with Sales, Soluti...

Kinsta is one of the top providers of managed hosting for WordPress, with a growing club of 120,000+ businesses including startups, universities, and Fortune 500 firms. We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers.
 
That's because, to us, each day is a chance to grow. As a team, we continuously inspire each other to learn new and better ways to make an impact. We own our jobs proudly - our leaders don't hold our hands, but they're in our corner whenever we ask for help - and our environment is flexible and remote-first.
 
We are looking for a motivated Account Manager in the Asia-Pacific region who will be responsible for managing existing client accounts and generating additional revenue by working with customers on upselling, cross-selling, and retention. Account managers are also tasked with retaining the client’s business and growing these accounts through upsells and cross-sells. 
 
An ideal candidate is someone who is proactive and has a knack for building relationships. Also, someone who is tech-savvy, process-driven, and loves the thrill of seeking out additional revenue and closing deals!

jobs.descriptionHtml: Tentang Perusahaan PT Sinar Lampu Indonesia (Sanwa Group) Merupakan perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang Lampu Hias, Perusahaan melayani kebutuhan pelanggan baik untuk proyek maupun konsumen, serta berhubungan dengan berbagai pihak seperti kontraktor, developer, dan pelanggan potensial. Ini adalah posisi Sales di bidang desain interior dan renovasi, dengan fokus pada mencari pelanggan baru, menjaga hubungan dengan pelanggan yang sudah ada, serta mengelola proyek di sektor perumahan, komersial, dan perusahaan renovasi. **Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan :** 1. Mencari pelanggan baru, mempertahankan pelanggan yang sudah ada, serta melakukan follow-up terhadap proyek perumahan, lokasi komersial, dan perusahaan renovasi. 2. Mengunjungi lokasi proyek, melakukan pengukuran, mencatat kondisi ruangan dan pekerjaan, membuat penawaran harga (quotation), serta menangani pesanan. 3. Melayani pelanggan di showroom/pameran, memberikan pelayanan, serta mendampingi pelanggan untuk melihat sampel dan memilih produk. 4. Melakukan follow-up terhadap proses produksi, pemasangan/instalasi, dan masalah setelah penjualan (after-sales), serta segera melaporkannya kepada manajemen. 5. Memiliki pengalaman 1–3 tahun di bidang sales, lebih disukai yang memiliki pengalaman di bidang interior. 3. Memahami penjualan B2B dan B2C serta memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik. 4. Bersedia bekerja secara mobile/outdoor (banyak bekerja di lapangan). 5. Bersedia lembur apabila diperlukan. 6. Jujur, disiplin, dan bertanggung jawab. Jenis Pekerjaan: Kontrak Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

jobs.descriptionHtml: Job Posting Date2026.10.23 Job TypeRegular TeamEngineering & IT Location BSD City, Indonesia About TravelokaTraveloka is Southeast Asia’s leading all-in-one travel platform connecting millions globally with trusted, world-class experiences. With over 140 million app downloads and more than 40 million monthly active users, Traveloka stands as one of the most popular travel apps in the region. **Job Description** =================== *Job ID: MJ000418* **About Traveloka** Traveloka is Southeast Asia's leading travel and lifestyle super-app. We connect tens of millions of travellers across the region with flights, hotels, experiences, financial services, and more — all from a single platform. Since our founding in 2012, we have expanded to eleven markets, processed billions of dollars in transactions, and built one of the most recognised consumer brands in the region. We move fast because the region demands it. Southeast Asia is young, mobile-first, and growing faster than almost anywhere else on earth. We are not transplanting a Western playbook — we are writing a new one, from scratch, for a market that does not look like anywhere else — and we are calling for people who want to be part of that. **About the Team** Information Security at Traveloka protects one of Southeast Asia's largest travel platforms — millions of travellers, their payments, and their trust across 11 markets. We are the team that lets hundreds of engineers ship fast without shipping risk: building secure-by-default infrastructure, hunting threats in real time, and setting the standards every product team is held to. As we scale and as AI becomes native to how we build, the attack surface grows and our work only gets more critical. Here you defend at genuine scale and own outcomes, not tickets. Whether you are hardening systems through security engineering or running detection and response in security operations, you will make decisions that move the whole company. If you want your security work to matter to real people across the region, you will fit right in. As a DevSecOps Engineer, you are the technical authority for security within the software development lifecycle, driving the most complex security-in-pipeline programs, setting the standards your function operates by, and shaping how secure development is practiced across Traveloka as an individual contributor. **Job Scope:** * Own and drive the most complex, highest-impact SDLC security programs end-to-end, from scoping and embedding controls into CI/CD workflows through to remediation validation and organisational learning * Define and enforce the technical standards, scanning methodologies, and tooling frameworks your function operates by — covering vulnerability detection in code and 3rd-party libraries — ensuring consistency, quality, and continuous improvement across all security work in the build pipeline * Identify systemic gaps in secure coding practice and pipeline security coverage across the engineering organisation, and lead cross-functional improvement programs that produce lasting structural change in how Traveloka builds software securely * Act as the senior technical authority in security discussions with engineering, product, and business leadership, providing the depth of reasoning and credibility that helps the organisation make sound, defensible decisions on security rules and build-time controls * Influence engineering teams toward secure coding and design practices through deep technical credibility, shaping how security is embedded into Traveloka’s development workflows as an individual contributor * Define how AI tools are adopted within secure development workflows, establishing the standards for responsible use and modeling the judgment that separates genuine security acceleration from risk amplification * Define and own Traveloka’s CI/CD pipeline security architecture, setting the standards for how security controls are embedded across build workflows and ensuring coverag...

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Description** FINNS Beach Club is looking for a talented individual who is passionate about digital design, user experience, and visual craftsmanship. We are currently seeking a UI/UX Designer to join our growing marketing team and shape the digital presence of one of the world’s most iconic destinations. **Summary** FINNS World's Best Beach Club is not just a beach club; it's a destination where dreams come alive! We pride ourselves on creating exhilarating entertainment, vibrant energy, and unforgettable F&B experiences. Nestled along the breathtaking Bali coastline, we provide a one-of-a-kind party atmosphere that leaves our guests craving for more. **Responsibilities** * Craft intuitive, engaging, and visually stunning user interfaces across web and mobile platforms, bringing unique brand campaigns to life with strong visual craftsmanship. * Build, expand, and maintain scalable Design Systems and component libraries to ensure visual consistency across all digital touchpoints. * Collaborate closely with Web Developers, Marketing teams, and various departments across FINNS to ensure seamless design handoffs and technical feasibility. * Analyse feedback, analytics, and UI/UX trends to continually optimise digital journeys and conversion rates. * Establish design standards, guidelines, and best practices for the company's digital ecosystem. **Qualifications** * Minimum 2–3 years of experience as a UI/UX Designer or similar role. * Strong written and spoken communication skills in both English and Bahasa Indonesia. * Strong mastery of Figma, including advanced features such as Design Tokens, Auto-Layout, Components, and Prototyping. * Proven hands-on experience in building, documenting, and managing Design Systems and component libraries (Figma, tokens, auto-layout, etc.). * Solid understanding of user-centred design principles and responsive web design. * Basic-to-intermediate understanding of UX Writing, with the ability to write functional copy. * Basic understanding of HTML/CSS capabilities and technical constraints for smooth dev-handoffs. * Portfolio demonstrating strong visual design sense, end-to-end UX processes, and design system. * Excellent problem-solving skills, visual accuracy, and strong attention to detail. * Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, high-energy environment. Work Location: In person

jobs.company: WowSuite, DFO Performance, OnPoint Health Media & Tech
jobs.descriptionHtml: **CONVERSION RATE OPTIMIZATION (CRO) SPECIALIST - AI FIRST** **Company:** WowSuite **Location:** Jakarta, Indonesia **Type:** Full-time, Remote **Team:** CRO / Growth / Creative **THE ROLE** WowSuite is hiring a hands-on CRO Specialist to improve the commercial performance of ecommerce, lead-generation, subscription and telehealth funnels. We run Meta, Taboola and Outbrain style funnels, including presell pages, index pages, checkouts and upsells. Most of our traffic is paid and mobile. This is not a basic "button color" CRO role or a pure design role. You will use data, customer behavior, AI and experimentation to identify where funnels lose money, determine why, and decide what to test next. This is an AI-first role. AI should be part of your normal workflow for research, analytics, testing, QA and reporting. Copy and design skills are a strong bonus, but not the main requirement. **MAIN GOAL** Increase profitable revenue from the traffic we already have. Performance is measured by commercial results, not activity. **WHAT YOU WILL OWN** * Analyze the full funnel from traffic source through landing page, checkout, payment, upsells and retention. * Identify the highest-value conversion and economic constraints using data. * Build and prioritize a CRO testing backlog based on expected commercial impact. * Design and analyze structured A/B tests with clear hypotheses, primary metrics and guardrails. * Improve CVR, revenue per visitor/click, AOV, payment completion, upsell rate and profitability. * Segment performance by traffic source, campaign, device, geography and funnel path. * Use analytics, heatmaps, session recordings, reviews, support data and customer research to understand behavior. * Turn findings into specific test recommendations for offers, copy, UX, page structure, checkout, proof and payment flows. * Give clear briefs to designers, copywriters and developers and review execution against the CRO hypothesis. * Use AI for research, analysis, SQL/formulas, test ideas, variants and reporting. * QA tests across mobile, desktop, tracking, pricing, checkout and payment. * Clearly report what was tested, why, the result, economic impact, decision and next test. * Move winners live quickly. **REQUIRED SKILLS** You should be strong in: * CRO and full-funnel analysis. * Ecommerce, lead generation or digital growth. * A/B testing and structured experimentation. * Funnel and step-level conversion analysis. * CVR, revenue per visitor/click, AOV, CAC/CPA and commercial metrics. * Traffic, campaign, device and geography segmentation. * GA4, PostHog, OpenPanel or similar analytics tools. * Excel or Google Sheets. * Heatmaps and session recordings. * AI-assisted research, analytics and reporting. * Professional written and spoken English. SQL or AI-assisted SQL is a strong advantage. **BONUS SKILLS** * Copywriting and offer presentation. * Mobile-first UX and ecommerce design. * Figma or equivalent wireframing/design tools. * Creating wireframes, layouts and CRO mockups. **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE** * Direct-response ecommerce. * Meta, Taboola or Outbrain traffic. * Subscription or membership funnels. * Telehealth or health ecommerce. * Performance advertising. * Checkout and payment optimization. * High-volume A/B testing. **HOW WE WORK** * Profit before vanity metrics. * Funnel before page. * Diagnosis before ideas. * Proof before decoration. * Clarity before cleverness. * Trust before urgency. * Mobile first when traffic is mobile. * Every test requires a hypothesis, primary metric and guardrail. * Winners go live quickly. * Then we move to the next highest-value constraint. **WHO WILL DO WELL** We want someone who can move from analysis to execution without waiting for multiple teams. You should be able to read the numbers, identify the likely problem, research it, write a clear test brief, QA the implementation and determine whether the business result improved. If you can also write copy or sketch layouts, even better. **APPLI...

jobs.title: Technical Expert, Geologist
jobs.descriptionHtml: Requisition ID: 147951 Location: Papua, ID, 99967 Category: Engineering Services The Underground Geology Group has a major role in the success of PTFI as it continues to operate the mines and bring new mines in development and production; ensuring that the geological models and ore body knowledge underpinning the underground operations are reliable; that structural, lithological and mineralization controls are understood and communicated to design and operating teams; and, that the mines are supported by geological data and reconciliation to deliver the expected revenue stream. The work carried out by the group includes drilling and core logging, geological mapping, structural interpretation, 3D geological modelling, resource and reserve support, grade control and reconciliation, geometallurgical characterization, and integration of geological data with geotechnical, hydrology and cave performance evaluation. ***Additional Responsibilities:*** * The Technical Expert Geology role exists to provide technical leadership in geology to PTFI’s mines. The intent of the role is provide: * Core underground geological expertise and ore body knowledge across operating and developing mines, including KL’s transition from development to production. * Reliable geological models, structural interpretation and domain definitions that underpin mine design, ground support and draw control in an operational environment * Assist in the development of the Underground Geology group that provides key technical advice and support to the Grasberg Underground Operations. * Geological interpretation, modelling and reconciliation for the GBC, DMLZ and Kucing Liar (KL) caving operations and for the Big Gossan stoping operation, all within PTFI’s Grasberg business unit. * Own geological data quality, including drilling, core logging, mapping, sampling and QA/QC, and the integration of structure, lithology, alteration and mineralization domains with geotechnical and hydrology teams. * Assist in the development of partnering arrangements with key specialist providers, such as drilling contractors, assay laboratories and geological technology vendors. * Provide expert advice to ensure that best geological practice in drilling, logging, mapping, modelling and interpretation is applied to the underground mines. * Provide expert advice to ensure that appropriate geological decisions are undertaken. These will range from infill drilling design and geological model updates to structural and lithological controls on cave behavior, to ore/waste reconciliation and draw control. * Develop, coach and mentor national staff to build capacity, ensure knowledge transfer and that geological analyses follow international best practices. * Provide professional advice/recommendations to PTFI leadership and supervisory staff. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Geology, Geological Engineering or Earth Science, or acceptable Tertiary qualifications, with at least ten (10) years of working experience in the application of geology to underground mining. * Demonstrated expertise in structural geology, 3D geological modelling and ore body knowledge as applied to underground mining, preferably block or panel cave operations in porphyry and skarn copper-gold systems. * Demonstrated ability to work with others and communicate complex issues. * Highly focused on geological interpretation and modelling as applied to underground mining and assessing geological aspects of underground mine production. This requires an in-depth knowledge of structural geology, ore deposit geology and cave mining. * Ability to interpret sparse and complex geological data, resolve uncertainty and convey the results to senior management. * Ability to anticipate geological risks to production and develop preventive actions as opposed to corrective actions. * Strong supervisory and leadership skills. * Strong analytical thinking skills. * Ability to work in a culturally diversified workforce. * Strong co...
