jobs.title: Director of Engineering Operations (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

As Director of Engineering Operations, you will build structured, repeatable operating capability across Mechanical, Electrical and Controls. You will own engineering planning and capacity reporting, configuration and release administration, supplier engineering readiness, and end-to-end engineering and supplier quality. This is a functional leadership role: you will set the processes that engineering must follow, while authorised engineers keep design approval, Systems Engineering keeps requirements governance, and Commercial Procurement keeps contracts.

What You'll Do

  • Own engineering planning, workload and capacity reporting so that commitments reflect real capacity.

  • Lead configuration and release administration, including Inventor licensing, Autodesk Vault and Jama administration, as a controlled and auditable capability.

  • Define and drive the planning, configuration, release and quality processes that Mechanical, Electrical and Controls are required to follow.

  • Ensure suppliers receive controlled, revision-correct technical information through readiness coordination with the Supply Chain Engineer.

  • Build a functioning supplier-quality and nonconformance process, and stand up the Engineering Quality Lead and Supplier Quality Engineer capability as it is approved.

  • Partner with Systems Engineering, the Systems Integration team, Commercial Procurement and the PMO to keep cross-functional handoffs clean and to give Integration trustworthy readiness evidence.

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • Experience in engineering configuration management, release control and change control in a hardware engineering environment.

  • Hands-on knowledge of engineering data and release tools such as Jama, Autodesk Vault or Inventor, or comparable PLM/PDM systems.

  • Experience running supplier technical coordination and quality or nonconformance processes, including auditable conformity records.

  • Proven ability to plan and manage engineering capacity and workload across multiple disciplines.

  • Leadership experience managing managers or senior specialists, and building process ownership within a team.

  • Clear, candid communication with senior leaders, with the judgement to escalate only genuine cross-functional trade-offs.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Background in systems engineering or systems integration on complex hardware programmes.

  • Experience standing up a new quality function from a small base, including supplier quality engineering.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineering Director (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

As the Mechanical Engineering Director at Focused Energy, you will design, build, and lead the Mechanical Engineering department, establishing its organizational structure, operating model, engineering standards, and budget. You will oversee end-to-end mechanical capability across key delivery programs, managing peer Chief Mechanical Engineers. Your leadership will ensure that mechanical subsystems are rigorously designed, manufactured, verified, and delivered on schedule to Systems Integration.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Mechanical Engineering department's structure, headcount, budget forecasting, and capacity allocation across active delivery programs.

  • Lead and develop peer Chief Mechanical Engineers and emerging capability leads, defining delegated technical authority frameworks and clear accountability.

  • Scale and build out the five core mechanical capability areas in phased stages aligned with funded project workloads.

  • Enforce robust mechanical design review governance, ensuring all released designs contain verified load cases, tolerances, and interface evidence.

  • Establish manufacturing and supplier engineering capabilities early in the lifecycle to optimize design-for-manufacture, assembly, and test readiness.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Systems Integration, Engineering Operations, Procurement, Quality, and Facilities to ensure seamless subsystem handovers at readiness gates.

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • Extensive leadership experience building, structuring, and scaling engineering organizations, teams, and departmental budgets.

  • Strong background across the full mechanical engineering lifecycle, spanning initial concept, supplier manufacturing, assembly, testing, and integration handover.

  • Proven track record of establishing formal design review cadences, delegated authority models, and engineering release standards.

  • Experience managing engineering resource allocation and resolving capacity trade-offs across concurrent, complex technical programs.

  • Demonstrated capability in mentoring technical leads and creating distinct career progression pathways for both management and specialist individual contributors.

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to communicate project risks, trade-offs, and commitments transparently to executive stakeholders.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Technical familiarity with high-complexity domains such as vacuum systems, cryogenics, thermal management, fluids, or precision mechanical systems.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy & SourceLight

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. As a spin-out of Focused Energy, SourceLight is turning breakthrough laser-driven radiation source technology into practical solutions for some of the world's most demanding inspection and material characterization challenges.

We are building on cutting-edge scientific innovation to develop scalable technology for industrial applications, including nuclear waste characterization, security screening, and non-destructive testing of safety-critical components.

As our technology moves from development toward industrial application, building a robust and scalable supply chain is essential to our success.

Your Role

We are looking for a Procurement & Supply Chain Manager to establish and lead this function from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity to take ownership of procurement and supplier strategy across the company, shaping how we identify, qualify, engage, and manage suppliers while ensuring our engineering teams have the components and resources they need to deliver.

You will work closely with our Product and Engineering teams, Finance, Legal, and external partners to establish company-wide procurement standards, negotiate complex technical and commercial agreements, and build a supplier ecosystem capable of supporting our growth.

Initially operating as a senior individual contributor, you will have significant autonomy and influence over how this function develops. As SourceLight scales, you will have the opportunity to expand the team, introduce new capabilities, and evolve procurement and supply chain into a fully established organizational function.

If you enjoy building structure in a fast-moving technical environment, navigating complex supplier relationships, and creating the operational foundations that enable innovative technology to reach the market, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact.

  • Build and lead the Procurement & Supply Chain function: Establish the strategy, processes, tools, and operating standards required to support procurement across all SourceLight product and engineering teams.

  • Enable engineering and product teams: Take ownership of procurement activities from request through purchase order and supplier follow-up, allowing technical teams to focus on engineering, integration, testing, and product development.

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

jobs.descriptionHtml: ***Consultant as Low Carbon Technology Analyst - Energy and Sustainable Business Program*** ***This is a hybrid position which requires 8 days per month in the office. You will be based in our office in WRI Indonesia, Jakarta. Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position.*** **Program Overview** WRI Indonesia’s Energy and Sustainability Business (ESB) Portfolio works to advance reliable, clean energy while reducing carbon emissions and supporting economic development. Recognizing the interconnected nature of economic, social, and environmental goals, the program collaborates across disciplines, including with WRI’s cities, climate, and ocean teams to integrate low-carbon technologies, quantitative models, and policy tools. These efforts align with national priorities such as accelerating Indonesia’s net-zero targets by 2050 for industry and 2060 for the broader economy. The Sustainable Energy Transition in Indonesia (SETI) project is aiming to accelerate the achievement of Indonesia’s net zero or energy transition target, working to drive the energy transition in the industrial and built environment sectors. This collaborative project between the German and Indonesian governments supports energy efficiency and renewable energy implementation in high-energy sectors and is led by the Directorate of New and Renewable Energy and Energy Conservation under the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (MEMR), as well as advised by the Ministry of Industry’s Green Industry Center and other agencies. SETI is managed by a consortium including GIZ, WRI Indonesia, IESR, Yayasan Cerah, LPEM FEB UI, and Fraunhofer, serving as the project’s implementers. SETI project is divided into four focuses: policy support, sustainable finance, industrial energy lab, and built environment energy lab.WRI Indonesia is the main implementation partner for the industrial energy lab, thus responsible in providing technical assistance, capacity building, and research to accelerate energy transition in the industrial sector. **Job Highlight** The Low Carbon Technology Analyst will support WRI Indonesia ESB portfolio projects, specifically Sustainable Energy Transition in Indonesia (SETI) project, by supporting industries in implementing energy efficiency and/or renewable energy through technical assistance and consultations. This includes conducting and reviewing technical and techno-economic analysis, energy and emission savings potential calculations, and convening these messages to company management to support implementation decision making. The Analyst should have a solid understanding of energy efficiency and renewable energy technologies, electrical and heat related systems in industries, implementation considerations of companies for energy efficiency and renewable energy projects, as well as associated business models and techno-economic calculations. Moreover, this position will support the project planning and implementation activities through coordination with relevant personnels to ensure fulfilment of administrative requirement of project activities. This position will be based in Jakarta with office-flex working arrangement. Reporting directly to SETI Senior Lead while working collaboratively with the Senior Energy Efficiency Specialist, whilst supporting the Energy and Sustainable Business research team on research projects if needed. jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Security Engineer (SDE 3)
jobs.descriptionHtml: Kredivo Group is looking for a Senior Security Engineer to lead day-to-day Enterprise Security work. This is a hands-on role. You will own the security of our endpoints, identity, SaaS, network and cloud, and you will guide junior security engineers on the team. You will deploy and run our security platforms, remediate vulnerabilities across the fleet, and harden our corporate environment using zero trust and secure-by-default principles. You will work with IT, DevOps and Engineering across Indonesia, and international, and support Cyber Defense during incidents. **About the Job**: Cyber Defense Strategy & Leadership * Enterprise Security BAU work and projects, and help set the team's roadmap. * Mentor and coach SDE-1 and SDE-2 engineers, and review their configurations, scripts and remediation work. * Set priorities by risk, and track and report security posture metrics (patch compliance, EDR coverage, vulnerability SLA, phishing click rate) to the Enterprise Security Lead. * Write, maintain and enforce IT and Security policies, standards and procedures. Endpoint, Vulnerability & Patch Management * Administer and tune the security platforms: EDR, VMDR, WAF and the Email Security Gateway. * Run vulnerability management end to end: scanning, prioritization (CVSS, CISA KEV, Ransomware), remediation and SLA tracking across Windows, macOS and Linux. * Build and safely deploy patch and remediation automation through MDM tools. * Keep endpoint security agents deployed and healthy across the fleet. jobs.descriptionHtml: UltaHost is looking for a Senior Internal Security & Security Operations Engineer to take ownership of internal security and help strengthen the protection of our workforce, identities, systems, and day-to-day operations. This is a senior, hands-on technical role with responsibility across Identity & Access Management (IAM), internal security, security monitoring, SOC operations, and incident response. The position requires someone who can combine strong technical security expertise with a structured and operational approach to access control, monitoring, investigation, and risk reduction. You will be responsible for securing employee and contractor identities, privileged access, credentials, internal systems, endpoints, VPN and remote access, while ensuring that appropriate security controls are implemented and maintained throughout the account and access lifecycle. A key part of the role will also involve actively monitoring security events and investigating suspicious activity across authentication systems, endpoints, internal applications, and cloud/SaaS environments. You will take an active role in identifying potential threats, investigating security incidents, collecting evidence, containing risks, coordinating remediation, and ensuring corrective actions are followed through to closure. You will work closely with HR, IT, system owners, and other technical teams to improve access governance, strengthen internal security controls, enhance detection and response capabilities, and reduce security risks across UltaHost’s internal environment. We are looking for someone who is comfortable taking end-to-end ownership — from implementing preventive controls and improving security monitoring to investigating real incidents and driving security improvements across the organization. **What You’ll Own** **Identity, Access & Credential Security** * Design and maintain RBAC across departments, roles, and critical systems. * Manage MFA, SSO, PAM, investigate alerts from SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, authentication systems, cloud/SaaS platforms, internal applications, and endpoints. * Investigate suspicious logins, compromised accounts, credential leaks, alert quality, incident records, escalation paths, and response playbooks. * Lead internal security incidents and support infrastructure/product incidents involving identities or credentials. **Internal Systems & Workforce Security** * Define security requirements for laptops, VPN and remote access, email, code repositories, support platforms, finance tools, and administrative systems. * Work closely with HR and IT on joiner/mover/leaver processes and internal security investigations. * Support security awareness, phishing prevention, and secure handling of sensitive information and jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer (Cloud and Platform Security)
jobs.descriptionHtml: ### **About Amartha** Amartha is a technology company focused on creating shared prosperity by developing digital financial solutions for the grassroots economy. Founded in 2010 as a microfinance institution, Amartha connects rural, women-led micro-enterprises with affordable capital. Amartha is expanding as a tech company, building a microfinance ecosystem that connects to the growing digital economy through capital, investment, and payment services. By boosting the competitiveness of micro and small entrepreneurs, Amartha empowers women-led MSMEs, creates jobs, and fosters inclusive economic growth. Our Empowered to Grow culture guides how we work together. We Focus on Clarity, Take the Lead, and Grow Impact, empowering our people to take ownership and create meaningful, lasting impact. ### **About the role** Amartha is an Indonesian fintech group that provides financial services to micro-entrepreneurs through several licensed entities in lending, payments, and related services. Our production platform runs on Google Cloud and Kubernetes, and our security team is building the controls, detection, and automation that a regulated lender needs at that scale. We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own cloud and platform security engineering. You will run the controls that detect and prevent misconfiguration and intrusion across our cloud and container estate, respond to what our detection stack surfaces, and turn manual security infrastructure into code. You will work alongside DevOps and platform engineering, and your work feeds directly into our ISO 27001 and regulator audit evidence. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a wide mandate. You will be the senior voice on cloud security in the team, and we expect you to set the technical direction for it rather than wait for a backlog. ### **What you will do** * Own container and cloud runtime security: workload isolation, Kubernetes hardening, and runtime threat detection. * Run and extend automated benchmark and configuration scanning across our cloud platform and productivity suite, and act on what it finds. * Build shift-left security into CI/CD: infrastructure-as-code scanning and misconfiguration gates before deployment. * Bring the security team's own cloud estate under infrastructure as code. Provisioning is manual and drift-prone today, and ending that is a named deliverable of this role. * Build and run the deployment pipeline for our security tooling, so security infrastructure ships the same way the product does. * Own the SIEM platform end to end: network isolation, version currency, configuration management, and detection coverage across critical workloads. * Respond to and review security alerts, tune detection rules, and cut false positives. * Manage edge and perimeter security: web application firewall rules, DNS and traffic visibility, and security event retention. * Manage the platform and console access paths that sit with security engineering. * Document what you build, to the standard where another engineer can operate it without you. Continuity is a measured outcome of this role, not a nice-to-have. * Share the information security on-call rotation, and help us establish it. * Produce the control evidence our auditors and regulators ask for, with the GRC team. ### **What you bring** * 5 or more years in security engineering, infrastructure engineering, or SRE, with at least 3 years focused on cloud and container security. * Hands-on depth in public cloud and Kubernetes security: identity and access management, RBAC, workload identity, network policy, admission control, runtime detection, and secret management. Google Cloud is our primary platform. * Production experience with a SIEM, including deployment, detection rule authoring, and alert triage. * Infrastructure as code in practice, not in theory: reusable modules, state management, and deployment pipelines you built and operated yourself. * Experience embedding security scanni...

jobs.title: SPORT ANALYST INTERNATIONAL
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Analis Sepak Bola lnternasional** Bertanggung jawab menyajikan analisis pertandingan dan kompetisi berbasis data serta sumber tepercaya sebagai bahan editorial untuk preview, prediksi, dan liputan sepak bola. Deskripsi Pekerjaan * Menganalisis performa terkini tim dan pemain dengan mempertimbangkan hasil, konsistensi, produktivitas, serta konteks pertandingan. * Mengkaji pendekatan taktik, kekuatan dan kelemahan, kemungkinan susunan pemain, absensi, kondisi kandang/tandang, serta faktor teknis lain yang relevan. * Menganalisis rekor pertemuan, jadwal, kondisi kompetisi, dan data pendukung lain tanpa mengabaikan keterbatasan atau konteks datanya. * Menyusun preview dan prediksi pertandingan, termasuk alasan yang mendasari prediksi; membedakan fakta, interpretasi, dan opini dengan jelas. * Membuat brief analisis yang ringkas, akurat, mudah dipahami, dan dapat digunakan Editor sebagai bahan pengembangan artikel. * Memantau berita dan perkembangan yang berdampak pada analisis, serta memperbarui brief bila terdapat perubahan penting. * Mencantumkan sumber untuk data dan klaim, memeriksa keandalan sumber, dan tidak menyajikan spekulasi sebagai fakta. * Berkolaborasi dengan Editor untuk memastikan sudut analisis sesuai kebutuhan pembaca dan rencana editorial. **Kualifikasi** * Memiliki pengetahuan mendalam tentang sepak bola Indonesia, Vietnam, dan internasional serta kompetisi, klub, pemain, dan taktik. * Mampu menganalisis performa, taktik, rekor pertemuan, dan faktor teknis; mampu menjelaskan kesimpulan secara logis dan terstruktur. * Terampil melakukan riset dari beberapa sumber tepercaya dan memeriksa konsistensi data sebelum digunakan. * Mampu menulis dalam bahasa Indonesia dengan jelas; mampu membaca sumber berbahasa Inggris menjadi nilai tambah. * Teliti, kritis, memenuhi tenggat, dan terbuka terhadap evaluasi hasil prediksi maupun kualitas analisis. * Nilai tambah: pengalaman membuat preview/prediksi, menggunakan data statistik sepak bola, atau bekerja dengan media olahraga. * Perlu dicatat, khususnya, bahwa para editor tidak diperbolehkan menggunakan kecerdasan buatan (AI) untuk menulis artikel. Work Location: Hybrid remote in Jakarta Raya

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Gambaran Umum Pekerjaan** TANGGA AGENCY' mencari Sales Motoris Rokok yang bersemangat dan berorientasi pada penjualan untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Purwokerto. Posisi ini merupakan peran kunci dalam mendistribusikan dan mempromosikan produk rokok kami kepada berbagai outlet ritel di seluruh wilayah. Sebagai Sales Motoris Rokok, Anda akan bertanggung jawab untuk membangun hubungan pelanggan yang kuat, meningkatkan penjualan, dan memastikan ketersediaan produk yang optimal di setiap titik penjualan. Jabatan ini bersifat fulltime dan memerlukan Anda untuk bekerja di lapangan dengan menggunakan kendaraan roda dua atau empat untuk mengunjungi pelanggan secara berkala. **Tanggung Jawab Utama** * Mengunjungi outlet ritel, minimarket, warung, dan lokasi penjualan lainnya secara rutin untuk menawarkan dan menjual produk rokok sesuai dengan target penjualan yang ditetapkan. * Membangun dan mempertahankan hubungan bisnis yang baik dengan pemilik dan pengelola outlet untuk meningkatkan loyalitas pelanggan dan meningkatkan repeat order. * Memastikan penempatan produk yang optimal di lokasi penjualan, termasuk penata letak display dan merchandising yang menarik. * Mengelola inventaris produk, mencatat stok yang tersedia, dan melaporkan kebutuhan pengisian ulang kepada manajemen. * Melakukan pencatatan penjualan harian dan menyiapkan laporan penjualan secara akurat dan tepat waktu. * Mempromosikan produk baru dan penawaran khusus kepada pelanggan untuk meningkatkan kesadaran merek dan volume penjualan. * Menangani pembayaran dari pelanggan dan memastikan transaksi keuangan tercatat dengan benar. * Memberikan informasi produk dan mengatasi pertanyaan atau keluhan pelanggan pemahaman yang baik tentang manajemen stok dan merchandising. * Kemampuan komunikasi yang efektif dan keterampilan interpersonal yang kuat untuk membangun hubungan dengan pelanggan. * Semangat tinggi, motivasi diri yang kuat, dan orientasi terhadap target penjualan. * Kemauan untuk bekerja di lapangan dan melakukan perjalanan ke berbagai lokasi secara konsisten. * Pengetahuan dasar tentang produk rokok dan regulasi terkait industri tembakau. * Kemampuan menggunakan perangkat mobile atau sistem pencatatan digital untuk melaporkan penjualan. * Memiliki kendaraan roda dua atau empat sendiri merupakan keuntungan. **Manfaat Utama Perusahaan** * Gaji dasar yang kompetitif dengan sistem komisi berbasis pencapaian target penjualan. * Tunjangan kinerja dan bonus bulanan untuk pencapaian penjualan yang konsisten. * Tunjangan operasional untuk biaya bahan bakar dan pemeliharaan kendaraan. * Kesempatan pengembangan karier dengan pelatihan penjualan dan product knowledge yang berkelanjutan. * Lingkungan kerja yang dinamis dengan dukungan tim manajemen yang responsif. * Fleksibilitas dalam pengelolaan rute penjualan dengan otonomi dalam mengatur jadwal kunjungan. * Asuransi kesehatan dasar untuk melindungi kesejahteraan Anda. **Tentang Kami** TANGGA AGENCY' adalah perusahaan terkemuka di industri ritel dan distribusi produk konsumen yang berfokus pada menyediakan layanan penjualan berkualitas tinggi di seluruh wilayah Bali. Kami berkomitmen untuk membangun kemitraan jangka panjang dengan outlet ritel dan memastikan produk kami tersedia dengan mudah bagi konsumen. Dengan tim yang profesional dan berpengalaman, kami terus berinovasi dalam strategi pemasaran dan penjualan untuk mencapai pertumbuhan bisnis yang berkelanjutan. TANGGA AGENCY' menghargai dedikasi, integritas, dan kerja keras, dan kami percaya bahwa kesuksesan bersama adalah kunci untuk membangun bisnis yang kuat dan berkelanjutan...

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Full-stack) - AI Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer (Fullstack) - 2 Job Title Software Engineer (Full-stack) - AI Platform Job Description About the Role We’re hiring for a Full-stack Engineer for Flip's newly created AI Platform team. You will be working with the technology that will support and empower our various product offerings, including but not limited to payments & transfers, lifestyle products, gaming, payment gateway, and many others. You’ll be working across both front-end and back-end components — turning ideas into impactful features that enhance user experience and business efficiency. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, fellow engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders to design, develop, and optimize solutions that align with our technical and business goals. You’ll also have the opportunity to continuously improve our codebase, share best practices, and explore new technologies that keep our systems robust and future ready. About Flip Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar, who were college friends in Universitas Indonesia, started Flip as a project in 2015 to transfer payments to each other at a fraction of what banks would charge them. They are pioneers in the Indonesian market, with their technology now helping millions of Indonesians, both individuals and businesses, carry out bank-to-bank money transfers through a reliable and seamless app. After ten years of operations, Flip has helped Indonesians transfer money worth several trillions of rupiah and has received double-digit funding from respectable investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partner, and Insignia. Flip’s ultimate mission is to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world. At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. What You'll Do: * *Develop and maintain front-end and back-end applications.* * *Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality features.* * *Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.* * *Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback.* * *Troubleshoot and debug applications.* * *Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.* * *Report directly to the Engineering Manager and will work closely with other engineers and a Product Manager in their dedicated stream.* What You'll Need: * *Have a solid background in common programming problems and solutions.* * *Experience working on both the front-end (user-facing side) and back-end (server-side)* * *Knowledge and experience in Go, React.JS, & Next.js* * *Experience in working with large data set and/or high concurrency systems is a plus.* * *Solid understanding of algorithms, algorithmic complexities, OOP, design patterns, and clean code.* * *Ability to plan, prioritize, estimate, and execute a task with a good degree of predictability.* * *Ability to scope, review and refine user stories and/or tasks for technical completeness and to alleviate dependency risk.*

jobs.title: Graphic Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: We are seeking a creative, detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join our marketing team. In this role, you will develop visual concepts, create engaging graphics across digital and print media, and ensure our brand identity remains strong and consistent. You will collaborate closely with copywriters, marketers, and product managers to translate strategic goals into high-impact visual stories. **Key Responsibilities** * **Visual Asset Creation:** Design compelling graphics for digital channels (social media, website banners, email templates, digital ads) and print materials (brochures, flyers, packaging, event collateral). * **Brand Management:** Maintain and evolve brand guidelines, ensuring consistent visual identity across all marketing touchpoints. * **Collaboration & Concepting:** Brainstorm visual concepts with cross-functional teams and translate creative briefs into clear design solutions. * **Production & Pre-Press:** Prepare final production-ready files for web (optimized formats) and print (color proofing, bleed, typography adjustments). * **Project Management:** Prioritize multiple design requests, meet tight deadlines, and incorporate stakeholder feedback efficiently. **Qualifications & Requirements** * **Education & Experience:** Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience with a strong portfolio). * **Portfolio:** A diverse portfolio showcasing expertise in typography, layout, color theory, and visual story-telling across digital and print formats. * **Technical Proficiency:**⚬ Advanced skills in **Adobe Creative Cloud** (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).⚬ Hands-on experience with modern design/prototyping tools like **Figma** or **Sketch**. * **Design Fundamentals:** Deep understanding of composition, grid systems, image editing, and digital media formats. * **Soft Skills:** Strong communication skills, openness to constructive feedback, and the ability to manage time independently in a fast-paced environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Basic knowledge of motion graphics/video editing (**Adobe After Effects** or **Premiere Pro**). * Experience with HTML/CSS or email marketing builders (e.g., Mailchimp, Figma-to-code plugins). * Familiarity with UI/UX principles and digital accessibility (WCAG) standards. Work Location: In person

This role is primarily focused on **automated testing**. You will design, develop and maintain reusable automation frameworks and test scripts covering UI, API, integration and regression testing. You will also perform manual and exploratory testing where automation is not practical. Web and Mobile Application Testing * Automate web application testing using tools such as **Selenium, Cypress or Playwright**. * Automate mobile application testing using **Maestro, Appium, Espresso, XCUITest or equivalent frameworks**. * Develop and maintain **Maestro test flows** for critical user journeys, smoke testing, regression testing and end-to-end testing across iOS and Android applications. * Validate application behaviour across supported browsers, devices, screen sizes and operating systems. * Perform manual and exploratory testing for complex scenarios that cannot be effectively automated. 3. API and Backend Testing * Develop automated API tests using tools or frameworks such as **Postman/Newman, REST Assured or equivalent**. * Validate API requests, responses, authentication, business rules and error handling. * Perform database queries to verify data integrity and backend processing. * Test integrations between mobile applications, web applications, APIs and external systems. 4. CI/CD and Continuous Testing * Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines. * Work with developers and DevOps engineers to execute automated tests during builds, deployments and scheduled regression runs. * Monitor automation results and provide clear reporting on test coverage, failures and release risks. * Improve execution speed, stability and reliability of automated test suites. 5. Test Planning and Quality Assurance * Review business requirements, user stories and technical specifications to identify test scenarios. * Prepare and maintain test plans, test cases, test scripts and traceability records. * Conduct functional, regression, integration, usability and compatibility testing. * Support SIT, UAT, release validation and post-deployment verification. * Contribute to performance testing using tools such as **JMeter, k6, Gatling or LoadRunner**, where required. 6. You bring practical experience operating workshop machinery, an understanding of technical drawings and measurement equipment, and the ability to maintain machinery in reliable working condition. You are comfortable working under limited supervision, solving non-routine challenges through analysis, and supporting and guiding less experienced colleagues while consistently delivering work to established standards. jobs.title: Marketing Data Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Company Overview** Wego is an online travel metasearch platform used by millions to find the best flights and hotel deals. We are seeking a talented, agile Marketing Automation & AI Engineer with a strong focus on Agentic AI to join our MarTech team. **Role Description** As part of the Marketing Technology (MarTech) team, you will build the next generation of marketing automation - designing and deploying autonomous AI agents that drive insights from digital campaigns and independently optimize marketing operations. You will work daily alongside the Performance Marketing team, deeply understanding their KPIs (ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversion rates) and how media platforms work, their campaign structures, auction mechanics, and APIs (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, Apple Search Ads) to ensure every system you build directly serves campaign performance goals. Unlike traditional, rigid backend data roles focused solely on static data lakes, this position requires building highly adaptable, configuration-driven automation systems. You will design architectures that allow the Performance Marketing team to quickly pivot campaign strategies, creative assets, and budget pacing without needing structural core code deployments for every minor requirement change. **Key Responsibilities** * **Campaign Creation & Optimization Automation:** Architect end-to-end automated workflows for campaign creation, audience segmentation, creative assembly, launch, and continuous optimization using AI/ML signals to drive dynamic bidding, budget pacing, and A/B testing across channels. * **AI-Driven Content Orchestration:** Engineer multi-agent systems to generate and iterate on personalized ad content (ad copy, images, videos) at scale. * **Agile Data Activation & Automation Infrastructure:** Build and maintain flexible data flows optimized for real-time marketing activation. Ensure data structures are explicitly designed for dynamic content generation and automated campaign adjustment rather than just static reporting or legacy ETL pipelines. * **Performance Marketing Collaboration:** Partner daily with the Performance Marketing team to translate KPIs and rapidly changing campaign objectives into technical configurations; ensure data integrity, API reliability, and consistent AI agent deployments across all paid channels. * **Agentic Workflow Development:** Design, build, and deploy autonomous AI agents using LLMs (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) for automated marketing workflows. **Qualifications** **Experience & Domain Expertise** * 3+ years in performance/digital marketing analytics and marketing automation with hands-on experience in AI engineering. * Deep understanding of paid/performance marketing KPIs, how media platforms work (campaign structure, auction mechanics, targeting, measurement) and their APIs (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok), and MMP tooling (AppsFlyer, Adjust). * Proven experience building end-to-end campaign automation systems including programmatic campaign creation, ML-driven optimization, and automated actions via ad platform APIs. **Technical Skills** * Advanced SQL and Python. * Proven experience building configuration-driven architectures or rules engines (e.g., headless CMS integrations, dynamic creative optimization tools), attribution models, and activation workflows. * Proficiency building and orchestrating AI agents using foundational LLMs; integrating LLMs and AI agents with external tools and APIs. **Soft Skills & Mindset** * Extreme flexibility and comfort with ambiguity: Understands that marketing strategies pivot quickly and intentionally designs technical solutions to accommodate fluid business requirements. * Strong product mindset: Views the marketing team as your core "users" and builds tools that empower them to self-serve safely. * Excellent communication skills to seamlessly bridge technical architectures with creative marketing strategies.

Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position.*** **Program Overview** WRI Indonesia is an independent research organization that turns big ideas into action at the nexus of environment, economic opportunity, and human well-being. At WRI Indonesia, we aim to bring innovations in research and business approaches in order to create the enabling conditions for Indonesia to achieve robust economic growth while respecting environmental and social values. We seek to contribute to the accomplishment of ambitious sustainable development goals through working with leaders in public and private sectors, as well as collaborating with civil society organizations, in turning big ideas into action. To achieve Indonesia’s climate goal while at the same time improving the livelihood of the communities and protecting biodiversity, we work together with partners to mainstream nature-based solutions (NbS) as an approach to address global climate challenge. We aim to achieve this through research, policy advocacy, and creation of a community of practice to develop new financing model for forest conservation, advocate regulatory framework that are conducive for NbS approach, and development of multi-stakeholder platform to amplify and accelerate NbS approach in Indonesia and Southeast Asia region. **SCeNe Coalition** The SCeNe Coalition is aimed to develop Triple Benefit Tools and Website for Southeast Asia Climate and Nature-based Solution (SCeNe) Coalition. Triple Benefit Tool will help to identify high impact future NbS opportunities, ensuring a targeted pipeline of NbS supply that focus on geographies with the highest conservation, social development and carbon potential. This tool will also help to validate triple benefit quality, giving the projects additional scientific credibility; to ensure finance is flowing transparently; and to increase ecosystem participation. **Data Lab Indonesia** The Data Lab Unit aims to establish a leading hub for open-source data, code, and visualizations, fostering data democratization and collaboration among NGOs and development partners. By addressing critical challenges such as unsustainable data platform management strategies, technical inconsistencies, and high employee turnover, the unit will ensure the long-term sustainability and impact of WRI Indonesia's platforms. This initiative transforms grant-dependent outputs into powerful tools for driving positive change in climate resilience, social equity, and nature conservation across Indonesia and Southeast Asia. Aligning with WRI's strategy, the Data Lab Unit promotes systemic, data-driven solutions, transitioning WRI's approach from isolated project delivery to broader systems change while enhancing institutional capabilities and addressing financial sustainability gaps to create scalable, impactful initiatives. **Job Highlight** The Senior AI Engineer will lead the technical development and evaluation of AI capabilities for the Dynamic Multilingual Translation and Document Generation initiative within the Nature-based Solutions (NbS) Tool. The role focuses on building reliable, source-grounded multilingual translation and AI-assisted document generation capabilities using existing Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) approaches. Working under the direct supervision of the Product and Engineering Manager, the Senior AI Engineer will working closely with the Product Manager and Backend Engineers, the consultant will evaluate suitable AI models, design and optimise AI pipelines, establish measurable quality standards, and provide technical guidance for integration into the NbS Tool. jobs.title: Middle Full-Stack Developer (Next.js)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About us** ============ Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/ **About the role** ================== We are looking for a disciplined, highly autonomous Middle Next.js Developer to build and ship product features for one of our core D2C subscription products. You will own features end to end across a TypeScript monorepo — a Next.js App Router client, a Fastify + Payload CMS API on PostgreSQL, and Cloudflare Workers at the edge — from the moment you receive a task, through breaking it down, estimating, implementing, testing, and observability, to a clean release to production and confirmation that it works for real users. This is a hands-on engineering role suited for someone who treats production as the standard, not the finish line. Half-tested code, silent failures, and unverified AI-generated output are not acceptable. The codebase is convention-heavy — a layered Feature-Sliced Design structure with strict import rules — and you are expected to work inside those conventions rather than around them. You are accountable for every task you take on and for every area of the product you touch: if it breaks, regresses, or stays half-finished, that is yours to see through. We expect maximum autonomy and real involvement in the product — you work independently within a sprint, communicate risks before they become blockers, and escalate architectural decisions to senior engineers rather than guessing. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== ### **Feature Development** * Build features across the Next.js client and the Fastify + Payload CMS backend according to product requirements * Write code that follows the team's Feature-Sliced Design layering, naming, and import conventions * Ship changes behind feature flags and A/B experiments, fully localized across every supported locale * Integrate third-party providers — billing, email/CRM, analytics — over REST APIs and webhooks ### **Quality & Reliability** * Cover functionality with unit, integration, and e2e tests at the level the team expects * Run a thorough self-review before code review, and review teammates' code with the same rigour * Fix bugs and perform root-cause analysis for recurring issues * Optimize page and endpoint performance — rendering and caching strategy, database queries, bundle size ### **Security & Observability** * Apply secure development practices: schema validation, access control, safe handling of secrets * Follow observability practices — structured logging, metrics, and alerts — using existing tooling ### **Collaboration** * Break down, estimate, and ship your own tasks to production within the sprint — and stay accountable for them after release * Own the areas of the product you work in: their stability, performance, and follow-up fixes * Surface requirement clarifications, estimate changes, and risks early and in writing * Escalate complex architectural decisions and critical risks to senior engineers **Qualifications** ================== ### **Must-Have Experience** * 2+ years of commercial React experience, including 1+ year with Next.js (App Router, Server Components, route handlers, rendering and caching strategies) and solid TypeScript * Node.js backend experience on a typed HTTP framework (Fastify, Nest, or Express) with PostgreSQL — REST API design, schema migrations, integrations over REST and webhooks (signature verification, idempotency, retries) — plus a working understanding of HTTP/REST, auth mechanisms, and web security fundamentals * Hands-on with the modern client stack: TanStack jobs.descriptionHtml: **About us** VTL Travel is a Singapore-based travel company that operates as the parent brand for a family of niche travel sites, each targeting a distinct segment of the travel market. Under the VTL Travel umbrella sit three focused brands: Holidays From Singapore, which handles leisure travel, nearby getaways, cruises, visa-related services, and corporate trips; Tour Mount Bromo, which specializes in East Java tours covering Mount Bromo, Ijen, waterfalls, and private tour packages; and Batam Ferry Tickets, which focuses on Singapore-to-Batam ferry ticket bookings and promotions. **About the role** We're looking for a hands-on web developer to maintain and grow batamferrytickets.com — a custom built site — and to build and manage the API integrations that power our booking, payment, and ferry booking API features. This is a practical, execution-focused role: keeping the site fast, secure, and bug-free, while connecting it reliably to the third-party systems our bookings depend on. **Key responsibilities** * Maintain and troubleshoot website, including API Updates and theme updates, performance tuning, and uptime/security monitoring * Fix bugs, broken forms, layout issues, and mobile responsiveness problems as they arise * Implement design and content changes from the marketing team without breaking page speed or SEO structure * Manage staging-to-live deployment workflow to avoid downtime on a revenue-generating site * Build and maintain the integration between the site and the ferry ticketing/booking system (availability, pricing, seat/ticket confirmation) * Develop and maintain the hotel-booking module integration for combined ferry+hotel packages (hotel supplier or OTA API/feed) * Maintain the payment gateway integration (HitPay or Airwallex) and troubleshoot failed or stuck transactions * Connect and maintain WhatsApp Business API or click-to-WhatsApp flows for enquiry handling * Set up and maintain GA4 and Google Ads conversion tracking (events, server-side tagging where needed) so booking data flows correctly for marketing reporting * Handle webhook endpoints and scheduled sync jobs (e.g. inventory/price sync) reliably, with logging and error alerts **About you** * 2+ years of experience Web Developer (PHP, custom functions, child themes, Payment Gateway Integration) * Proven experience integrating REST/SOAP APIs, handling JSON, authentication (API keys, OAuth), and webhooks * Good Practical skillset in API integration * Experience with payment gateway integrations (HitPay, Stripe, PayNow, or similar) * Comfortable working with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Ads conversion tracking * Solid understanding of website security (SSL, backups, firewall rules, malware cleanup) * Familiar with git-based deployment workflows and staging environments * Able to debug independently and document fixes clearly Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **[PT Mitra Cakra Digital — Tech Team]** Kami mencari **DevSecOps Engineer** yang tangguh untuk membangun, mengamankan, dan mengotomatiskan jalur rilis serta infrastruktur aplikasi berbasis *container* di PT Mitra Cakra Digital. Di peran ini, Anda adalah garda terdepan yang memastikan sistem kami beroperasi secara stabil, aman, dan *high-availability*. Hasil kerja Anda—mulai dari *pipeline* CI/CD, otomatisasi GitOps, hingga *observability stack*—akan menjadi fondasi utama yang diandalkan oleh seluruh tim pengembang kami. **Apa yang akan Anda lakukan:** * Membangun, mengotomatiskan, dan memelihara *pipeline* CI/CD yang cepat, andal, dan terintegrasi dengan kontrol keamanan. * Mengelola dan mengoptimalkan infrastruktur *container* serta orkestrasinya menggunakan Kubernetes dan Helm. * Menerapkan pengelolaan kredensial (*secret management*) dan *security policy* pada jalur rilis untuk mencegah kebocoran data. * Membangun dan mengelola sistem pemantauan (*observability*), pencatatan *log*, serta *distributed tracing* (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry). * Mengonfigurasi API Gateway, menyusun kebijakan akses (*access policy*), serta menetapkan *rate limiting* untuk menjaga keamanan dan beban server. **Yang kami cari (Kualifikasi):** * Pengalaman minimal 4 tahun di bidang DevOps, DevSecOps, atau *Site Reliability Engineering* (SRE). * Penguasaan mendalam dalam orkestrasi **Kubernetes** dan pengelolaan **Helm** *charts*. * Menguasai *tooling* CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, atau setara) dan pendekatan jobs.title: Head of Business & Growth - GoPay Later
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About the Role** As Head of Business & Growth for GoPay Later, you’ll own the growth of product by combining business understanding, data, and customer insights to find where the next wave of growth and opportunity will come from. You’ll turn those opportunities into go-to-market plans across product and marketing and drive them from strategy through execution and measurement, with clear accountability. jobs.title: Brand Marketing Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About Us** MAGI Group started in 2020 selling acrylic printed merchandise. Since then, we’ve grown into a merchandise house that ships internationally on a regular basis, with two brands under one roof: * **Magihae** — merchandise for the IP, creator, and fandom world. We work with artists, creators, publishers, IP owners, and IP-focused and premium brands. * **Magi** — a merchandise partner for corporates and brands, from corporate gifting to campaign merchandise, trusted by leading names across retail, beauty, and F&B. Behind both is our own production facility in Jakarta, with in-house UV printing, digital printing, laser cutting, and fiber marking. **Why This Role Matters** People already know us for merchandise, and it sells. What we want next is for our brands to feel more like culture: more creative, more collaborative, and more present in the conversations that matter to creators and brands. Our goal is to become the trusted merchandise partner for Southeast Asia’s creative industry. You’ll lead how we get there. **Why Join Us?** * **Join at the right moment.** We’re growing with strong organic traction. What we need now is a captain to set the direction and lead the team. * **Build something that doesn’t exist yet.** The creative industry in Indonesia and Southeast Asia is growing fast, but no merchandise brand is top of mind yet. We plan to build that from our own niche. * **Compete on value, not price.** Our market rewards quality, creativity, and craft over who’s cheapest. That makes the work harder, and a lot more fun. * **Work with a team that keeps innovating.** Our product team runs active R&D, and we’re often early adopters of new production technology and market trends, so there’s always something new to bring to market. * **Turn ideas into real products, fast.** With in-house production, a campaign idea can become a physical product with fast iteration. * **Work directly with the founder** and have real ownership over where both brands go next. **What You’ll Do** * Plan and lead brand campaigns and activations, from concept to measurable results. * Manage collaborations with KOLs, artists, and creators across Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore. * Develop the promotion calendar and content strategy across our brands. * Define product positioning and make sure brand communication stays consistent. * Lead and coordinate a small team and freelancers, and report on performance weekly. **What We’re Looking For** * Around 3–5 years of experience in brand, marketing, or product marketing, with a proven track record of leading campaigns end-to-end. * Experience coordinating small teams and freelancers, especially for content and creator-related projects. * Experience working with KOLs and creators, from sourcing and negotiation to briefing and performance measurement. * Comfortable working with budgets and target margins, and with approval and payment processes through Finance. * Strong creative taste combined with commercial sense: you care about how things look *and* whether they sell. * Familiarity with fandom culture (anime, K-pop, comics) is a plus, along with the ability to reach creative audiences beyond fandom communities. * Understanding of merchandise, printing, or IP licensing is a strong plus. * Strong written and presentation skills in both Indonesian and English. **How to Apply** Send your CV and portfolio to bit.ly/Brandmarketing2026 Jenis Pekerjaan: Penuh Waktu Pertanyaan Lamaran: * Ekspektasi Salary Pengalaman: * brand & marketing: 3 tahun (Diwajibkan) Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

jobs.title: Head of Sales | Revit
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Revit** is one of the brands in the Belkins group of companies. In 3 years, we’ve grown to a team of 25+ people located all over the world, and so far we’ve made a positive impact on more than 150 clients who trusted our team with their growth and outbound (emails, LinkedIn, cold calling). At Revit, we show up every day because we love selling ideas, creating new business relationships, solving challenges that might seem impossible, and getting results where others couldn’t — so that like-minded clients who trust us with their outbound and growth can become our years-long partners. With more extensive support from the other companies in the Belkins group, our 2027 goal is to grow 2x in size and find a way to keep scaling while keeping quality high across the board — from having the best people on the team to onboarding the right clients who match our values and value proposition. Back in 2017, **Belkins** started as an appointment-setting agency with just one service offering. Fast forward to today, and we’ve transformed into Belkins Group — a vibrant ecosystem of services and products that define the cutting-edge landscape of the SalesTech and MarTech industries. Among our successes are ambitious start-ups like **Revit**, which have evolved into standalone powerhouses, as well as innovative products such as **Folderly**. This is not a place for everyone, but if you’re looking for a world-class culture and an opportunity to grow, build your career, and make an impact, you’re likely to enjoy being part of Revit and building the future together with us! And now we’re looking for a **Head of Sales**: someone who wants to own the number, not just manage the team, and who’d rather be on the call than read about it in a report. #### **The role** Revit sells outbound, so our own sales team is measured by the same thing we promise clients: real conversations that turn into real deals. You’ll take over the sales team and the number behind it, with one clear goal for 2027 — help us grow 2x: * Double MRR by the end of 2027; * Double our close rate; * Actively support marketing as we double the pipeline. You’ll work side by side with Nick, our Co-Founder/CEO, the core team across all verticals, and the other brands in Belkins Group. ### **What you’ll do:** * **Making 3 AEs better every week.** You’ll do call reviews, give feedback, sit in on deals, and jump in to close when it matters. * **Owning the number.** You’ll handle MRR, forecasts, and monthly plans, and know where we stand and why before anyone asks. * **Building the system.** You’ll build a sales process that’s clear enough for a new AE to follow, with data that shows exactly where deals get stuck. * **Growing the close rate.** You’ll find where we lose deals between the first call and the signature, and fix it. * **Designing KPIs and incentives** that reward the results we actually want. * **Being marketing’s closest partner.** You’ll shape ICPs and messaging together, so a bigger pipeline turns into revenue, not just a fuller calendar. * **Scaling the team** as we grow, including bringing in fractional AEs when it makes sense. ### **What you bring:** A sales leader who wants to own our growth. jobs.title: Business Development Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Business Development Associate – AI Visibility Services** Job Type: Full-Time | Fully Remote Compensation: IDR 3,000,000 monthly base salary + commission **Job Overview** UK Creative Ventures is looking for a motivated Business Development Associate to help introduce our AI Visibility services to small and medium-sized businesses across the UK, USA, Europe, New Zealand and Australia. As more people use ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and other AI-powered platforms to find businesses and services, online visibility is changing. Our AI Visibility service helps businesses understand how they appear in AI search results and identify opportunities to improve their online presence. This role involves finding potential clients, starting conversations, presenting our services and developing business relationships. It is ideal for someone who is confident with outreach, enjoys communicating with business owners and can work independently. **Key Responsibilities** - Research and identify potential SME clients across the UK, USA, Europe, New Zealand, Australia and international markets. - Generate new business opportunities through LinkedIn, email and other relevant channels. - Contact business owners and decision-makers to introduce our services. - Explain the benefits of the AI Visibility Snapshot and convert prospects into paying clients. - Follow up with potential clients and maintain an organised sales pipeline. - Identify opportunities to introduce clients to our Growth & AI Audit and wider marketing, recruitment and education services. - Build and maintain professional relationships with prospective and existing clients. - Share market feedback and prospect insights to help improve our sales approach. - Prospect lists, messaging frameworks and service guidance will be provided. **Requirements** - Previous experience in sales, business development, lead generation or client acquisition. - Confidence communicating with business owners and decision-makers. - Experience with LinkedIn outreach, cold emailing or telephone prospecting. - Good written and verbal communication skills. - Ability to explain services clearly, particularly to people unfamiliar with AI search. - Strong organisation, follow-up and time-management skills. - Self-motivated, target-driven and comfortable working remotely. - Experience in digital marketing, recruitment, SaaS or B2B services is an advantage. jobs.descriptionHtml: ***Consultant as Project Implementation Assistant - Cities Program*** ***This is a hybrid position which requires 8 days per month in the office. You will be based in our office in WRI Indonesia, Jakarta. Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position.*** **Program Overview** Under the support of the Climate and Clean Air Coalition (CCAC), WRI Indonesia is supporting the establishment and operationalization of the Indonesia Super Pollutant Unit to strengthen Indonesia’s capacity to design, coordinate, and implement policies and actions to reduce super pollutants, including short-lived climate pollutants (SLCPs). WRI Indonesia serves as the administrator of the Unit. This institutional arrangement is designed to enable sustained engagement with senior government leadership while strengthening operational coordination across key technical directorates, including Waste Management, Climate Change, Air Quality, and Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification (MRV). Acting as Indonesia’s national coordination platform for super pollutant mitigation, the Unit will convene relevant ministries, along with state-owned enterprises, development partners, and subnational governments. Through this platform, the Unit will promote coherent policy development, strengthen integrated data and knowledge systems, mobilize financial and technical resources, and mainstream super pollutant mitigation into Indonesia’s national development and climate policy frameworks. **Job Highlight** The Project Implementation Assistant will provide administrative, operational, and coordination support to the Indonesia Super Pollutant Unit to facilitate the effective delivery of its projects and activities. The position will primarily focus on providing and coordinating administrative and operational support including , maintaining project documentation, track implementation progress and deliverables, and facilitate stakeholder engagement activities by preparing materials, documenting key results and follow-up action, and preparing materials to support project report.. The role also requires a good understanding of super pollutant issues and the Unit’s program priorities to effectively support the preparation of briefing notes, meeting materials, presentations, and other documents requiring technical or substantive inputs. Working closely with the Technical Unit Senior Lead and relevant technical experts, the Project Implementation Assistant will help consolidate technical inputs, organize relevant information, and ensure that program materials are accurate, consistent, and aligned with the Unit’s priorities., The role will also support follow up on agreed actions and outstanding tasks to facilitate smooth program coordination and implementation. The Project Implementation Assistant will report directly to the SLCP Technical Unit Senior Lead and coordinate with relevant WRI Indonesia teams, government counterparts, technical experts, and development partners as required to support the implementation of the Unit’s activities. This position is based in Jakarta with flexible working arrangements and domestic and international travel as required. In support of WRI's commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI), this position is expected to actively integrate equity and inclusive practices into program implementation, stakeholder engagement, and organizational culture. **What You Will Do** **Project Implementation Support (50%)** * Provide administrative and operational support for program implementation under the direction of the SLCP Technical Unit Senior Lead. * Assist in maintaining project work plans, activity trackers, deliverable records, and other project documentation to support implementation monitoring and follow-up. * Support the preparation of terms of reference, briefing notes, presentations, progress updates, and other administrative and program m...

jobs.title: Facilities Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml: Summary Apple is now seeking an extraordinary Facilities Manager to support the growing team in Indonesia. The Facilities Manager is the culmination of all the skills and resources of a validated facility professional with additional cross-functional administration expertise and exceptional customer experience skills. As a Facilities Manager, you will hold a strong emphasis on running site operations critical to ensuring consistent delivery and the highest performance levels for Soft & Hard Services. You will have the ability to harmonize with Apple corporate business functions & customers at all levels and provide multiple structured and/or ad-hoc, timely and accurate status reports. Description Responsible for the delivery, management, and maintenance of services within offices and academies in Indonesia, including: - Hands-on provision of site Soft & Hard Services - Collaborating with Apple's LOB, RE&D and their nominated internal/external vendors/partners - Input to in-GEO OPEX planning and budgets - Handle Places commercial obligations, e.g., Lease, Utility & Vendor payments - Drive consistency in Places site services and resources as directed - Create and sustain Best Practices for the Facility Team - Run single to multiple, simple to complex Facility initiatives, programs, and projects - Adherence to the use of established protocols, tools & processes - Follow up with Apple customers on site services delivery tracking, issues, risks, and results - Ensure vendors' compliance with agreed SLAs and KPIs - Implement tools, standards, policies, guidelines, and processes - Input on Facility Management improvement programs - Advising and driving improvement changes in Places Facility Management services at the Site level - Support site OH&S compliance - Manage office occupancy report and space planning Minimum Qualifications * 3-5 years of experience in Facility Management or related roles in the high-end corporate office environment * Degree qualified in related fields * Contract/Operations management experience * Must have professional fluency in written and spoken Bahasa Indonesia and English Preferred Qualifications * Experience with space management/churn project management an advantage * IFMA certification desirable but not required * Passionate about customer services and end-user experience * Self-starter and capable individual contributor * Ability to connect with dispersed internal/external teams * Excellent communication and presentation skills At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong. Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

jobs.title: Freelance Writer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our organization is seeking content writers to create articles and blog posts on a variety of topics.

 

The rate of pay is $20 per 100 words (this comes out to approximately $100 per article or $50 per hour).

 

Some topics you may be asked to write about include the following (you can always turn down a topic if you do not feel comfortable writing about it, however if you have experience or expertise in a specific area, please let us know):

 

  • Health & beauty
  • Fitness
  • Home Decor
  • Fashion
  • Sports
  • Do it yourself
  • Finance
  • Legal
  • Medical
  • Family/Parenting
  • Relationships
  • Real Estate
  • Restaurants
  • Contracting (plumbing, pool building, remodeling, etc.)

 

These are just some of the more general industries and topics that we cover.

 

Requirements:

  • We ask that all work be completed using a word processor such as Microsoft Word or Open Office
  • A reliable internet connection and the ability to meet deadlines
  • Good communication skills and respond in a timely manner to editorial staff when they ask for updates on tasks, etc
  • Work well as a team member with the rest of our content management and editorial staff



Note: Applicants to this job signaled that accessing some writing tasks may require payment.
